13940.label: Psalms 1:1
13940.text: Happy is the man who does not walk according to the advice of the wickedAnd does not stand on the path of sinners And does not sit in the seat of scoffers.

13941.label: Psalms 1:2
13941.text: But his delight is in the law of Jehovah, And he reads His law in an undertone day and night.

13942.label: Psalms 1:3
13942.text: He will be like a tree planted by streams of water,A tree that produces fruit in its season,The foliage of which does not wither. And everything he does will succeed.

13943.label: Psalms 1:4
13943.text: The wicked are not like that;They are like the chaff that the wind blows away.

13944.label: Psalms 1:5
13944.text: That is why the wicked will not remain standing in the judgment; Nor will sinners remain standing in the assembly of the righteous.

13945.label: Psalms 1:6
13945.text: For Jehovah is aware of the way of the righteous, But the way of the wicked will perish.

13946.label: Psalms 2:1
13946.text: Why are the nations agitatedAnd the peoples muttering an empty thing?

13947.label: Psalms 2:2
13947.text: The kings of the earth take their standAnd high officials gather together as one Against Jehovah and against his anointed one.

13948.label: Psalms 2:3
13948.text: They say: “Let us tear off their shacklesAnd throw off their ropes!”

13949.label: Psalms 2:4
13949.text: The One enthroned in the heavens will laugh;Jehovah will scoff at them.

13950.label: Psalms 2:5
13950.text: At that time he will speak to them in his angerAnd terrify them in his burning anger,

13951.label: Psalms 2:6
13951.text: Saying: “I myself have installed my king On Zion, my holy mountain.”

13952.label: Psalms 2:7
13952.text: Let me proclaim the decree of Jehovah;He said to me: “You are my son; Today I have become your father.

13953.label: Psalms 2:8
13953.text: Ask of me, and I will give nations as your inheritanceAnd the ends of the earth as your possession.

13954.label: Psalms 2:9
13954.text: You will break them with an iron scepter, And you will smash them like a piece of pottery.”

13955.label: Psalms 2:10
13955.text: So now, you kings, show insight;Accept correction, you judges of the earth.

13956.label: Psalms 2:11
13956.text: Serve Jehovah with fear,And rejoice with trembling.

13957.label: Psalms 2:12
13957.text: Honor the son, or God will become indignantAnd you will perish from the way, For His anger flares up quickly. Happy are all those taking refuge in Him.

13959.label: Psalms 3:1
13959.text: O Jehovah, why have my adversaries become so numerous? Why are so many rising up against me?

13960.label: Psalms 3:2
13960.text: Many are saying about me: “God will not save him.” (Selah)

13961.label: Psalms 3:3
13961.text: But you, O Jehovah, are a shield around me, My glory and the One who lifts up my head.

13962.label: Psalms 3:4
13962.text: I will call aloud to Jehovah,And he will answer me from his holy mountain. (Selah)

13963.label: Psalms 3:5
13963.text: I will lie down and sleep;And I will wake up in safety,For Jehovah continues to support me.

13964.label: Psalms 3:6
13964.text: I am not afraid of the tens of thousandsLined up against me on every side.

13965.label: Psalms 3:7
13965.text: Rise up, O Jehovah! Save me, O my God! For you will strike all my enemies on the jaw;You will break the teeth of the wicked.

13966.label: Psalms 3:8
13966.text: Salvation belongs to Jehovah. Your blessing is upon your people. (Selah)

13968.label: Psalms 4:1
13968.text: When I call, answer me, O my righteous God. Make a way of escape for me in my distress. Show me favor and hear my prayer.

13969.label: Psalms 4:2
13969.text: You sons of men, how long will you turn my honor into humiliation? How long will you love what is worthless and search for what is false? (Selah)

13970.label: Psalms 4:3
13970.text: Know that Jehovah will treat his loyal one in a special way; Jehovah will hear when I call to him.

13971.label: Psalms 4:4
13971.text: Be agitated, but do not sin. Have your say in your heart, upon your bed, and keep silent. (Selah)

13972.label: Psalms 4:5
13972.text: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness,And trust in Jehovah.

13973.label: Psalms 4:6
13973.text: There are many saying: “Who will show us anything good?” Let the light of your face shine upon us, O Jehovah.

13974.label: Psalms 4:7
13974.text: You have filled my heart with greater rejoicingThan those who have an abundant harvest of grain and new wine.

13975.label: Psalms 4:8
13975.text: I will lie down and sleep in peace, For you alone, O Jehovah, make me dwell in security.

13977.label: Psalms 5:1
13977.text: Listen to my words, O Jehovah; Be attentive to my sighing.

13978.label: Psalms 5:2
13978.text: Pay attention to my cry for help,O my King and my God, because to you I pray.

13979.label: Psalms 5:3
13979.text: O Jehovah, you will hear my voice in the morning; In the morning I will express my concern to you and wait expectantly.

13980.label: Psalms 5:4
13980.text: For you are not a God who takes pleasure in wickedness; No one bad may remain with you.

13981.label: Psalms 5:5
13981.text: No arrogant person may stand in your presence. You hate all those who behave wickedly;

13982.label: Psalms 5:6
13982.text: You will destroy those who speak lies. Jehovah detests violent and deceptive people.

13983.label: Psalms 5:7
13983.text: But I will come into your house because of your great loyal love; I will bow down toward your holy temple in reverential fear of you.

13984.label: Psalms 5:8
13984.text: Lead me, O Jehovah, in your righteousness because of my foes;Make your way clear for me.

13985.label: Psalms 5:9
13985.text: For nothing they say can be trusted;Within them is nothing but malice;Their throat is an open grave;They flatter with their tongue.

13986.label: Psalms 5:10
13986.text: But God will declare them guilty;Their own schemes will cause their downfall. May they be driven away because of their many transgressions,For they have rebelled against you.

13987.label: Psalms 5:11
13987.text: But all those who take refuge in you will rejoice; They will always shout joyfully. You will block approach to them,And those loving your name will rejoice in you.

13988.label: Psalms 5:12
13988.text: For you will bless anyone righteous, O Jehovah;You will surround them with approval as with a large shield.

13990.label: Psalms 6:1
13990.text: O Jehovah, do not reprove me in your anger,And do not correct me in your rage.

13991.label: Psalms 6:2
13991.text: Show me favor, O Jehovah, for I am growing weak. Heal me, O Jehovah, for my bones are shaking.

13992.label: Psalms 6:3
13992.text: Yes, I am greatly disturbed, And I ask you, O Jehovah—how long will it be?

13993.label: Psalms 6:4
13993.text: Return, O Jehovah, and rescue me; Save me for the sake of your loyal love.

13994.label: Psalms 6:5
13994.text: For in death there is no mention of you;In the Grave, who will praise you?

13995.label: Psalms 6:6
13995.text: I have grown weary with my sighing; All night long I soak my bed with tears; I flood my couch with weeping.

13996.label: Psalms 6:7
13996.text: My eye is weak from my grief; It has dimmed because of all those harassing me.

13997.label: Psalms 6:8
13997.text: Get away from me, all you who behave wickedly,For Jehovah will hear the sound of my weeping.

13998.label: Psalms 6:9
13998.text: Jehovah will hear my request for favor; Jehovah will accept my prayer.

13999.label: Psalms 6:10
13999.text: All my enemies will be put to shame and dismayed;They will fall back in sudden disgrace.

14001.label: Psalms 7:1
14001.text: O Jehovah my God, in you I have taken refuge. Save me from all those persecuting me and rescue me.

14002.label: Psalms 7:2
14002.text: Otherwise they will tear me to pieces as a lion does, Carrying me off with no one to rescue me.

14003.label: Psalms 7:3
14003.text: O Jehovah my God, if I am at fault in this,If I have acted unjustly,

14004.label: Psalms 7:4
14004.text: If I have wronged the one doing good to me, Or if I have plundered my enemy without cause,

14005.label: Psalms 7:5
14005.text: Then let an enemy pursue and overtake me; Let him trample my life down to the earthAnd cause my glory to perish in the dust. (Selah)

14006.label: Psalms 7:6
14006.text: Rise up in your anger, O Jehovah;Stand up against the fury of my enemies; Awake for me, and demand that justice be done.

14007.label: Psalms 7:7
14007.text: Let the nations surround you;And you will act against them from on high.

14008.label: Psalms 7:8
14008.text: Jehovah will pass sentence on the peoples. Judge me, O Jehovah, according to my righteousnessAnd according to my integrity.

14009.label: Psalms 7:9
14009.text: Please put an end to the evil deeds of the wicked. But establish the righteous, Since you are the righteous God who examines the hearts and the deepest emotions.

14010.label: Psalms 7:10
14010.text: God is my shield, the Savior of those upright in heart.

14011.label: Psalms 7:11
14011.text: God is a righteous Judge, And God proclaims his judgments every day.

14012.label: Psalms 7:12
14012.text: If anyone will not repent, He sharpens his sword; He bends his bow and makes it ready.

14013.label: Psalms 7:13
14013.text: He prepares his deadly weapons;He makes ready his flaming arrows.

14014.label: Psalms 7:14
14014.text: Look at the one who is pregnant with wickedness;He conceives trouble and gives birth to lies.

14015.label: Psalms 7:15
14015.text: He excavates a pit and digs it deep,But he falls into the very hole he made.

14016.label: Psalms 7:16
14016.text: The trouble he causes will return on his own head; His violence will fall on the crown of his head.

14017.label: Psalms 7:17
14017.text: I will praise Jehovah for his justice; I will sing praises to the name of Jehovah the Most High.

14019.label: Psalms 8:1
14019.text: O Jehovah our Lord, how majestic your name is throughout the earth;You have set your splendor even higher than the heavens!

14020.label: Psalms 8:2
14020.text: Out of the mouth of children and infants you have established strengthOn account of your adversaries,To silence the enemy and the avenger.

14021.label: Psalms 8:3
14021.text: When I see your heavens, the works of your fingers,The moon and the stars that you have prepared,

14022.label: Psalms 8:4
14022.text: What is mortal man that you keep him in mind,And a son of man that you take care of him?

14023.label: Psalms 8:5
14023.text: You made him a little lower than godlike ones, And you crowned him with glory and splendor.

14024.label: Psalms 8:6
14024.text: You gave him dominion over the works of your hands; You have put everything under his feet:

14025.label: Psalms 8:7
14025.text: All the flocks and cattle,As well as the wild animals,

14026.label: Psalms 8:8
14026.text: The birds of the heavens and the fish of the sea,Whatever passes through the paths of the seas.

14027.label: Psalms 8:9
14027.text: O Jehovah our Lord, how majestic your name is throughout the earth!

14029.label: Psalms 9:1
14029.text: I will praise you, O Jehovah, with all my heart;I will tell about all your wonderful works.

14030.label: Psalms 9:2
14030.text: I will rejoice and exult in you;I will sing praises to your name, O Most High.

14031.label: Psalms 9:3
14031.text: When my enemies retreat, They will stumble and perish from before you.

14032.label: Psalms 9:4
14032.text: For you defend my just cause;You sit on your throne judging with righteousness.

14033.label: Psalms 9:5
14033.text: You have rebuked nations and destroyed the wicked,Blotting out their name forever and ever.

14034.label: Psalms 9:6
14034.text: The enemy has been ruined forever;You uprooted their cities,And all memory of them will perish.

14035.label: Psalms 9:7
14035.text: But Jehovah is enthroned forever; He has firmly established his throne for justice.

14036.label: Psalms 9:8
14036.text: He will judge the inhabited earth in righteousness; He will render righteous legal decisions for the nations.

14037.label: Psalms 9:9
14037.text: Jehovah will become a secure refuge for the oppressed, A secure refuge in times of distress.

14038.label: Psalms 9:10
14038.text: Those knowing your name will trust in you; You will never abandon those seeking you, O Jehovah.

14039.label: Psalms 9:11
14039.text: Sing praises to Jehovah, who is dwelling in Zion;Make his deeds known among the peoples.

14040.label: Psalms 9:12
14040.text: For the One who avenges their blood remembers them; He will not forget the cry of the afflicted.

14041.label: Psalms 9:13
14041.text: Show me favor, O Jehovah; see my affliction by those hating me,You who raise me from the gates of death,

14042.label: Psalms 9:14
14042.text: So that I may declare your praiseworthy deeds in the gates of the daughter of Zion, And rejoice in your acts of salvation.

14043.label: Psalms 9:15
14043.text: The nations have sunk down into the pit they made;Their own foot has been caught in the net they hid.

14044.label: Psalms 9:16
14044.text: Jehovah is known by the judgment he executes. The wicked one has been ensnared in the work of his own hands. Hig·gaʹion. (Selah)

14045.label: Psalms 9:17
14045.text: The wicked will retreat toward the Grave, All the nations who forget God.

14046.label: Psalms 9:18
14046.text: But the poor will not always be forgotten; Nor will the hope of the meek ever perish.

14047.label: Psalms 9:19
14047.text: Rise up, O Jehovah! Do not let mortal man prevail. May the nations be judged in your presence.

14048.label: Psalms 9:20
14048.text: Strike them with fear, O Jehovah, Let the nations know that they are only mortal men. (Selah)

14049.label: Psalms 10:1
14049.text: Why, O Jehovah, do you stand at a distance? Why do you hide yourself in times of distress?

14050.label: Psalms 10:2
14050.text: The wicked one arrogantly pursues the helpless one, But he will be caught in the schemes he devises.

14051.label: Psalms 10:3
14051.text: For the wicked one boasts about his selfish desires And blesses the greedy one; נ [Nun]He disrespects Jehovah.

14052.label: Psalms 10:4
14052.text: In his haughtiness, the wicked man makes no investigation;All his thoughts are: “There is no God.”

14053.label: Psalms 10:5
14053.text: His ways keep prospering, But your judgments are beyond his understanding; He scoffs at all his adversaries.

14054.label: Psalms 10:6
14054.text: He says in his heart: “I will never be shaken; For generation after generationI will never see calamity.”

14055.label: Psalms 10:7
14055.text: His mouth is full of curses, lies, and threats; Under his tongue are trouble and injury.

14056.label: Psalms 10:8
14056.text: He waits in ambush near the settlements;From his hiding place he kills an innocent one. ע [Ayin] His eyes are watching for an unfortunate victim.

14057.label: Psalms 10:9
14057.text: He waits in his hiding place like a lion in its lair. He waits to seize the helpless one. He seizes the helpless one when he pulls his net shut.

14058.label: Psalms 10:10
14058.text: The victim is crushed and brought down;The unfortunate ones fall into his clutches.

14059.label: Psalms 10:11
14059.text: He says in his heart: “God has forgotten. He has turned away his face. He never notices.”

14060.label: Psalms 10:12
14060.text: Rise up, O Jehovah. O God, lift up your hand. Do not forget the helpless ones.

14061.label: Psalms 10:13
14061.text: Why has the wicked one disrespected God? He says in his heart: “You will not hold me accountable.”

14062.label: Psalms 10:14
14062.text: But you do see trouble and distress. You look on and take matters in hand. To you the unfortunate victim turns; You are the helper for the fatherless child.

14063.label: Psalms 10:15
14063.text: Break the arm of the wicked and evil man, So that when you search for his wickedness,You will find it no more.

14064.label: Psalms 10:16
14064.text: Jehovah is King forever and ever. The nations have perished from the earth.

14065.label: Psalms 10:17
14065.text: But you will hear the request of the meek, O Jehovah. You will make their hearts firm and pay close attention to them.

14066.label: Psalms 10:18
14066.text: You will render justice to the fatherless and to those who are crushed, So that mortal man of the earth may no longer make them afraid.

14068.label: Psalms 11:1
14068.text: In Jehovah I have taken refuge. So how can you say to me: “Flee like a bird to your mountain!

14069.label: Psalms 11:2
14069.text: See how the wicked bend the bow;They set their arrow on the bowstring,To shoot from the darkness those upright in heart.

14070.label: Psalms 11:3
14070.text: When the foundations are torn down,What can the righteous do?”

14071.label: Psalms 11:4
14071.text: Jehovah is in his holy temple. Jehovah’s throne is in the heavens. His own eyes see, his watchful eyes examine the sons of men.

14072.label: Psalms 11:5
14072.text: Jehovah examines the righteous one as well as the wicked one; He hates anyone who loves violence.

14073.label: Psalms 11:6
14073.text: Upon the wicked, he will rain down snares; Fire and sulfur and a scorching wind will be the portion of their cup.

14074.label: Psalms 11:7
14074.text: For Jehovah is righteous; he loves righteous acts. The upright will see his face.

14076.label: Psalms 12:1
14076.text: Save me, O Jehovah, for the loyal one is no more;Faithful people have vanished from among men.

14077.label: Psalms 12:2
14077.text: They speak lies to one another;They flatter with their lips and speak with deceitful hearts.

14078.label: Psalms 12:3
14078.text: Jehovah will cut off all flattering lipsAnd the tongue that makes great boasts,

14079.label: Psalms 12:4
14079.text: Those who say: “We will prevail with our tongues. We use our lips as we please;Who will be our master?”

14080.label: Psalms 12:5
14080.text: “Because the afflicted are oppressed,Because of the sighing of the poor, I will rise up to act,” says Jehovah. “I will save them from those who treat them with contempt.”

14081.label: Psalms 12:6
14081.text: The sayings of Jehovah are pure; They are like silver refined in an earthen furnace, purified seven times.

14082.label: Psalms 12:7
14082.text: You will guard them, O Jehovah; You will protect each one of them from this generation forever.

14083.label: Psalms 12:8
14083.text: The wicked walk around unrestrainedBecause the sons of men promote depravity.

14085.label: Psalms 13:1
14085.text: How long, O Jehovah, will you forget me? Forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

14086.label: Psalms 13:2
14086.text: How long will I have anxious concern,With grief in my heart each day? How long will my enemy triumph over me?

14087.label: Psalms 13:3
14087.text: Look upon me and answer me, O Jehovah my God. Give light to my eyes, so that I may not fall asleep in death,

14088.label: Psalms 13:4
14088.text: So that my enemy will not say: “I have defeated him!” Do not let my opponents rejoice over my downfall.

14089.label: Psalms 13:5
14089.text: As for me, I trust in your loyal love; My heart will rejoice in your acts of salvation.

14090.label: Psalms 13:6
14090.text: I will sing to Jehovah, for he has richly rewarded me.

14092.label: Psalms 14:1
14092.text: The foolish one says in his heart: “There is no Jehovah.” Their actions are corrupt, and their dealings are detestable;No one is doing good.

14093.label: Psalms 14:2
14093.text: But Jehovah looks down from heaven on the sons of menTo see whether anyone has insight, whether anyone is seeking Jehovah.

14094.label: Psalms 14:3
14094.text: They have all turned aside; They are all alike corrupt. No one is doing good,Not even one.

14095.label: Psalms 14:4
14095.text: Do none of the wrongdoers understand? They devour my people as if they were eating bread. They do not call on Jehovah.

14096.label: Psalms 14:5
14096.text: But they will be filled with great terror, For Jehovah is with the generation of the righteous.

14097.label: Psalms 14:6
14097.text: You wrongdoers try to frustrate the plans of the lowly one,But Jehovah is his refuge.

14098.label: Psalms 14:7
14098.text: O that Israel’s salvation may come from Zion! When Jehovah gathers back his captive people,Let Jacob be joyful, let Israel rejoice.

14100.label: Psalms 15:1
14100.text: O Jehovah, who may be a guest in your tent? Who may reside in your holy mountain?

14101.label: Psalms 15:2
14101.text: The one who is walking faultlessly, Practicing what is right And speaking the truth in his heart.

14102.label: Psalms 15:3
14102.text: He does not slander with his tongue, He does nothing bad to his neighbor, And he does not defame his friends.

14103.label: Psalms 15:4
14103.text: He rejects anyone who is contemptible, But he honors those fearing Jehovah. He does not go back on his promise, even when it is bad for him.

14104.label: Psalms 15:5
14104.text: He does not lend his money on interest, And he does not accept a bribe against the innocent. Whoever does these things will never be shaken.

14106.label: Psalms 16:1
14106.text: Protect me, O God, for I have taken refuge in you.

14107.label: Psalms 16:2
14107.text: I have said to Jehovah: “You are Jehovah, my Source of goodness.

14108.label: Psalms 16:3
14108.text: And the holy ones in the earth,The majestic ones, bring me great delight.”

14109.label: Psalms 16:4
14109.text: Those who pursue other gods multiply their sorrows. I will never pour out their drink offerings of blood,Nor will my lips mention their names.

14110.label: Psalms 16:5
14110.text: Jehovah is my portion, my allotted share, and my cup. You safeguard my inheritance.

14111.label: Psalms 16:6
14111.text: Pleasant places have been measured out to me. Yes, I am content with my inheritance.

14112.label: Psalms 16:7
14112.text: I will praise Jehovah, who has given me advice. Even during the night, my innermost thoughts correct me.

14113.label: Psalms 16:8
14113.text: I keep Jehovah before me constantly. Because he is at my right hand, I will never be shaken.

14114.label: Psalms 16:9
14114.text: So my heart rejoices, my whole being is joyful. And I reside in security.

14115.label: Psalms 16:10
14115.text: For you will not leave me in the Grave. You will not allow your loyal one to see the pit.

14116.label: Psalms 16:11
14116.text: You make known to me the path of life. In your presence is abundant joy; There is happiness at your right hand forever.

14118.label: Psalms 17:1
14118.text: Hear my plea for justice, O Jehovah;Pay attention to my cry for help;Listen to my prayer spoken without deceit.

14119.label: Psalms 17:2
14119.text: May you make a just decision in my behalf; May your eyes see what is right.

14120.label: Psalms 17:3
14120.text: You have examined my heart, you have inspected me by night; You have refined me; You will find that I have not schemed anything bad,And my mouth has not transgressed.

14121.label: Psalms 17:4
14121.text: As for the activities of men,In accord with the word of your lips, I avoid the paths of the robber.

14122.label: Psalms 17:5
14122.text: Let my steps stay on your tracksSo that my feet will not stumble.

14123.label: Psalms 17:6
14123.text: I do call on you, because you will answer me, O God. Incline your ear to me. Hear my words.

14124.label: Psalms 17:7
14124.text: Show your loyal love in a wonderful way, O Savior of those seeking refuge at your right handFrom those who rebel against you.

14125.label: Psalms 17:8
14125.text: Guard me like the pupil of your eye; Conceal me in the shadow of your wings.

14126.label: Psalms 17:9
14126.text: Guard me from the wicked who attack me,From my mortal enemies who surround me.

14127.label: Psalms 17:10
14127.text: They have become insensitive; With their mouth they speak arrogantly;

14128.label: Psalms 17:11
14128.text: Now they hem us in; They watch for the chance to cause our downfall.

14129.label: Psalms 17:12
14129.text: He is like a lion eager to tear its prey to pieces,Like a young lion crouching in ambush.

14130.label: Psalms 17:13
14130.text: Rise up, O Jehovah, to confront him and bring him down;Rescue me from the wicked with your sword;

14131.label: Psalms 17:14
14131.text: Rescue me with your hand, O Jehovah,From men of this world, whose share is in this life, Those whom you fill with the good things you provide And who leave an inheritance to their many sons.

14132.label: Psalms 17:15
14132.text: But as for me, in righteousness I will see your face;I am satisfied to awaken in your presence.

14134.label: Psalms 18:1
14134.text: I have affection for you, O Jehovah, my strength.

14135.label: Psalms 18:2
14135.text: Jehovah is my crag and my stronghold and the One who rescues me. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge,My shield and my horn of salvation, my secure refuge.

14136.label: Psalms 18:3
14136.text: I call on Jehovah, who is worthy of praise,And I will be saved from my enemies.

14137.label: Psalms 18:4
14137.text: The ropes of death encircled me; Flash floods of worthless men terrified me.

14138.label: Psalms 18:5
14138.text: The ropes of the Grave surrounded me;The snares of death confronted me.

14139.label: Psalms 18:6
14139.text: In my distress I called on Jehovah,To my God I kept crying for help. From his temple he heard my voice, And my cry to him for help reached his ears.

14140.label: Psalms 18:7
14140.text: Then the earth began to shake and rock; The foundations of the mountains trembledAnd shook back and forth because he had been angered.

14141.label: Psalms 18:8
14141.text: Smoke ascended from his nostrils,And a consuming fire came from his mouth; Glowing coals blazed from him.

14142.label: Psalms 18:9
14142.text: He made the heavens bend as he descended, And thick gloom was beneath his feet.

14143.label: Psalms 18:10
14143.text: He rode on a cherub and came flying. He swooped down on the wings of a spirit.

14144.label: Psalms 18:11
14144.text: He then covered himself in darkness, All around him as a shelter,Dark waters and thick clouds.

14145.label: Psalms 18:12
14145.text: From the brightness before himHail and fiery coals broke through the clouds.

14146.label: Psalms 18:13
14146.text: Then Jehovah began to thunder in the heavens; The Most High made his voice heard With hailstones and fiery coals.

14147.label: Psalms 18:14
14147.text: He shot his arrows and scattered them; He hurled his lightning and threw them into confusion.

14148.label: Psalms 18:15
14148.text: The streambeds became visible; The foundations of the land were exposed by your rebuke, O Jehovah,By the blast of the breath from your nostrils.

14149.label: Psalms 18:16
14149.text: He reached down from on high;He took hold of me and pulled me from deep waters.

14150.label: Psalms 18:17
14150.text: He rescued me from my strong enemy, From those hating me, who were stronger than I was.

14151.label: Psalms 18:18
14151.text: They confronted me on the day of my disaster, But Jehovah was my support.

14152.label: Psalms 18:19
14152.text: He brought me out into a place of safety; He rescued me because he was pleased with me.

14153.label: Psalms 18:20
14153.text: Jehovah rewards me according to my righteousness; He repays me according to the innocence of my hands.

14154.label: Psalms 18:21
14154.text: For I have kept the ways of Jehovah,And I have not wickedly abandoned my God.

14155.label: Psalms 18:22
14155.text: All his judgments are before me;I will not disregard his statutes.

14156.label: Psalms 18:23
14156.text: I will remain blameless before him, And I will keep myself from error.

14157.label: Psalms 18:24
14157.text: May Jehovah repay me according to my righteousness, According to the innocence of my hands before him.

14158.label: Psalms 18:25
14158.text: With someone loyal you act in loyalty; With the blameless man you deal blamelessly;

14159.label: Psalms 18:26
14159.text: With the pure you show yourself pure, But with the crooked you show yourself shrewd.

14160.label: Psalms 18:27
14160.text: For you save those who are lowly But you abase the haughty.

14161.label: Psalms 18:28
14161.text: For it is you who light my lamp, O Jehovah,My God who lights up my darkness.

14162.label: Psalms 18:29
14162.text: With your help I can charge against a marauder band; By God’s power I can scale a wall.

14163.label: Psalms 18:30
14163.text: The way of the true God is perfect; The saying of Jehovah is refined. He is a shield to all those taking refuge in him.

14164.label: Psalms 18:31
14164.text: For who is a God besides Jehovah? And who is a rock except our God?

14165.label: Psalms 18:32
14165.text: The true God is the one who clothes me with strength, And he will make my way perfect.

14166.label: Psalms 18:33
14166.text: He makes my feet like those of a deer;He makes me stand on high places.

14167.label: Psalms 18:34
14167.text: He trains my hands for warfare;My arms can bend a bow of copper.

14168.label: Psalms 18:35
14168.text: You give me your shield of salvation, Your right hand supports me,And your humility makes me great.

14169.label: Psalms 18:36
14169.text: You widen the path for my footsteps;My feet will not slip.

14170.label: Psalms 18:37
14170.text: I will pursue my enemies and overtake them;I will not return until they are wiped out.

14171.label: Psalms 18:38
14171.text: I will crush them so that they cannot rise up; They will fall under my feet.

14172.label: Psalms 18:39
14172.text: You will equip me with strength for the battle;You will make my foes collapse under me.

14173.label: Psalms 18:40
14173.text: You will make my enemies retreat from me, And I will put an end to those who hate me.

14174.label: Psalms 18:41
14174.text: They cry for help, but there is no one to save them;They even cry to Jehovah, but he does not answer them.

14175.label: Psalms 18:42
14175.text: I will pound them as fine as dust in the wind;I will throw them out like mud in the streets.

14176.label: Psalms 18:43
14176.text: You will rescue me from the faultfinding of the people. You will appoint me the head of nations. A people whom I have not known will serve me.

14177.label: Psalms 18:44
14177.text: At a mere report they will obey me;Foreigners will come cringing before me.

14178.label: Psalms 18:45
14178.text: Foreigners will lose courage; They will come trembling from their strongholds.

14179.label: Psalms 18:46
14179.text: Jehovah is alive! Praised be my Rock! Let the God of my salvation be exalted.

14180.label: Psalms 18:47
14180.text: The true God executes vengeance for me; He subdues the peoples under me.

14181.label: Psalms 18:48
14181.text: He rescues me from my angry enemies;You lift me high above those who attack me; You save me from the man of violence.

14182.label: Psalms 18:49
14182.text: That is why I will glorify you among the nations, O Jehovah, And to your name I will sing praises.

14183.label: Psalms 18:50
14183.text: He performs great acts of salvation for his king; He displays loyal love to his anointed one, To David and his offspring forever.

14185.label: Psalms 19:1
14185.text: The heavens are declaring the glory of God; The skies above proclaim the work of his hands.

14186.label: Psalms 19:2
14186.text: Day after day their speech bubbles forth,And night after night they reveal knowledge.

14187.label: Psalms 19:3
14187.text: There is no speech, and there are no words;Their voice is not heard.

14188.label: Psalms 19:4
14188.text: But into all the earth their sound has gone out,And to the ends of the inhabited earth their message. In the heavens he has pitched a tent for the sun;

14189.label: Psalms 19:5
14189.text: It is like a bridegroom emerging from the bridal chamber;It rejoices like a mighty man running his course.

14190.label: Psalms 19:6
14190.text: It emerges from one end of the heavens,And it circles to their other end; And nothing is concealed from its heat.

14191.label: Psalms 19:7
14191.text: The law of Jehovah is perfect, restoring strength. The reminder of Jehovah is trustworthy, making the inexperienced one wise.

14192.label: Psalms 19:8
14192.text: The orders from Jehovah are righteous, causing the heart to rejoice; The commandment of Jehovah is clean, making the eyes shine.

14193.label: Psalms 19:9
14193.text: The fear of Jehovah is pure, lasting forever. The judgments of Jehovah are true, altogether righteous.

14194.label: Psalms 19:10
14194.text: They are more desirable than gold,Than much fine gold, And sweeter than honey, the honey that drips from the combs.

14195.label: Psalms 19:11
14195.text: By them your servant has been warned; In keeping them, there is a large reward.

14196.label: Psalms 19:12
14196.text: Who can discern mistakes? Pronounce me innocent from sins I am unaware of.

14197.label: Psalms 19:13
14197.text: And hold your servant back from presumptuous acts; Do not let them dominate me. Then I will be complete, And innocent of blatant sins.

14198.label: Psalms 19:14
14198.text: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heartBe pleasing to you, O Jehovah, my Rock and my Redeemer.

14200.label: Psalms 20:1
14200.text: May Jehovah answer you in the day of distress. May the name of the God of Jacob protect you.

14201.label: Psalms 20:2
14201.text: May he send you help from the holy place And sustain you from Zion.

14202.label: Psalms 20:3
14202.text: May he remember all your gift offerings;May he accept with favor your burnt offering. (Selah)

14203.label: Psalms 20:4
14203.text: May he grant you the desires of your heart And give success to all your plans.

14204.label: Psalms 20:5
14204.text: We will shout joyfully over your acts of salvation; We will lift our banners in the name of our God. May Jehovah fulfill all your requests.

14205.label: Psalms 20:6
14205.text: Now I do know that Jehovah saves his anointed one. He answers him from his holy heavensWith great salvation by his right hand.

14206.label: Psalms 20:7
14206.text: Some rely on chariots and others on horses, But we call on the name of Jehovah our God.

14207.label: Psalms 20:8
14207.text: They have collapsed and fallen,But we have risen up and been restored.

14208.label: Psalms 20:9
14208.text: O Jehovah, save the king! He will answer us in the day we call for help.

14210.label: Psalms 21:1
14210.text: O Jehovah, in your strength the king rejoices; How greatly he rejoices in your acts of salvation!

14211.label: Psalms 21:2
14211.text: You have granted him the desire of his heart, And you have not withheld the request of his lips. (Selah)

14212.label: Psalms 21:3
14212.text: For you meet him with rich blessings;You place a crown of fine gold on his head.

14213.label: Psalms 21:4
14213.text: He asked you for life, and you gave it to him, A long life, forever and ever.

14214.label: Psalms 21:5
14214.text: Your acts of salvation bring him great glory. Dignity and splendor you bestow on him.

14215.label: Psalms 21:6
14215.text: You make him blessed forever; You make him glad with the joy of your presence.

14216.label: Psalms 21:7
14216.text: For the king trusts in Jehovah; Because of the loyal love of the Most High, he will never be shaken.

14217.label: Psalms 21:8
14217.text: Your hand will find all your enemies;Your right hand will find those hating you.

14218.label: Psalms 21:9
14218.text: You will make them like a fiery furnace at the appointed time when you give them attention. Jehovah will swallow them up in his anger, and fire will consume them.

14219.label: Psalms 21:10
14219.text: Their descendants you will destroy from the earth,And their offspring from the sons of men.

14220.label: Psalms 21:11
14220.text: For they intended to do what is bad against you; They have devised schemes that will not succeed.

14221.label: Psalms 21:12
14221.text: For you will make them retreat By aiming your bow at them.

14222.label: Psalms 21:13
14222.text: Rise up, O Jehovah, in your strength. We will sing praises to your mightiness.

14224.label: Psalms 22:1
14224.text: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you far from saving me,Far from my cries of anguish?

14225.label: Psalms 22:2
14225.text: My God, I keep calling by day, and you do not answer; And by night there is no silence on my part.

14226.label: Psalms 22:3
14226.text: But you are holy, Surrounded by the praises of Israel.

14227.label: Psalms 22:4
14227.text: In you our fathers put their trust; They trusted, and you kept rescuing them.

14228.label: Psalms 22:5
14228.text: To you they cried out, and they were saved;They trusted in you, and they were not disappointed.

14229.label: Psalms 22:6
14229.text: But I am a worm and not a man,Scorned by men and despised by the people.

14230.label: Psalms 22:7
14230.text: All those seeing me mock me; They sneer and shake their heads in derision:

14231.label: Psalms 22:8
14231.text: “He entrusted himself to Jehovah. Let Him rescue him! Let Him save him, for he is so dear to Him!”

14232.label: Psalms 22:9
14232.text: You were the One who brought me out of the womb, The One who made me feel secure on my mother’s breasts.

14233.label: Psalms 22:10
14233.text: I have been entrusted to your care from birth;From my mother’s womb, you have been my God.

14234.label: Psalms 22:11
14234.text: Do not stay far off from me, for trouble is near And I have no other helper.

14235.label: Psalms 22:12
14235.text: Many young bulls surround me; Powerful bulls of Baʹshan encircle me.

14236.label: Psalms 22:13
14236.text: They open their mouth wide against me, Like a roaring lion that tears its prey to pieces.

14237.label: Psalms 22:14
14237.text: I am poured out like water;All my bones are out of joint. My heart has become like wax; It melts deep within me.

14238.label: Psalms 22:15
14238.text: My strength has dried up like a piece of pottery; My tongue sticks to my gums; You are bringing me down to the dust of death.

14239.label: Psalms 22:16
14239.text: For dogs surround me; They close in on me like a pack of evildoers, Like a lion they are at my hands and feet.

14240.label: Psalms 22:17
14240.text: I can count all my bones. They look on and stare at me.

14241.label: Psalms 22:18
14241.text: They divide my garments among themselves,And they cast lots for my clothing.

14242.label: Psalms 22:19
14242.text: But you, O Jehovah, do not remain far away. You are my strength; hurry to help me.

14243.label: Psalms 22:20
14243.text: Save me from the sword,My precious life from the paws of dogs;

14244.label: Psalms 22:21
14244.text: Save me from the mouth of the lion and the horns of wild bulls;Answer and save me.

14245.label: Psalms 22:22
14245.text: I will declare your name to my brothers; In the midst of the congregation I will praise you.

14246.label: Psalms 22:23
14246.text: You who fear Jehovah, praise him! All you offspring of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you offspring of Israel.

14247.label: Psalms 22:24
14247.text: For he has not despised nor loathed the suffering of the oppressed one; He has not hidden his face from him. When he cried to him for help, he heard.

14248.label: Psalms 22:25
14248.text: I will praise you in the large congregation; I will pay my vows before those who fear him.

14249.label: Psalms 22:26
14249.text: The meek will eat and be satisfied; Those seeking Jehovah will praise him. May you enjoy life forever.

14250.label: Psalms 22:27
14250.text: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to Jehovah. All the families of the nations will bow down before you.

14251.label: Psalms 22:28
14251.text: For the kingship belongs to Jehovah; He rules over the nations.

14252.label: Psalms 22:29
14252.text: All the prosperous ones of the earth will eat and will bow down;All those going down to the dust will kneel before him;None of them can preserve their lives.

14253.label: Psalms 22:30
14253.text: Their descendants will serve him;The generation to come will be told about Jehovah.

14254.label: Psalms 22:31
14254.text: They will come and tell of his righteousness. They will tell the people yet to be born what he has done.

14256.label: Psalms 23:1
14256.text: Jehovah is my Shepherd. I will lack nothing.

14257.label: Psalms 23:2
14257.text: In grassy pastures he makes me lie down;He leads me to well-watered resting-places.

14258.label: Psalms 23:3
14258.text: He refreshes me. He leads me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of his name.

14259.label: Psalms 23:4
14259.text: Though I walk in the valley of deep shadow, I fear no harm, For you are with me; Your rod and your staff reassure me.

14260.label: Psalms 23:5
14260.text: You prepare a table for me before my enemies. You refresh my head with oil; My cup is well-filled.

14261.label: Psalms 23:6
14261.text: Surely goodness and loyal love will pursue me all the days of my life, And I will dwell in the house of Jehovah for all my days.

14263.label: Psalms 24:1
14263.text: To Jehovah belong the earth and everything in it, The productive land and those dwelling on it.

14264.label: Psalms 24:2
14264.text: For he has solidly fixed it on the seas And firmly established it on the rivers.

14265.label: Psalms 24:3
14265.text: Who may ascend to the mountain of Jehovah, And who may stand up in his holy place?

14266.label: Psalms 24:4
14266.text: Anyone with innocent hands and a pure heart, Who has not sworn a false oath by My life, Nor taken an oath deceitfully.

14267.label: Psalms 24:5
14267.text: He will receive blessings from Jehovah And righteousness from his God of salvation.

14268.label: Psalms 24:6
14268.text: This is the generation of those seeking him,Of those seeking your face, O God of Jacob. (Selah)

14269.label: Psalms 24:7
14269.text: Lift up your heads, you gates; Open up, you ancient doorways,That the glorious King may enter!

14270.label: Psalms 24:8
14270.text: Who is this glorious King? Jehovah, strong and mighty, Jehovah, mighty in battle.

14271.label: Psalms 24:9
14271.text: Lift up your heads, you gates; Open up, you ancient doorways,That the glorious King may enter!

14272.label: Psalms 24:10
14272.text: Who is he, this glorious King? Jehovah of armies—he is the glorious King. (Selah)

14274.label: Psalms 25:1
14274.text: To you, O Jehovah, I turn.

14275.label: Psalms 25:2
14275.text: My God, I trust in you; Do not let me be put to shame. Do not let my enemies gloat over me.

14276.label: Psalms 25:3
14276.text: Surely none who hope in you will be put to shame, But shame awaits those who are treacherous without cause.

14277.label: Psalms 25:4
14277.text: Make me know your ways, O Jehovah; Teach me your paths.

14278.label: Psalms 25:5
14278.text: Cause me to walk in your truth and teach me, For you are my God of salvation. ו [Waw] In you I hope all day long.

14279.label: Psalms 25:6
14279.text: Remember your mercy, O Jehovah, and your loyal love, Which you have always shown.

14280.label: Psalms 25:7
14280.text: Do not remember the sins of my youth and my transgressions. Remember me according to your loyal love, For the sake of your goodness, O Jehovah.

14281.label: Psalms 25:8
14281.text: Good and upright is Jehovah. That is why he instructs sinners in the way to live.

14282.label: Psalms 25:9
14282.text: He will guide the meek in what is right, And he will teach the meek ones his way.

14283.label: Psalms 25:10
14283.text: All the paths of Jehovah are loyal love and faithfulnessFor those observing his covenant and his reminders.

14284.label: Psalms 25:11
14284.text: For the sake of your name, O Jehovah, Forgive my error, though it is great.

14285.label: Psalms 25:12
14285.text: Who is the man fearing Jehovah? He will instruct him about the way he should choose.

14286.label: Psalms 25:13
14286.text: He will experience what is good, And his descendants will take possession of the earth.

14287.label: Psalms 25:14
14287.text: Close friendship with Jehovah belongs to those who fear him, And he makes his covenant known to them.

14288.label: Psalms 25:15
14288.text: My eyes are always toward Jehovah, For he will free my feet from the net.

14289.label: Psalms 25:16
14289.text: Turn your face to me and show me favor,For I am alone and helpless.

14290.label: Psalms 25:17
14290.text: The distresses of my heart have multiplied; Free me from my anguish.

14291.label: Psalms 25:18
14291.text: See my affliction and my trouble, And pardon all my sins.

14292.label: Psalms 25:19
14292.text: See how numerous my enemies areAnd how violent their hatred is for me.

14293.label: Psalms 25:20
14293.text: Guard my life and save me. Do not let me be put to shame, for I have taken refuge in you.

14294.label: Psalms 25:21
14294.text: May integrity and uprightness safeguard me, For my hope is in you.

14295.label: Psalms 25:22
14295.text: O God, rescue Israel out of all his distresses.

14297.label: Psalms 26:1
14297.text: Judge me, O Jehovah, for I have walked in my integrity; In Jehovah I have trusted without wavering.

14298.label: Psalms 26:2
14298.text: Examine me, O Jehovah, and put me to the test;Refine my innermost thoughts and my heart.

14299.label: Psalms 26:3
14299.text: For your loyal love is always in front of me,And I walk in your truth.

14300.label: Psalms 26:4
14300.text: I do not associate with deceitful men, And I avoid those who hide what they are.

14301.label: Psalms 26:5
14301.text: I hate the company of evil men, And I refuse to associate with the wicked.

14302.label: Psalms 26:6
14302.text: I will wash my hands in innocence,And I will march around your altar, O Jehovah,

14303.label: Psalms 26:7
14303.text: To cause the sound of thanksgiving to be heard And to declare all your wonderful works.

14304.label: Psalms 26:8
14304.text: Jehovah, I love the house where you dwell, The place where your glory resides.

14305.label: Psalms 26:9
14305.text: Do not sweep me away with sinners Nor take my life away with violent men,

14306.label: Psalms 26:10
14306.text: Whose hands engage in shameful conduct,And whose right hand is full of bribes.

14307.label: Psalms 26:11
14307.text: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Rescue me and show me favor.

14308.label: Psalms 26:12
14308.text: My foot is standing on level ground; In the great congregation, I will praise Jehovah.

14310.label: Psalms 27:1
14310.text: Jehovah is my light and my salvation. Whom should I fear? Jehovah is the stronghold of my life. Whom should I dread?

14311.label: Psalms 27:2
14311.text: When evil men attacked me to devour my flesh, My adversaries and my enemies were the ones who stumbled and fell.

14312.label: Psalms 27:3
14312.text: Though an army should set up camp against me,My heart will not fear. Though war should break out against me,Even then I will remain confident.

14313.label: Psalms 27:4
14313.text: One thing I have asked from Jehovah—It is what I will look for—That I may dwell in the house of Jehovah all the days of my life, To gaze upon the pleasantness of JehovahAnd to look with appreciation upon his temple.

14314.label: Psalms 27:5
14314.text: For he will hide me in his shelter on the day of calamity; He will conceal me in the secret place of his tent; High on a rock he will place me.

14315.label: Psalms 27:6
14315.text: Now my head is high above my enemies who surround me;I will offer sacrifices at his tent with joyful shouting;I will sing praises to Jehovah.

14316.label: Psalms 27:7
14316.text: Hear me, O Jehovah, when I cry out; Show me favor and answer me.

14317.label: Psalms 27:8
14317.text: Speaking for you, my heart has said: “Seek to find my face.” Your face, O Jehovah, I will seek to find.

14318.label: Psalms 27:9
14318.text: Do not hide your face from me. Do not turn your servant away in your anger. You are my helper; Do not forsake me or leave me, my God of salvation.

14319.label: Psalms 27:10
14319.text: Even if my own father and mother abandon me, Jehovah himself will take me in.

14320.label: Psalms 27:11
14320.text: Instruct me in your way, O Jehovah, Lead me in the path of uprightness because of my foes.

14321.label: Psalms 27:12
14321.text: Do not hand me over to my adversaries, For false witnesses have risen up against me, And they threaten me with violence.

14322.label: Psalms 27:13
14322.text: Where would I be if I did not have faithThat I would see Jehovah’s goodness in the land of the living?

14323.label: Psalms 27:14
14323.text: Hope in Jehovah; Be courageous and strong of heart. Yes, hope in Jehovah.

14325.label: Psalms 28:1
14325.text: To you I keep calling, O Jehovah my Rock; Do not turn a deaf ear to me. If you keep silent toward me,I will become like those going down to the pit.

14326.label: Psalms 28:2
14326.text: Hear my pleas when I cry to you for helpAs I lift up my hands toward the innermost room of your sanctuary.

14327.label: Psalms 28:3
14327.text: Do not drag me away with the wicked, with those practicing what is hurtful, Those who are speaking words of peace with their fellow man while evil is in their hearts.

14328.label: Psalms 28:4
14328.text: Pay them back for their deeds, According to their evil practices. Repay them for the work of their hands,According to what they have done.

14329.label: Psalms 28:5
14329.text: For they pay no attention to the activities of Jehovah, Nor to the work of his hands. He will tear them down and not build them up.

14330.label: Psalms 28:6
14330.text: May Jehovah be praised,For he has heard my pleas for help.

14331.label: Psalms 28:7
14331.text: Jehovah is my strength and my shield; In him my heart trusts. I have received his help, and my heart rejoices,So I will praise him with my song.

14332.label: Psalms 28:8
14332.text: Jehovah is a strength for his people;He is a stronghold, bringing grand salvation to his anointed one.

14333.label: Psalms 28:9
14333.text: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Shepherd them and carry them in your arms forever.

14335.label: Psalms 29:1
14335.text: Give Jehovah his due, you sons of mighty ones,Give Jehovah his due for his glory and strength.

14336.label: Psalms 29:2
14336.text: Give Jehovah the glory due his name. Bow down to Jehovah in holy adornment.

14337.label: Psalms 29:3
14337.text: The voice of Jehovah is heard over the waters;The glorious God thunders. Jehovah is over many waters.

14338.label: Psalms 29:4
14338.text: The voice of Jehovah is powerful; The voice of Jehovah is splendid.

14339.label: Psalms 29:5
14339.text: The voice of Jehovah is breaking the cedars;Yes, Jehovah shatters the cedars of Lebʹa·non.

14340.label: Psalms 29:6
14340.text: He makes Lebʹa·non skip like a calf,And Sirʹi·on like a young wild bull.

14341.label: Psalms 29:7
14341.text: The voice of Jehovah strikes with flames of fire;

14342.label: Psalms 29:8
14342.text: The voice of Jehovah makes the wilderness shudder; Jehovah makes the wilderness of Kaʹdesh shudder.

14343.label: Psalms 29:9
14343.text: The voice of Jehovah makes the deer shudder and give birthAnd strips bare the forests. And all in his temple say: “Glory!”

14344.label: Psalms 29:10
14344.text: Jehovah sits enthroned above the flooding waters; Jehovah sits enthroned as King forever.

14345.label: Psalms 29:11
14345.text: Jehovah will give strength to his people. Jehovah will bless his people with peace.

14347.label: Psalms 30:1
14347.text: I will exalt you, O Jehovah, for you have lifted me up;You did not let my enemies rejoice over me.

14348.label: Psalms 30:2
14348.text: O Jehovah my God, I cried to you for help, and you healed me.

14349.label: Psalms 30:3
14349.text: O Jehovah, you have lifted me up from the Grave. You kept me alive; you spared me from sinking into the pit.

14350.label: Psalms 30:4
14350.text: Sing praises to Jehovah, you his loyal ones, Give thanks to his holy name;

14351.label: Psalms 30:5
14351.text: Because being under his anger is only for a moment, But being in his favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may come in the evening, but in the morning, there is a joyful cry.

14352.label: Psalms 30:6
14352.text: When I was untroubled, I said: “I will never be shaken.”

14353.label: Psalms 30:7
14353.text: O Jehovah, while I was in your favor, you made me as strong as a mountain. But when you hid your face, I became terrified.

14354.label: Psalms 30:8
14354.text: To you, O Jehovah, I kept calling; And to Jehovah, I kept pleading for favor.

14355.label: Psalms 30:9
14355.text: What profit is there in my death, in my going down to the pit? Will the dust praise you? Will it tell of your faithfulness?

14356.label: Psalms 30:10
14356.text: Hear, O Jehovah, and show me favor. O Jehovah, become my helper.

14357.label: Psalms 30:11
14357.text: You have changed my mourning into dancing;You have removed my sackcloth, and you clothe me with rejoicing,

14358.label: Psalms 30:12
14358.text: So that I may sing your praise and not keep silent. O Jehovah my God, I will praise you forever.

14360.label: Psalms 31:1
14360.text: In you, O Jehovah, I have taken refuge. May I never be put to shame. Rescue me because of your righteousness.

14361.label: Psalms 31:2
14361.text: Incline your ear to me. Come quickly to my rescue. Become for me a mountain stronghold,A fortified place to save me.

14362.label: Psalms 31:3
14362.text: For you are my crag and my stronghold; For the sake of your name, you will lead me and guide me.

14363.label: Psalms 31:4
14363.text: You will free me from the net that they have secretly laid for me, For you are my fortress.

14364.label: Psalms 31:5
14364.text: Into your hand I entrust my spirit. You have redeemed me, O Jehovah, the God of truth.

14365.label: Psalms 31:6
14365.text: I hate those who are devoted to worthless, vain idols,But as for me, I trust in Jehovah.

14366.label: Psalms 31:7
14366.text: I will rejoice greatly in your loyal love,For you have seen my affliction; You are aware of my deep distress.

14367.label: Psalms 31:8
14367.text: You have not handed me over to the enemy,But you make me stand in a place of safety.

14368.label: Psalms 31:9
14368.text: Show me favor, O Jehovah, for I am in distress. Anguish has made my eyes weak, my whole body as well.

14369.label: Psalms 31:10
14369.text: My life is consumed with grief And my years with groaning. My strength is waning because of my error;My bones grow weak.

14370.label: Psalms 31:11
14370.text: I am scorned by all my adversaries, Especially my neighbors. And I am dreaded by my acquaintances;When they see me in public, they flee from me.

14371.label: Psalms 31:12
14371.text: I am put out of their heart and forgotten, as if I were dead;I am like a broken jar.

14372.label: Psalms 31:13
14372.text: I have heard many evil rumors;Terror surrounds me. When they gather together as one against me,They scheme to take away my life.

14373.label: Psalms 31:14
14373.text: But I trust in you, O Jehovah. I declare: “You are my God.”

14374.label: Psalms 31:15
14374.text: My days are in your hand. Rescue me from the hand of my enemies and from those persecuting me.

14375.label: Psalms 31:16
14375.text: Make your face shine upon your servant. Save me by your loyal love.

14376.label: Psalms 31:17
14376.text: O Jehovah, may I not be put to shame when I call on you. May the wicked be put to shame; May they be silenced in the Grave.

14377.label: Psalms 31:18
14377.text: May lying lips become speechless, Lips that speak arrogantly against the righteous, with haughtiness and contempt.

14378.label: Psalms 31:19
14378.text: How abundant your goodness is! You have stored it up for those who fear you, And you have shown it before all men, in behalf of those taking refuge in you.

14379.label: Psalms 31:20
14379.text: You will conceal them in the secret place of your presence From the schemes of men;You will hide them in your shelterFrom malicious attacks.

14380.label: Psalms 31:21
14380.text: May Jehovah be praised,For in a wonderful way, he has shown his loyal love to me in a besieged city.

14381.label: Psalms 31:22
14381.text: As for me, I panicked and said: “I will perish from before you.” But you heard my pleas for help when I cried out to you.

14382.label: Psalms 31:23
14382.text: Love Jehovah, all you who are loyal to him! Jehovah protects the faithful, But he repays exceedingly anyone showing haughtiness.

14383.label: Psalms 31:24
14383.text: Be courageous, and may your heart be strong, All you who are waiting for Jehovah.

14385.label: Psalms 32:1
14385.text: Happy is the one whose transgression is pardoned, whose sin is covered.

14386.label: Psalms 32:2
14386.text: Happy is the man whom Jehovah does not charge with guilt, In whose spirit there is no deceit.

14387.label: Psalms 32:3
14387.text: When I kept silent, my bones wasted away because of my groaning all day long.

14388.label: Psalms 32:4
14388.text: For day and night your hand was heavy upon me. My strength evaporated like water in the dry summer heat. (Selah)

14389.label: Psalms 32:5
14389.text: Finally I confessed my sin to you;I did not cover my error. I said: “I will confess my transgressions to Jehovah.” And you pardoned the error of my sins. (Selah)

14390.label: Psalms 32:6
14390.text: This is why every loyal one will pray to you While you may yet be found. Then even the floodwaters will not reach him.

14391.label: Psalms 32:7
14391.text: You are a hiding place for me;You will safeguard me from distress. You will surround me with joyful shouts of deliverance. (Selah)

14392.label: Psalms 32:8
14392.text: “I will give you insight and instruct you in the way you should go. I will give you advice with my eye upon you.

14393.label: Psalms 32:9
14393.text: Do not become like a horse or a mule, without understanding, Whose spiritedness must be controlled with a bridle or a halterBefore it will come near to you.”

14394.label: Psalms 32:10
14394.text: Many are the pains of the wicked;But the one trusting in Jehovah is surrounded by His loyal love.

14395.label: Psalms 32:11
14395.text: Rejoice in Jehovah and be joyful, you righteous ones;Shout joyfully, all you who are upright in heart.

14396.label: Psalms 33:1
14396.text: Shout joyfully, you righteous ones, because of Jehovah. It is fitting for the upright to praise him.

14397.label: Psalms 33:2
14397.text: Give thanks to Jehovah with the harp;Sing praises to him with a ten-stringed instrument.

14398.label: Psalms 33:3
14398.text: Sing to him a new song; Play skillfully on the strings, along with shouts of joy.

14399.label: Psalms 33:4
14399.text: For the word of Jehovah is upright, And everything he does is trustworthy.

14400.label: Psalms 33:5
14400.text: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is filled with Jehovah’s loyal love.

14401.label: Psalms 33:6
14401.text: By the word of Jehovah the heavens were made, And by the spirit of his mouth everything in them.

14402.label: Psalms 33:7
14402.text: He gathers the seawaters like a dam; He puts the surging waters in storehouses.

14403.label: Psalms 33:8
14403.text: Let the whole earth fear Jehovah. Let the inhabitants of the productive land be in awe of him.

14404.label: Psalms 33:9
14404.text: For he spoke, and it came to be; He commanded, and it stood firm.

14405.label: Psalms 33:10
14405.text: Jehovah has frustrated the schemes of the nations; He has thwarted the plans of the peoples.

14406.label: Psalms 33:11
14406.text: But the decisions of Jehovah will stand forever; The thoughts of his heart are from generation to generation.

14407.label: Psalms 33:12
14407.text: Happy is the nation whose God is Jehovah, The people he has chosen as his own possession.

14408.label: Psalms 33:13
14408.text: Jehovah looks down from heaven;He sees all the sons of men.

14409.label: Psalms 33:14
14409.text: From his place of residence,He gazes on the inhabitants of the earth.

14410.label: Psalms 33:15
14410.text: He is the one forming the hearts of all;He examines all their works.

14411.label: Psalms 33:16
14411.text: No king is saved by a large army; A mighty man is not saved by his great power.

14412.label: Psalms 33:17
14412.text: The horse is a false hope for salvation; Its great strength does not ensure escape.

14413.label: Psalms 33:18
14413.text: Look! The eye of Jehovah watches over those fearing him, Those waiting for his loyal love,

14414.label: Psalms 33:19
14414.text: To rescue them from deathAnd to keep them alive during famine.

14415.label: Psalms 33:20
14415.text: We are in expectation of Jehovah. He is our helper and our shield.

14416.label: Psalms 33:21
14416.text: Our hearts rejoice in him,For we trust in his holy name.

14417.label: Psalms 33:22
14417.text: May your loyal love rest upon us, O Jehovah, While we keep waiting for you.

14419.label: Psalms 34:1
14419.text: I will praise Jehovah at all times;His praise will be on my lips constantly.

14420.label: Psalms 34:2
14420.text: I will boast in Jehovah; The meek will hear and rejoice.

14421.label: Psalms 34:3
14421.text: Magnify Jehovah along with me; Let us exalt his name together.

14422.label: Psalms 34:4
14422.text: I inquired of Jehovah, and he answered me. He rescued me from all my fears.

14423.label: Psalms 34:5
14423.text: Those who looked to him became radiant;Their faces could not be put to shame.

14424.label: Psalms 34:6
14424.text: This lowly one called, and Jehovah heard. He saved him from all his distresses.

14425.label: Psalms 34:7
14425.text: The angel of Jehovah camps all around those fearing Him, And he rescues them.

14426.label: Psalms 34:8
14426.text: Taste and see that Jehovah is good; Happy is the man who takes refuge in him.

14427.label: Psalms 34:9
14427.text: Fear Jehovah, all you his holy ones,For those who fear him lack nothing.

14428.label: Psalms 34:10
14428.text: Even strong young lions have been reduced to hunger,But those seeking Jehovah will lack nothing good.

14429.label: Psalms 34:11
14429.text: Come, my sons, listen to me;I will teach you the fear of Jehovah.

14430.label: Psalms 34:12
14430.text: Who among you takes pleasure in lifeAnd would love to see many good days?

14431.label: Psalms 34:13
14431.text: Then guard your tongue from what is bad, Your lips from speaking deception.

14432.label: Psalms 34:14
14432.text: Turn away from what is bad and do what is good; Seek peace and pursue it.

14433.label: Psalms 34:15
14433.text: The eyes of Jehovah are on the righteous, And his ears listen to their cry for help.

14434.label: Psalms 34:16
14434.text: But the face of Jehovah is against those doing what is bad,To erase all memory of them from the earth.

14435.label: Psalms 34:17
14435.text: They cried out, and Jehovah heard; He rescued them from all their distresses.

14436.label: Psalms 34:18
14436.text: Jehovah is close to the brokenhearted; He saves those who are crushed in spirit.

14437.label: Psalms 34:19
14437.text: Many are the hardships of the righteous one, But Jehovah rescues him from them all.

14438.label: Psalms 34:20
14438.text: He is guarding all his bones;Not one of them has been broken.

14439.label: Psalms 34:21
14439.text: Disaster will put the wicked to death;Those hating the righteous will be found guilty.

14440.label: Psalms 34:22
14440.text: Jehovah is redeeming the life of his servants;None of those taking refuge in him will be found guilty.

14442.label: Psalms 35:1
14442.text: O Jehovah, defend my case against my opposers; Fight against those who fight against me.

14443.label: Psalms 35:2
14443.text: Take up your buckler and large shield, And rise up to my defense.

14444.label: Psalms 35:3
14444.text: Lift up your spear and battle-ax against my pursuers. Say to me: “I am your salvation.”

14445.label: Psalms 35:4
14445.text: May those who are hunting for my life be put to shame and humiliated. May those who are plotting to destroy me retreat in disgrace.

14446.label: Psalms 35:5
14446.text: May they become like chaff in the wind;May Jehovah’s angel drive them away.

14447.label: Psalms 35:6
14447.text: May their path be dark and slipperyAs Jehovah’s angel pursues them.

14448.label: Psalms 35:7
14448.text: For without cause they have hidden a net to trap me;Without cause they have dug a pit for me.

14449.label: Psalms 35:8
14449.text: May disaster come upon him by surprise;May the net that he hid catch him;May he fall into it and be destroyed.

14450.label: Psalms 35:9
14450.text: But I will rejoice in Jehovah;I will be joyful in his acts of salvation.

14451.label: Psalms 35:10
14451.text: All my bones will say: “O Jehovah, who is like you? You rescue the helpless from those who are stronger, The helpless and the poor from those who rob them.”

14452.label: Psalms 35:11
14452.text: Malicious witnesses come forward, Asking me things I know nothing about.

14453.label: Psalms 35:12
14453.text: They repay me with bad for good, Making me feel bereaved.

14454.label: Psalms 35:13
14454.text: But when they were ill, I clothed myself with sackcloth;I afflicted myself by fasting,And when my prayer would return unanswered,

14455.label: Psalms 35:14
14455.text: I walked about mourning as for a friend or a brother of mine;I bowed down in sorrow, like one mourning for his mother.

14456.label: Psalms 35:15
14456.text: But when I stumbled, they rejoiced and gathered together;They gathered together to strike me down in ambush;They tore me to pieces and did not keep silent.

14457.label: Psalms 35:16
14457.text: The ungodly scornfully mock me, They grind their teeth against me.

14458.label: Psalms 35:17
14458.text: O Jehovah, how long will you just look on? Rescue me from their attacks, My precious life from the young lions.

14459.label: Psalms 35:18
14459.text: Then I will give thanks to you in the great congregation; I will praise you among the throngs of people.

14460.label: Psalms 35:19
14460.text: Do not let those who for no reason are my enemies gloat over me;Do not let those hating me without cause wink their eyes maliciously.

14461.label: Psalms 35:20
14461.text: For they do not speak words of peace,But they deceptively scheme against the peaceful ones of the land.

14462.label: Psalms 35:21
14462.text: They open their mouth wide to accuse me,Saying: “Aha! Aha! Our eyes have seen it.”

14463.label: Psalms 35:22
14463.text: You have seen this, O Jehovah. Do not remain silent. O Jehovah, do not stay far from me.

14464.label: Psalms 35:23
14464.text: Awake and rise to my defense,My God, Jehovah, defend me in my legal case.

14465.label: Psalms 35:24
14465.text: Judge me according to your righteousness, O Jehovah my God;Do not let them gloat over me.

14466.label: Psalms 35:25
14466.text: May they never say to themselves: “Aha! We got what we wanted.” May they never say: “We have swallowed him up.”

14467.label: Psalms 35:26
14467.text: Let all of them be put to shame and disgraced,Those who gloat over my calamity. Let those who exalt themselves over me be clothed with shame and humiliation.

14468.label: Psalms 35:27
14468.text: But let those who take pleasure in my righteousness shout joyfully;May they constantly say: “May Jehovah be magnified, who takes pleasure in the peace of his servant.”

14469.label: Psalms 35:28
14469.text: Then my tongue will recount your righteousness And praise you all day long.

14471.label: Psalms 36:1
14471.text: Transgression speaks to the wicked one deep within his heart;There is no fear of God before his eyes.

14472.label: Psalms 36:2
14472.text: For in his own eyes he flatters himself too muchTo detect and hate his error.

14473.label: Psalms 36:3
14473.text: The words of his mouth are hurtful and deceptive;He shows no insight for doing what is good.

14474.label: Psalms 36:4
14474.text: He plots hurtful schemes even on his bed. He is set on a path that is not good;He does not reject what is bad.

14475.label: Psalms 36:5
14475.text: O Jehovah, your loyal love reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness up to the clouds.

14476.label: Psalms 36:6
14476.text: Your righteousness is like majestic mountains; Your judgments are like vast, deep waters. Man and beast you preserve, O Jehovah.

14477.label: Psalms 36:7
14477.text: How precious your loyal love is, O God! In the shadow of your wings, the sons of men take refuge.

14478.label: Psalms 36:8
14478.text: They drink their fill of the rich bounty of your house, And you cause them to drink of the torrent of your delights.

14479.label: Psalms 36:9
14479.text: With you is the source of life; By your light we can see light.

14480.label: Psalms 36:10
14480.text: Continue showing your loyal love to those who know you, And your righteousness, to the upright in heart.

14481.label: Psalms 36:11
14481.text: Do not let the foot of the haughty tread on meOr the hand of the wicked drive me away.

14482.label: Psalms 36:12
14482.text: There the wrongdoers have fallen;They have been knocked down and cannot get up.

14484.label: Psalms 37:1
14484.text: Do not be upset because of evil menOr envious of wrongdoers.

14485.label: Psalms 37:2
14485.text: They will quickly wither like grass And shrivel like green new grass.

14486.label: Psalms 37:3
14486.text: Trust in Jehovah and do what is good; Reside in the earth, and act with faithfulness.

14487.label: Psalms 37:4
14487.text: Find exquisite delight in Jehovah,And he will grant you the desires of your heart.

14488.label: Psalms 37:5
14488.text: Commit your way to Jehovah; Rely on him, and he will act in your behalf.

14489.label: Psalms 37:6
14489.text: He will make your righteousness shine like daybreak,And your justice like the midday sun.

14490.label: Psalms 37:7
14490.text: Keep silent before Jehovah And wait expectantly for him. Do not be upset by the manWho succeeds in carrying out his schemes.

14491.label: Psalms 37:8
14491.text: Let go of anger and abandon rage; Do not become upset and turn to doing evil.

14492.label: Psalms 37:9
14492.text: For evil men will be done away with, But those hoping in Jehovah will possess the earth.

14493.label: Psalms 37:10
14493.text: Just a little while longer, and the wicked will be no more; You will look at where they were,And they will not be there.

14494.label: Psalms 37:11
14494.text: But the meek will possess the earth, And they will find exquisite delight in the abundance of peace.

14495.label: Psalms 37:12
14495.text: The wicked man plots against the righteous; He grinds his teeth at him.

14496.label: Psalms 37:13
14496.text: But Jehovah will laugh at him,For He knows that his day will come.

14497.label: Psalms 37:14
14497.text: The wicked draw their swords and bend their bowsTo bring down the oppressed and the poor,To slaughter those whose way is upright.

14498.label: Psalms 37:15
14498.text: But their sword will pierce their own heart; Their bows will be broken.

14499.label: Psalms 37:16
14499.text: Better is the little of the righteous oneThan the abundance of many wicked ones.

14500.label: Psalms 37:17
14500.text: For the arms of the wicked will be broken,But Jehovah will support the righteous.

14501.label: Psalms 37:18
14501.text: Jehovah is aware of what the blameless go through, And their inheritance will last forever.

14502.label: Psalms 37:19
14502.text: They will not be put to shame in the time of disaster;In the time of famine they will have plenty.

14503.label: Psalms 37:20
14503.text: But the wicked will perish; The enemies of Jehovah will vanish like glorious pastures;They will vanish like smoke.

14504.label: Psalms 37:21
14504.text: The wicked one borrows and does not repay,But the righteous one is generous and giving.

14505.label: Psalms 37:22
14505.text: Those blessed by Him will possess the earth,But those cursed by Him will be done away with.

14506.label: Psalms 37:23
14506.text: Jehovah guides the steps of a man When He finds pleasure in his way.

14507.label: Psalms 37:24
14507.text: Although he may fall, he will not be hurled down, For Jehovah supports him by the hand.

14508.label: Psalms 37:25
14508.text: I was once young and now I am old,But I have not seen anyone righteous abandoned, Nor his children looking for bread.

14509.label: Psalms 37:26
14509.text: He always lends freely, And his children are in line for a blessing.

14510.label: Psalms 37:27
14510.text: Turn away from bad and do what is good, And you will remain forever.

14511.label: Psalms 37:28
14511.text: For Jehovah loves justice,And he will not abandon his loyal ones. ע [Ayin] They will always be guarded; But the descendants of the wicked will be done away with.

14512.label: Psalms 37:29
14512.text: The righteous will possess the earth, And they will live forever on it.

14513.label: Psalms 37:30
14513.text: The mouth of the righteous one imparts wisdom, And his tongue speaks about justice.

14514.label: Psalms 37:31
14514.text: The law of his God is in his heart; His steps will not falter.

14515.label: Psalms 37:32
14515.text: The wicked watches the righteous,Seeking to put him to death.

14516.label: Psalms 37:33
14516.text: But Jehovah will not abandon him to the hand of that one Or find him guilty when he is judged.

14517.label: Psalms 37:34
14517.text: Hope in Jehovah and follow his way,And he will exalt you to take possession of the earth. When the wicked are done away with, you will see it.

14518.label: Psalms 37:35
14518.text: I have seen the ruthless, evil manSpreading out like a luxuriant tree in its native soil.

14519.label: Psalms 37:36
14519.text: But he suddenly passed away and was gone; I kept searching for him, and he could not be found.

14520.label: Psalms 37:37
14520.text: Take note of the blameless one, And keep the upright one in sight,For the future of that man will be peaceful.

14521.label: Psalms 37:38
14521.text: But all the transgressors will be destroyed;The future of wicked people will be cut off.

14522.label: Psalms 37:39
14522.text: The salvation of the righteous is from Jehovah; He is their fortress in the time of distress.

14523.label: Psalms 37:40
14523.text: Jehovah will help them and rescue them. He will rescue them from the wicked and save them,Because they take refuge in him.

14525.label: Psalms 38:1
14525.text: O Jehovah, do not reprove me in your anger,Nor correct me in your wrath.

14526.label: Psalms 38:2
14526.text: For your arrows have pierced deep into me,And your hand presses down on me.

14527.label: Psalms 38:3
14527.text: My whole body is sick because of your indignation. There is no peace within my bones because of my sin.

14528.label: Psalms 38:4
14528.text: For my errors loom over my head; Like a heavy burden, they are too much for me to bear.

14529.label: Psalms 38:5
14529.text: My wounds stink and festerBecause of my foolishness.

14530.label: Psalms 38:6
14530.text: I am distressed and extremely downcast;I walk around sad all day long.

14531.label: Psalms 38:7
14531.text: There is a burning within me; My whole body is sick.

14532.label: Psalms 38:8
14532.text: I have grown numb and become completely crushed;My anguished heart makes me groan aloud.

14533.label: Psalms 38:9
14533.text: O Jehovah, all my desires are before you,And my sighing is not hidden from you.

14534.label: Psalms 38:10
14534.text: My heart pounds, my strength is gone,And the light of my eyes has left me.

14535.label: Psalms 38:11
14535.text: My friends and my companions avoid me because of my plague,And my close acquaintances keep their distance.

14536.label: Psalms 38:12
14536.text: Those seeking my life set traps;Those trying to harm me speak of ruin; They mutter deception all day long.

14537.label: Psalms 38:13
14537.text: But like someone deaf, I would not listen; Like someone speechless, I would not open my mouth.

14538.label: Psalms 38:14
14538.text: I have become like a man who cannot hear,Whose mouth has nothing to say in defense.

14539.label: Psalms 38:15
14539.text: For on you, O Jehovah, I waited, And you answered me, O Jehovah my God.

14540.label: Psalms 38:16
14540.text: For I said: “May they not gloat over meOr exalt themselves over me if my foot slips.”

14541.label: Psalms 38:17
14541.text: For I was ready to collapse,And my pain was always with me.

14542.label: Psalms 38:18
14542.text: I confessed my error; I was troubled by my sin.

14543.label: Psalms 38:19
14543.text: But my enemies are vigorous and mighty, Those hating me for no reason have become numerous.

14544.label: Psalms 38:20
14544.text: They repaid me with bad for good;They were resisting me for pursuing what is good.

14545.label: Psalms 38:21
14545.text: Do not abandon me, O Jehovah. O God, do not remain far away from me.

14546.label: Psalms 38:22
14546.text: Do hurry to help me,O Jehovah, my salvation.

14548.label: Psalms 39:1
14548.text: I said: “I will guard my stepTo avoid sinning with my tongue. I will guard my mouth with a muzzle As long as anyone wicked is in my presence.”

14549.label: Psalms 39:2
14549.text: I was speechless and silent; I kept quiet even about what is good,But my pain was intense.

14550.label: Psalms 39:3
14550.text: My heart smoldered inside me. As I pondered, the fire kept burning. Then my tongue spoke:

14551.label: Psalms 39:4
14551.text: “O Jehovah, help me to know what my end will be,And the measure of my days, So that I may know how short my life is.

14552.label: Psalms 39:5
14552.text: Indeed, you have made my days just a few; And my life span is as nothing before you. Surely every man, though he seems secure, is nothing but a mere breath. (Selah)

14553.label: Psalms 39:6
14553.text: Surely every man walks about like a shadow. He rushes around for nothing. He piles up wealth, not knowing who will enjoy it.

14554.label: Psalms 39:7
14554.text: What, then, can I hope for, O Jehovah? You are my only hope.

14555.label: Psalms 39:8
14555.text: Save me from all my transgressions. Do not let the foolish one make me an object of contempt.

14556.label: Psalms 39:9
14556.text: I remained speechless;I could not open my mouth, Because this was your doing.

14557.label: Psalms 39:10
14557.text: Remove your plague from me. I am worn down because your hand strikes me.

14558.label: Psalms 39:11
14558.text: You correct man with punishment for his error; You consume the things he treasures just as a moth does. Surely every man is but a mere breath. (Selah)

14559.label: Psalms 39:12
14559.text: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah,Listen to my cry for help. Do not ignore my tears. For I am but a foreign resident to you, A traveler passing through, just like all my forefathers.

14560.label: Psalms 39:13
14560.text: Turn your harsh gaze away from me so that I may cheer upBefore I pass away and I am gone.”

14562.label: Psalms 40:1
14562.text: I earnestly hoped in Jehovah,And he inclined his ear to me and heard my cry for help.

14563.label: Psalms 40:2
14563.text: He brought me up out of a roaring pit,Out of the slimy mire. And he set my feet upon a crag;He made my footing secure.

14564.label: Psalms 40:3
14564.text: Then he put a new song in my mouth, Praise to our God. Many will look on in aweAnd put their trust in Jehovah.

14565.label: Psalms 40:4
14565.text: Happy is the man who trusts in JehovahAnd who does not look to the defiant or to those who are false.

14566.label: Psalms 40:5
14566.text: How many things you have done,O Jehovah my God,Your wonderful works and your thoughts toward us. None can compare to you; If I were to try to tell and speak of them,They would be too numerous to recount!

14567.label: Psalms 40:6
14567.text: Sacrifice and offering you did not desire, But you opened up my ears to hear. You did not ask for burnt offerings and sin offerings.

14568.label: Psalms 40:7
14568.text: Then I said: “Look, I have come. In the scroll it is written about me.

14569.label: Psalms 40:8
14569.text: To do your will, O my God, is my delight, And your law is deep within me.

14570.label: Psalms 40:9
14570.text: I proclaim the good news of righteousness in the great congregation. Look! I do not restrain my lips, O Jehovah, as you well know.

14571.label: Psalms 40:10
14571.text: I do not cover over your righteousness in my heart. I declare your faithfulness and salvation. I do not hide your loyal love and your truth in the great congregation.”
