14572.label: Psalms 40:11
14572.text: O Jehovah, do not withhold your mercy from me. May your loyal love and your truth constantly safeguard me.

14573.label: Psalms 40:12
14573.text: The calamities surrounding me are too many to count. So many of my errors overwhelm me that I cannot see my way; They are more numerous than the hairs of my head,And I have lost heart.

14574.label: Psalms 40:13
14574.text: Please be willing, O Jehovah, to save me. O Jehovah, hurry to help me.

14575.label: Psalms 40:14
14575.text: May all those seeking to take my life Be put to shame and disgraced. May those who delight in my calamityRetreat in humiliation.

14576.label: Psalms 40:15
14576.text: May those who are saying to me: “Aha! Aha!” Be appalled because of their own shame.

14577.label: Psalms 40:16
14577.text: But let those seeking you Exult and rejoice in you. May those who love your acts of salvation always say: “May Jehovah be magnified.”

14578.label: Psalms 40:17
14578.text: But I am helpless and poor;May Jehovah pay attention to me. You are my helper and my rescuer; My God, do not delay.

14580.label: Psalms 41:1
14580.text: Happy is anyone who shows consideration to the lowly one; Jehovah will rescue him in the day of calamity.

14581.label: Psalms 41:2
14581.text: Jehovah will guard him and keep him alive. He will be pronounced happy in the earth; You will never turn him over to the will of his enemies.

14582.label: Psalms 41:3
14582.text: Jehovah will sustain him on his sickbed; During his sickness you will completely change his bed.

14583.label: Psalms 41:4
14583.text: For I said: “O Jehovah, show me favor. Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”

14584.label: Psalms 41:5
14584.text: But my enemies speak evil about me: “When will he die and his name perish?”

14585.label: Psalms 41:6
14585.text: If one of them comes to see me, his heart speaks falsely. He gathers something harmful to say;Then he goes out and spreads it abroad.

14586.label: Psalms 41:7
14586.text: All those who hate me whisper to one another;They are scheming something bad against me:

14587.label: Psalms 41:8
14587.text: “A dreadful thing has overtaken him;Now that he is down, he will not rise again.”

14588.label: Psalms 41:9
14588.text: Even the man at peace with me, one whom I trusted, Who was eating my bread, has lifted his heel against me.

14589.label: Psalms 41:10
14589.text: But you, O Jehovah, show me favor and raise me up,So that I may repay them.

14590.label: Psalms 41:11
14590.text: By this I will know that you are pleased with me: When my enemy cannot shout in triumph over me.

14591.label: Psalms 41:12
14591.text: As for me, you uphold me because of my integrity; You will keep me in your presence forever.

14592.label: Psalms 41:13
14592.text: May Jehovah, the God of Israel, be praisedThroughout all eternity. Amen and Amen.

14594.label: Psalms 42:1
14594.text: As a deer that longs for streams of water,So I long for you, O God.

14595.label: Psalms 42:2
14595.text: I do thirst for God, for the living God. When may I come and appear before God?

14596.label: Psalms 42:3
14596.text: My tears are my food day and night;All day long people taunt me: “Where is your God?”

14597.label: Psalms 42:4
14597.text: These things I remember, and I pour out my soul, For I once walked along with the multitude;I used to walk solemnly before them to the house of God,With sounds of rejoicing and thanksgiving,Those of a crowd celebrating a festival.

14598.label: Psalms 42:5
14598.text: Why am I in despair? Why is this turmoil within me? Wait for God, For I will yet praise him as my Grand Savior.

14599.label: Psalms 42:6
14599.text: My God, I am in despair. That is why I remember you, From the land of Jordan and the peaks of Herʹmon,From Mount Mi·zarʹ.

14600.label: Psalms 42:7
14600.text: Deep waters call to deep watersAt the sound of your waterfalls. All your surging waves have overwhelmed me.

14601.label: Psalms 42:8
14601.text: By day Jehovah will grant me his loyal love,And by night his song will be with me—a prayer to the God of my life.

14602.label: Psalms 42:9
14602.text: I will say to God, my crag: “Why have you forgotten me? Why should I walk about sad because of the oppression by my enemy?”

14603.label: Psalms 42:10
14603.text: With murderous hostility my enemies taunt me;All day long they taunt me: “Where is your God?”

14604.label: Psalms 42:11
14604.text: Why am I in despair? Why is this turmoil within me? Wait for God, For I will yet praise him as my Grand Savior and my God.

14605.label: Psalms 43:1
14605.text: Judge me, O God, Defend my legal case against a disloyal nation. Rescue me from the man of deception and unrighteousness.

14606.label: Psalms 43:2
14606.text: For you are my God, my fortress. Why have you cast me off? Why must I walk about sad because of the oppression by my enemy?

14607.label: Psalms 43:3
14607.text: Send out your light and your truth. May these lead me; May they guide me to your holy mountain and to your grand tabernacle.

14608.label: Psalms 43:4
14608.text: Then I will come to the altar of God, To God, my exceeding joy. And I will praise you with the harp, O God, my God.

14609.label: Psalms 43:5
14609.text: Why am I in despair? Why is this turmoil within me? Wait for God, For I will yet praise him as my Grand Savior and my God.

14611.label: Psalms 44:1
14611.text: O God, we have heard with our own ears,Our forefathers have recounted to us, The deeds you accomplished in their days,In the days of long ago.

14612.label: Psalms 44:2
14612.text: With your hand you drove away nations And settled our forefathers there. You crushed nations and drove them out.

14613.label: Psalms 44:3
14613.text: It was not by their own sword that they took possession of the land, And their own arm did not bring them victory. Rather, it was by your right hand and your arm and the light of your face,For you took pleasure in them.

14614.label: Psalms 44:4
14614.text: You are my King, O God; Command complete victory for Jacob.

14615.label: Psalms 44:5
14615.text: By your power we will drive back our adversaries; In your name we will trample down those who rise up against us.

14616.label: Psalms 44:6
14616.text: For I do not trust in my bow,And my sword cannot save me.

14617.label: Psalms 44:7
14617.text: It was you who saved us from our adversaries, You who humiliated those who hate us.

14618.label: Psalms 44:8
14618.text: To God we will offer praise all day long,And we will give thanks to your name forever. (Selah)

14619.label: Psalms 44:9
14619.text: But now you have cast us off and humiliated us,And you do not go out with our armies.

14620.label: Psalms 44:10
14620.text: You keep making us retreat from our adversary; Those who hate us take whatever they want.

14621.label: Psalms 44:11
14621.text: You hand us over to be devoured like sheep;You have scattered us among the nations.

14622.label: Psalms 44:12
14622.text: You sell your people for next to nothing; You make no profit from the sale.

14623.label: Psalms 44:13
14623.text: You make us a reproach to our neighbors,An object of ridicule and jeering to those all around us.

14624.label: Psalms 44:14
14624.text: You make us an object of scorn among the nations, Something for the peoples to shake their heads at.

14625.label: Psalms 44:15
14625.text: I feel humiliated all day long,And I am overwhelmed by my shame,

14626.label: Psalms 44:16
14626.text: On account of the sound of their taunts and insults,Because of our enemy who is taking revenge.

14627.label: Psalms 44:17
14627.text: All of this has come upon us, yet we have not forgotten you,And we have not violated your covenant.

14628.label: Psalms 44:18
14628.text: Our heart has not deviated;Our footsteps do not stray from your path.

14629.label: Psalms 44:19
14629.text: But you have crushed us where the jackals dwell;You have covered us with deep shadow.

14630.label: Psalms 44:20
14630.text: If we have forgotten the name of our GodOr if we spread out our hands in prayer to a foreign god,

14631.label: Psalms 44:21
14631.text: Will not God discover this? He is aware of the secrets of the heart.

14632.label: Psalms 44:22
14632.text: For your sake we are being put to death all day long;We have been accounted as sheep for slaughtering.

14633.label: Psalms 44:23
14633.text: Rouse yourself. Why do you keep sleeping, O Jehovah? Awake! Do not keep casting us off forever.

14634.label: Psalms 44:24
14634.text: Why do you hide your face? Why do you forget our affliction and our oppression?

14635.label: Psalms 44:25
14635.text: For we have been brought down to the dust;Our bodies are pressed to the ground.

14636.label: Psalms 44:26
14636.text: Rise up as our helper! Rescue us because of your loyal love.

14638.label: Psalms 45:1
14638.text: My heart is stirred by something good. I say: “My song is about a king.” May my tongue be the stylus of a skilled copyist.

14639.label: Psalms 45:2
14639.text: You are the most handsome of the sons of men. Gracious speech flows from your lips. That is why God has blessed you forever.

14640.label: Psalms 45:3
14640.text: Strap your sword on your side, O mighty one, In your dignity and your splendor.

14641.label: Psalms 45:4
14641.text: And in your splendor go on to victory; Ride in the cause of truth and humility and righteousness, And your right hand will accomplish awe-inspiring things.

14642.label: Psalms 45:5
14642.text: Your arrows are sharp, making peoples fall before you; They pierce the hearts of the king’s enemies.

14643.label: Psalms 45:6
14643.text: God is your throne forever and ever; The scepter of your kingdom is a scepter of uprightness.

14644.label: Psalms 45:7
14644.text: You loved righteousness, and you hated wickedness. That is why God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of exultation more than your companions.

14645.label: Psalms 45:8
14645.text: All your garments are scented with myrrh and aloeswood and cassia;From the grand ivory palace, stringed instruments make you rejoice.

14646.label: Psalms 45:9
14646.text: The daughters of kings are among your ladies of honor. The royal consort has taken her stand at your right hand, adorned in gold of Oʹphir.

14647.label: Psalms 45:10
14647.text: Listen, O daughter, pay attention and incline your ear;Forget your people and your father’s house.

14648.label: Psalms 45:11
14648.text: And the king will long for your beauty,For he is your lord,So bow down to him.

14649.label: Psalms 45:12
14649.text: The daughter of Tyre will come with a gift;The wealthiest of men will seek your favor.

14650.label: Psalms 45:13
14650.text: Inside the palace the king’s daughter is absolutely magnificent;Her clothing is adorned with gold.

14651.label: Psalms 45:14
14651.text: She will be brought to the king in richly woven garments. The virgin companions following her are brought in before you.

14652.label: Psalms 45:15
14652.text: They will be brought with rejoicing and joy;They will enter into the king’s palace.

14653.label: Psalms 45:16
14653.text: Your sons will take the place of your forefathers. You will appoint them as princes in all the earth.

14654.label: Psalms 45:17
14654.text: I will make your name known throughout all generations to come. That is why peoples will praise you forever and ever.

14656.label: Psalms 46:1
14656.text: God is our refuge and strength, A help that is readily found in times of distress.

14657.label: Psalms 46:2
14657.text: That is why we will not fear, though the earth undergoes change,Though the mountains topple into the depths of the sea,

14658.label: Psalms 46:3
14658.text: Though its waters roar and foam over, Though the mountains rock on account of its turbulence. (Selah)

14659.label: Psalms 46:4
14659.text: There is a river the streams of which make the city of God rejoice, The holy grand tabernacle of the Most High.

14660.label: Psalms 46:5
14660.text: God is in the city; it cannot be overthrown. God will come to its aid at the break of dawn.

14661.label: Psalms 46:6
14661.text: The nations were in an uproar, the kingdoms were overthrown;He raised his voice, and the earth melted.

14662.label: Psalms 46:7
14662.text: Jehovah of armies is with us; The God of Jacob is our secure refuge. (Selah)

14663.label: Psalms 46:8
14663.text: Come and witness the activities of Jehovah,How he has done astonishing things on the earth.

14664.label: Psalms 46:9
14664.text: He is bringing an end to wars throughout the earth. He breaks the bow and shatters the spear;He burns the military wagons with fire.

14665.label: Psalms 46:10
14665.text: “Give in and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations; I will be exalted in the earth.”

14666.label: Psalms 46:11
14666.text: Jehovah of armies is with us; The God of Jacob is a secure refuge for us. (Selah)

14668.label: Psalms 47:1
14668.text: All you peoples, clap your hands. Shout in triumph to God with joyful cries.

14669.label: Psalms 47:2
14669.text: For Jehovah the Most High is awe-inspiring; He is the great King over all the earth.

14670.label: Psalms 47:3
14670.text: He subdues peoples under us;He puts nations under our feet.

14671.label: Psalms 47:4
14671.text: He chooses our inheritance for us, The pride of Jacob, whom he loves. (Selah)

14672.label: Psalms 47:5
14672.text: God has ascended amid joyful shouting;Jehovah, amid the sound of the horn.

14673.label: Psalms 47:6
14673.text: Sing praises to God, sing praises. Sing praises to our King, sing praises.

14674.label: Psalms 47:7
14674.text: For God is King of all the earth; Sing praises, and show insight.

14675.label: Psalms 47:8
14675.text: God has become King over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.

14676.label: Psalms 47:9
14676.text: The leaders of the peoples have gathered togetherWith the people of the God of Abraham. For the rulers of the earth belong to God. He is highly exalted.

14678.label: Psalms 48:1
14678.text: Jehovah is great and most worthy of praiseIn the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

14679.label: Psalms 48:2
14679.text: Beautiful in its loftiness, the joy of the whole earth, Is Mount Zion in the far north,The city of the Grand King.

14680.label: Psalms 48:3
14680.text: In her fortified towers,God has made known that he is a secure refuge.

14681.label: Psalms 48:4
14681.text: For look! kings have assembled; Together they have advanced.

14682.label: Psalms 48:5
14682.text: When they saw it, they were amazed. They panicked and fled in terror.

14683.label: Psalms 48:6
14683.text: Trembling seized them there,Anguish like that of a woman giving birth.

14684.label: Psalms 48:7
14684.text: With an east wind you wreck the ships of Tarʹshish.

14685.label: Psalms 48:8
14685.text: What we heard about, we have now seen for ourselvesIn the city of Jehovah of armies, in the city of our God. God will firmly establish it forever. (Selah)

14686.label: Psalms 48:9
14686.text: We ponder your loyal love, O God, Within your temple.

14687.label: Psalms 48:10
14687.text: Like your name, O God, your praiseReaches to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is filled with righteousness.

14688.label: Psalms 48:11
14688.text: May Mount Zion rejoice,May the towns of Judah be joyful, because of your judgments.

14689.label: Psalms 48:12
14689.text: March around Zion; go all around it;Count its towers.

14690.label: Psalms 48:13
14690.text: Set your hearts upon its ramparts. Inspect its fortified towers,So that you may tell about it to future generations.

14691.label: Psalms 48:14
14691.text: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will guide us forevermore.

14693.label: Psalms 49:1
14693.text: Hear this, all you peoples. Pay attention, all you inhabitants of the world,

14694.label: Psalms 49:2
14694.text: Both small and great, Rich and poor alike.

14695.label: Psalms 49:3
14695.text: My own mouth will speak wisdom,And the meditation of my heart will show understanding.

14696.label: Psalms 49:4
14696.text: I will pay attention to a proverb;I will expound my riddle with the harp.

14697.label: Psalms 49:5
14697.text: Why should I fear during times of trouble, When I am surrounded by the evil of those trying to overthrow me?

14698.label: Psalms 49:6
14698.text: Those who are trusting in their wealth And who boast about their great riches,

14699.label: Psalms 49:7
14699.text: None of them can ever redeem a brotherOr give to God a ransom for him,

14700.label: Psalms 49:8
14700.text: (The ransom price for their life is so preciousThat it is always beyond their reach);

14701.label: Psalms 49:9
14701.text: That he should live forever and not see the pit.

14702.label: Psalms 49:10
14702.text: He sees that even wise people die;The stupid and the unreasoning perish together, And they must leave their wealth to others.

14703.label: Psalms 49:11
14703.text: Their inner wish is that their houses will last forever,Their tents to generation after generation. They have named their estates after themselves.

14704.label: Psalms 49:12
14704.text: But man, although honored, will not remain; He is no better than the beasts that perish.

14705.label: Psalms 49:13
14705.text: This is the way of the stupid ones And of those who follow them, who take pleasure in their empty words. (Selah)

14706.label: Psalms 49:14
14706.text: They are assigned like sheep to the Grave. Death will shepherd them;The upright will rule over them in the morning. Every trace of them will fade away; The Grave rather than a palace will be their home.

14707.label: Psalms 49:15
14707.text: But God will redeem me from the power of the Grave, For he will take hold of me. (Selah)

14708.label: Psalms 49:16
14708.text: Do not be afraid because a man becomes rich,Because the splendor of his house increases,

14709.label: Psalms 49:17
14709.text: For when he dies he can take nothing with him; His splendor will not go down with him.

14710.label: Psalms 49:18
14710.text: For during his lifetime he congratulates himself. (People praise you when you prosper.)

14711.label: Psalms 49:19
14711.text: But he finally joins the generation of his forefathers. They will never again see the light.

14712.label: Psalms 49:20
14712.text: A man who does not understand this, although honored, Is no better than the beasts that perish.

14714.label: Psalms 50:1
14714.text: The God of gods, Jehovah, has spoken;He summons the earthFrom the rising of the sun until its setting.

14715.label: Psalms 50:2
14715.text: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines forth.

14716.label: Psalms 50:3
14716.text: Our God will come and cannot remain silent. Before him is a consuming fire, And a great storm rages all around him.

14717.label: Psalms 50:4
14717.text: He summons the heavens above and the earth, So as to judge his people:

14718.label: Psalms 50:5
14718.text: “Gather to me my loyal ones,Those making a covenant with me over sacrifice.”

14719.label: Psalms 50:6
14719.text: The heavens proclaim his righteousness,For God himself is Judge. (Selah)

14720.label: Psalms 50:7
14720.text: “Listen, O my people, and I will speak;Israel, I will bear witness against you. I am God, your God.

14721.label: Psalms 50:8
14721.text: I do not reprove you because of your sacrifices,Nor because of your whole burnt offerings that are constantly before me.

14722.label: Psalms 50:9
14722.text: I do not need to take a bull from your house,Nor goats from your pens.

14723.label: Psalms 50:10
14723.text: For every wild animal of the forest is mine, Even the beasts upon a thousand mountains.

14724.label: Psalms 50:11
14724.text: I know every bird of the mountains; The countless animals of the field are mine.

14725.label: Psalms 50:12
14725.text: If I were hungry, I would not tell you,For the productive land and everything in it is mine.

14726.label: Psalms 50:13
14726.text: Will I eat the flesh of bullsAnd drink the blood of goats?

14727.label: Psalms 50:14
14727.text: Offer thanksgiving as your sacrifice to God, And pay your vows to the Most High;

14728.label: Psalms 50:15
14728.text: Call on me in the time of distress. I will rescue you, and you will glorify me.”

14729.label: Psalms 50:16
14729.text: But God will say to the wicked: “What right do you have to relate my regulations Or to speak about my covenant?

14730.label: Psalms 50:17
14730.text: For you hate discipline, And you keep turning your back on my words.

14731.label: Psalms 50:18
14731.text: When you see a thief, you approve of him, And you keep company with adulterers.

14732.label: Psalms 50:19
14732.text: You use your mouth to spread what is bad,And deception is attached to your tongue.

14733.label: Psalms 50:20
14733.text: You sit and speak against your own brother; You reveal the faults of your own mother’s son.

14734.label: Psalms 50:21
14734.text: When you did these things, I remained silent,So you thought that I would be just like you. But now I will reprove you,And I will state my case against you.

14735.label: Psalms 50:22
14735.text: Please consider this, you who forget God, So that I may not tear you to pieces with no one to rescue you.

14736.label: Psalms 50:23
14736.text: The one who offers thanksgiving as his sacrifice glorifies me, And as for the one who follows a set course,I will cause him to see salvation by God.”

14738.label: Psalms 51:1
14738.text: Show me favor, O God, according to your loyal love. Blot out my transgressions according to your great mercy.

14739.label: Psalms 51:2
14739.text: Thoroughly wash me from my error, And cleanse me from my sin.

14740.label: Psalms 51:3
14740.text: For I am well-aware of my transgressions,And my sin is always before me.

14741.label: Psalms 51:4
14741.text: Against you—you above all —I have sinned; What is bad in your eyes I have done. Therefore, you are righteous when you speak,You are right in your judgment.

14742.label: Psalms 51:5
14742.text: Look! I was born guilty of error,And my mother conceived me in sin.

14743.label: Psalms 51:6
14743.text: Look! You find pleasure in truth in the inner person; Teach my innermost self true wisdom.

14744.label: Psalms 51:7
14744.text: Purify me from my sin with hyssop, so that I will be clean; Wash me, so that I will be whiter than snow.

14745.label: Psalms 51:8
14745.text: Let me hear sounds of joy and rejoicing,So that the bones you crushed will rejoice.

14746.label: Psalms 51:9
14746.text: Turn your face away from my sins, And wipe away all my errors.

14747.label: Psalms 51:10
14747.text: Create in me a pure heart, O God, And put within me a new spirit, a steadfast one.

14748.label: Psalms 51:11
14748.text: Do not cast me out from your presence;And do not take your holy spirit away from me.

14749.label: Psalms 51:12
14749.text: Restore to me the joy of your salvation; Stir within me a willingness to obey you.

14750.label: Psalms 51:13
14750.text: I will teach transgressors your ways, So that sinners will return to you.

14751.label: Psalms 51:14
14751.text: Save me from bloodguilt, O God, the God of my salvation, So that my tongue may joyfully declare your righteousness.

14752.label: Psalms 51:15
14752.text: O Jehovah, open my lips,So that my mouth may declare your praise.

14753.label: Psalms 51:16
14753.text: For you do not want a sacrifice—otherwise I would give it; You do not find delight in a whole burnt offering.

14754.label: Psalms 51:17
14754.text: The sacrifices pleasing to God are a broken spirit;A heart broken and crushed, O God, you will not reject.

14755.label: Psalms 51:18
14755.text: In your goodwill do what is good for Zion;Build up the walls of Jerusalem.

14756.label: Psalms 51:19
14756.text: Then you will take delight in the sacrifices of righteousness,The burnt sacrifices and the whole offerings;Then bulls will be offered up on your altar.

14758.label: Psalms 52:1
14758.text: Why do you boast about your evil acts, you mighty one? The loyal love of God lasts all day long.

14759.label: Psalms 52:2
14759.text: Your tongue, as sharp as a razor, Schemes harm and works deceitfully.

14760.label: Psalms 52:3
14760.text: You love evil more than what is good,Lying more than speaking what is right. (Selah)

14761.label: Psalms 52:4
14761.text: You love every harmful word,O you deceitful tongue!

14762.label: Psalms 52:5
14762.text: That is why God will pull you down once and for all; He will snatch you up and tear you away from your tent; He will uproot you from the land of the living. (Selah)

14763.label: Psalms 52:6
14763.text: The righteous ones will see it and be filled with awe, And they will laugh at him.

14764.label: Psalms 52:7
14764.text: “Here is a man who did not make God his refuge, But he trusted in his great riches And relied on his own evil plots.”

14765.label: Psalms 52:8
14765.text: But I will be like a luxuriant olive tree in God’s house;My trust is in God’s loyal love, forever and ever.

14766.label: Psalms 52:9
14766.text: I will praise you forever because you have taken action; In the presence of your loyal ones,I will hope in your name, for it is good.

14768.label: Psalms 53:1
14768.text: The foolish one says in his heart: “There is no Jehovah.” Their unrighteous actions are corrupt and detestable;No one is doing good.

14769.label: Psalms 53:2
14769.text: But God looks down from heaven on the sons of men To see whether anyone has insight, whether anyone is seeking Jehovah.

14770.label: Psalms 53:3
14770.text: They have all turned away;They are all alike corrupt. No one is doing good,Not even one.

14771.label: Psalms 53:4
14771.text: Do none of the wrongdoers understand? They devour my people as if they were eating bread. They do not call on Jehovah.

14772.label: Psalms 53:5
14772.text: But they will be filled with great terror,Terror they have never felt before, For God will scatter the bones of those attacking you. You will put them to shame, for Jehovah has rejected them.

14773.label: Psalms 53:6
14773.text: O that Israel’s salvation may come from Zion! When Jehovah gathers back his captive people,Let Jacob be joyful, let Israel rejoice.

14775.label: Psalms 54:1
14775.text: O God, save me by your name, And defend me with your power.

14776.label: Psalms 54:2
14776.text: O God, hear my prayer; Pay attention to the words of my mouth.

14777.label: Psalms 54:3
14777.text: For strangers rise up against me,And ruthless men seek my life. They have no regard for God. (Selah)

14778.label: Psalms 54:4
14778.text: Look! God is my helper; Jehovah is with those supporting me.

14779.label: Psalms 54:5
14779.text: He will repay my foes with their own evil;In your faithfulness, put an end to them.

14780.label: Psalms 54:6
14780.text: I will sacrifice to you willingly. I will praise your name, O Jehovah, for it is good.

14781.label: Psalms 54:7
14781.text: For he saves me from every distress, And I will look in triumph on my enemies.

14783.label: Psalms 55:1
14783.text: Listen to my prayer, O God, And do not ignore my request for mercy.

14784.label: Psalms 55:2
14784.text: Do pay attention to me and answer me. My concern makes me restless, And I am distraught

14785.label: Psalms 55:3
14785.text: Because of what the enemy is sayingAnd the pressure from the wicked one. For they heap trouble upon me,And in anger they harbor animosity against me.

14786.label: Psalms 55:4
14786.text: My heart is in anguish within me, And the terrors of death overwhelm me.

14787.label: Psalms 55:5
14787.text: Fear and trembling come upon me,And shuddering grips me.

14788.label: Psalms 55:6
14788.text: I keep saying: “If only I had wings like a dove! I would fly away and reside in safety.

14789.label: Psalms 55:7
14789.text: Look! I would flee far away. I would lodge in the wilderness. (Selah)

14790.label: Psalms 55:8
14790.text: I would hurry to a place of shelterAway from the raging wind, away from the storm.”

14791.label: Psalms 55:9
14791.text: Confuse them, O Jehovah, and frustrate their plans, For I have seen violence and conflict in the city.

14792.label: Psalms 55:10
14792.text: Day and night they walk around on its walls;Within it are malice and trouble.

14793.label: Psalms 55:11
14793.text: Ruin is in its midst;Oppression and deception never depart from its public square.

14794.label: Psalms 55:12
14794.text: For it is not an enemy who taunts me; Otherwise I could put up with it. It is not a foe who has risen up against me;Otherwise I could conceal myself from him.

14795.label: Psalms 55:13
14795.text: But it is you, a man like me, My own companion whom I know well.

14796.label: Psalms 55:14
14796.text: We used to enjoy a warm friendship together;Into the house of God we used to walk along with the multitude.

14797.label: Psalms 55:15
14797.text: May destruction overtake them! Let them go down alive into the Grave; For evil resides among them and within them.

14798.label: Psalms 55:16
14798.text: As for me, I will call out to God,And Jehovah will save me.

14799.label: Psalms 55:17
14799.text: Evening and morning and noontime, I am troubled and I groan, And he hears my voice.

14800.label: Psalms 55:18
14800.text: He will rescue me and give me peace from those fighting against me,For multitudes come against me.

14801.label: Psalms 55:19
14801.text: God will hear and respond to them, The one who sits enthroned from of old. (Selah) They will refuse to change,Those who have not feared God.

14802.label: Psalms 55:20
14802.text: He attacked those at peace with him; He violated his covenant.

14803.label: Psalms 55:21
14803.text: His words are smoother than butter, But conflict is in his heart. His words are softer than oil,But they are drawn swords.

14804.label: Psalms 55:22
14804.text: Throw your burden on Jehovah, And he will sustain you. Never will he allow the righteous one to fall.

14805.label: Psalms 55:23
14805.text: But you, O God, will bring them down to the deepest pit. Those bloodguilty and deceitful men will not live out half their days. But as for me, I will trust in you.

14807.label: Psalms 56:1
14807.text: Show me favor, O God, because mortal man is attacking me. All day long they keep fighting and oppressing me.

14808.label: Psalms 56:2
14808.text: My foes keep snapping at me all day long;Many arrogantly fight against me.

14809.label: Psalms 56:3
14809.text: When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.

14810.label: Psalms 56:4
14810.text: In God—whose word I praise—In God I put my trust; I am not afraid. What can mere man do to me?

14811.label: Psalms 56:5
14811.text: All day long they hurt my interests;Their only thought is to harm me.

14812.label: Psalms 56:6
14812.text: They conceal themselves to attack;They watch my every step, Hoping to take away my life.

14813.label: Psalms 56:7
14813.text: Reject them because of their wickedness. Bring down the nations in your anger, O God.

14814.label: Psalms 56:8
14814.text: You keep track of my wandering. Do collect my tears in your skin bottle. Are they not recorded in your book?

14815.label: Psalms 56:9
14815.text: My enemies will retreat on the day that I call for help. Of this I am confident: God is on my side.

14816.label: Psalms 56:10
14816.text: In God—whose word I praise—In Jehovah—whose word I praise—

14817.label: Psalms 56:11
14817.text: In God I put my trust; I am not afraid. What can a mere human do to me?

14818.label: Psalms 56:12
14818.text: I am bound by my vows to you, O God; I will offer you expressions of thanksgiving.

14819.label: Psalms 56:13
14819.text: For you have rescued me from death And prevented my feet from stumbling, So that I may walk before God in the light of the living.

14821.label: Psalms 57:1
14821.text: Show me favor, O God, show me favor,For I take refuge in you, And in the shadow of your wings I take refuge until the troubles pass.

14822.label: Psalms 57:2
14822.text: I call to God the Most High,To the true God, who brings them to an end for me.

14823.label: Psalms 57:3
14823.text: He will send help from heaven and save me. He will frustrate the one snapping at me. (Selah) God will send his loyal love and his faithfulness.

14824.label: Psalms 57:4
14824.text: I am surrounded by lions; I must lie among men who want to devour me,Whose teeth are spears and arrowsAnd whose tongue is a sharp sword.

14825.label: Psalms 57:5
14825.text: Be exalted above the heavens, O God;May your glory be over all the earth.

14826.label: Psalms 57:6
14826.text: They have prepared a net to ensnare my feet; I am bowed down with distress. They have dug a pit ahead of me,But they fell into it themselves. (Selah)

14827.label: Psalms 57:7
14827.text: My heart is steadfast, O God, My heart is steadfast. I will sing and make music.

14828.label: Psalms 57:8
14828.text: Do awake, my glory. Do awake, O stringed instrument; you too, O harp. I will awaken the dawn.

14829.label: Psalms 57:9
14829.text: I will praise you among the peoples, O Jehovah; I will sing praises to you among the nations.

14830.label: Psalms 57:10
14830.text: For your loyal love is great, as high as the heavens, And your faithfulness, up to the skies.

14831.label: Psalms 57:11
14831.text: Be exalted above the heavens, O God;May your glory be over all the earth.

14833.label: Psalms 58:1
14833.text: Can you speak about righteousness when you are silent? Can you judge in uprightness, you sons of men?

14834.label: Psalms 58:2
14834.text: Instead, you devise unrighteousness in your heart, And your hands dispense violence in the land.

14835.label: Psalms 58:3
14835.text: The wicked go astray from birth; They are wayward, liars from the time they are born.

14836.label: Psalms 58:4
14836.text: Their venom is like the venom of serpents; They are deaf like the cobra that stops up its ear.

14837.label: Psalms 58:5
14837.text: It will not listen to the voice of charmers,No matter how skillful their spells.

14838.label: Psalms 58:6
14838.text: O God, knock the teeth out of their mouth! Break the jaws of these lions, O Jehovah!

14839.label: Psalms 58:7
14839.text: May they disappear like waters that drain away. May He bend his bow and make them fall by his arrows.

14840.label: Psalms 58:8
14840.text: May they be like a snail that melts away as it moves along;Like a woman’s stillborn child who never sees the sun.

14841.label: Psalms 58:9
14841.text: Before your cooking pots feel the heat of the bramble,He will sweep away both the moist and the burning twig, as in a storm wind.

14842.label: Psalms 58:10
14842.text: The righteous one will rejoice because he has seen the vengeance; His feet will be drenched with the blood of the wicked.

14843.label: Psalms 58:11
14843.text: Then men will say: “Surely there is a reward for the righteous. There is indeed a God who judges in the earth.”

14845.label: Psalms 59:1
14845.text: Rescue me from my enemies, O my God; Protect me from those rising up against me.

14846.label: Psalms 59:2
14846.text: Rescue me from those who act wickedly,And save me from violent men.

14847.label: Psalms 59:3
14847.text: Look! They wait to ambush me; Strong men attack meBut not because I have revolted or sinned, O Jehovah.

14848.label: Psalms 59:4
14848.text: Though I did no wrong, they run and prepare to attack. Do arise at my calling and see.

14849.label: Psalms 59:5
14849.text: For you, O Jehovah God of armies, are the God of Israel. Awake to turn your attention to all the nations. Do not show mercy to any malicious traitors. (Selah)

14850.label: Psalms 59:6
14850.text: They return each evening; They growl like dogs and prowl around the city.

14851.label: Psalms 59:7
14851.text: Look what pours forth from their mouth;Their lips are like swords, For they say: “Who is listening?”

14852.label: Psalms 59:8
14852.text: But you, O Jehovah, will laugh at them; You will scoff at all the nations.

14853.label: Psalms 59:9
14853.text: O my Strength, I will keep watch for you; For God is my secure refuge.

14854.label: Psalms 59:10
14854.text: The God who shows loyal love to me will come to my aid; God will cause me to look in triumph on my foes.

14855.label: Psalms 59:11
14855.text: Do not kill them, so that my people may not forget. By your power make them wander about;Cause their downfall, O Jehovah, our shield.

14856.label: Psalms 59:12
14856.text: For the sin of their mouth, the word of their lips,May they be trapped by their pride, Because of the cursing and deception that they speak.

14857.label: Psalms 59:13
14857.text: Finish them off in your wrath; Finish them off, so that they are no more;Make them know that God is ruling in Jacob and to the ends of the earth. (Selah)

14858.label: Psalms 59:14
14858.text: Let them return in the evening;Let them growl like dogs and prowl around the city.

14859.label: Psalms 59:15
14859.text: Let them wander about for something to eat; Do not let them be satisfied or find a lodging place.

14860.label: Psalms 59:16
14860.text: But as for me, I will sing about your strength; In the morning I will joyfully tell about your loyal love. For you are my secure refuge And a place for me to flee in my time of distress.

14861.label: Psalms 59:17
14861.text: O my Strength, to you I will sing praises, For God is my secure refuge, the God who shows loyal love to me.

14863.label: Psalms 60:1
14863.text: O God, you rejected us; you broke through our defenses. You were angry with us; but now accept us back!

14864.label: Psalms 60:2
14864.text: You caused the earth to quake; you split it open. Repair its breaches, for it is falling.

14865.label: Psalms 60:3
14865.text: You caused your people to suffer hardship. You made us drink wine that makes us stagger.

14866.label: Psalms 60:4
14866.text: Give a signal to those fearing youTo flee and dodge the bow. (Selah)

14867.label: Psalms 60:5
14867.text: So that your loved ones may be rescued,Save us with your right hand and answer us.

14868.label: Psalms 60:6
14868.text: God has spoken in his holiness: “I will exult, I will give out Sheʹchem as an inheritance, And I will measure off the Valley of Sucʹcoth.

14869.label: Psalms 60:7
14869.text: Gilʹe·ad belongs to me, as does Ma·nasʹseh, And Eʹphra·im is the helmet for my head;Judah is my commander’s staff.

14870.label: Psalms 60:8
14870.text: Moʹab is my washbasin. Over Eʹdom I will throw my sandal. Over Phi·lisʹti·a I will shout in triumph.”

14871.label: Psalms 60:9
14871.text: Who will bring me to the besieged city? Who will lead me as far as Eʹdom?

14872.label: Psalms 60:10
14872.text: Is it not you, O God, who have rejected us,Our God, who no longer goes out with our armies?

14873.label: Psalms 60:11
14873.text: Help us in our distress,For salvation by humans is worthless.

14874.label: Psalms 60:12
14874.text: By God we will gain power, And he will trample on our adversaries.

14876.label: Psalms 61:1
14876.text: Hear, O God, my cry for help. Do pay attention to my prayer.

14877.label: Psalms 61:2
14877.text: From the ends of the earth I will cry out to youWhen my heart is in despair. Lead me onto a rock that is higher than I am.

14878.label: Psalms 61:3
14878.text: For you are my refuge,A strong tower that protects me from the enemy.

14879.label: Psalms 61:4
14879.text: I will be a guest in your tent forever; I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. (Selah)

14880.label: Psalms 61:5
14880.text: For you, O God, have heard my vows. You have given me the inheritance belonging to those who fear your name.

14881.label: Psalms 61:6
14881.text: You will add days to the life of the king, And his years will be from generation to generation.

14882.label: Psalms 61:7
14882.text: He will sit enthroned forever before God; Grant him loyal love and faithfulness, so that these may safeguard him.

14883.label: Psalms 61:8
14883.text: Then I will sing praises to your name forever As I pay my vows day after day.

14885.label: Psalms 62:1
14885.text: Indeed, I wait silently for God. My salvation comes from him.

14886.label: Psalms 62:2
14886.text: Indeed, he is my rock and my salvation, my secure refuge; I will never be greatly shaken.

14887.label: Psalms 62:3
14887.text: How long will you assault a man in order to murder him? All of you are as dangerous as a leaning wall, a stone wall ready to collapse.

14888.label: Psalms 62:4
14888.text: For they consult together to topple him from his high position; They take pleasure in lying. With their mouth they bless, but inside they are cursing. (Selah)

14889.label: Psalms 62:5
14889.text: Indeed, I wait silently for God Because my hope comes from him.

14890.label: Psalms 62:6
14890.text: Indeed, he is my rock and my salvation, my secure refuge;I will never be shaken.

14891.label: Psalms 62:7
14891.text: Upon God depends my salvation and my glory. My strong rock, my refuge, is God.

14892.label: Psalms 62:8
14892.text: Trust in him at all times, O people. Pour out your hearts before him. God is a refuge for us. (Selah)

14893.label: Psalms 62:9
14893.text: The sons of men are a mere breath,The sons of mankind are a delusion. When laid together on the scales, they are lighter than a mere breath.

14894.label: Psalms 62:10
14894.text: Do not trust in extortionOr put false hopes in robbery. If your wealth increases, do not set your heart on it.

14895.label: Psalms 62:11
14895.text: Once God has spoken, twice I have heard this: That strength belongs to God.

14896.label: Psalms 62:12
14896.text: Also loyal love is yours, O Jehovah, For you repay each one according to his deeds.

14898.label: Psalms 63:1
14898.text: O God, you are my God, I keep looking for you. I do thirst for you. I am faint with longing for youIn a dry and parched land, where there is no water.

14899.label: Psalms 63:2
14899.text: So I have looked upon you in the holy place;I have seen your strength and your glory.

14900.label: Psalms 63:3
14900.text: Because your loyal love is better than life, My own lips will glorify you.

14901.label: Psalms 63:4
14901.text: Thus I will praise you all my life;In your name I will lift up my hands.

14902.label: Psalms 63:5
14902.text: I am satisfied with the best and choicest portion, So my mouth will praise you with joy on my lips.

14903.label: Psalms 63:6
14903.text: I remember you while upon my bed;I meditate on you during the watches of the night.

14904.label: Psalms 63:7
14904.text: For you are my helper, And I shout joyfully in the shadow of your wings.

14905.label: Psalms 63:8
14905.text: I cling to you;Your right hand keeps fast hold on me.

14906.label: Psalms 63:9
14906.text: But those who seek to destroy my life Will descend into the depths of the earth.

14907.label: Psalms 63:10
14907.text: They will be handed over to the power of the sword;They will become food for jackals.

14908.label: Psalms 63:11
14908.text: But the king will rejoice in God. Every person swearing by Him will exult, For the mouth of those speaking lies will be silenced.

14910.label: Psalms 64:1
14910.text: Hear my voice, O God, as I plead. Safeguard my life from the dreadfulness of the enemy.

14911.label: Psalms 64:2
14911.text: Shield me from the secret plots of wicked men, From the crowd of wrongdoers.

14912.label: Psalms 64:3
14912.text: They sharpen their tongue just like a sword;They aim their cruel words like arrows,

14913.label: Psalms 64:4
14913.text: To shoot at the innocent from their hiding places;They shoot at him suddenly, without fear.

14914.label: Psalms 64:5
14914.text: They hold fast to their evil intent; They discuss how to hide their traps. They say: “Who will see them?”

14915.label: Psalms 64:6
14915.text: They search out new ways of wrongdoing;They secretly devise their shrewd strategy; The thinking within each one’s heart is unfathomable.

14916.label: Psalms 64:7
14916.text: But God will shoot at them; Suddenly they will be wounded by an arrow.

14917.label: Psalms 64:8
14917.text: Their own tongue will cause their downfall; All those looking on will shake their head.

14918.label: Psalms 64:9
14918.text: Then all men will become afraid,And they will proclaim what God has done,And they will have insight into his deeds.

14919.label: Psalms 64:10
14919.text: The righteous one will rejoice in Jehovah and take refuge in him; All the upright in heart will exult.

14921.label: Psalms 65:1
14921.text: Praise awaits you, O God, in Zion; We will pay our vows to you.

14922.label: Psalms 65:2
14922.text: O Hearer of prayer, to you people of all sorts will come.

14923.label: Psalms 65:3
14923.text: My errors have overwhelmed me, But you cover over our transgressions.

14924.label: Psalms 65:4
14924.text: Happy is the one whom you choose and bring nearTo reside in your courtyards. We will be satisfied with the goodness of your house, Your holy temple.

14925.label: Psalms 65:5
14925.text: You will answer us with awe-inspiring deeds of righteousness,O God of our salvation;You are the Confidence of all the ends of the earth And of those distant across the sea.

14926.label: Psalms 65:6
14926.text: You firmly established the mountains by your power;You are clothed with mightiness.

14927.label: Psalms 65:7
14927.text: You calm the raging seas, The crash of their waves and the turmoil of the nations.

14928.label: Psalms 65:8
14928.text: The inhabitants of remote places will be awestruck by your signs; You will cause those from the sunrise to the sunset to shout joyfully.

14929.label: Psalms 65:9
14929.text: You care for the earth,Making it abundantly fruitful and very rich. The stream from God is full of water;You provide grain for them, For that is how you prepared the earth.

14930.label: Psalms 65:10
14930.text: You drench its furrows and level off its plowed soil; You soften it with showers of rain; you bless its growth.

14931.label: Psalms 65:11
14931.text: You crown the year with your goodness;Your tracks overflow with abundance.

14932.label: Psalms 65:12
14932.text: The pastures of the wilderness keep overflowing, And the hills are clothed with joyfulness.

14933.label: Psalms 65:13
14933.text: The pastures are covered with flocks,And the valleys are carpeted with grain. They shout in triumph, yes, they sing.

14935.label: Psalms 66:1
14935.text: Shout in triumph to God, all the earth.

14936.label: Psalms 66:2
14936.text: Sing praises to his glorious name. Make his praise glorious.

14937.label: Psalms 66:3
14937.text: Say to God: “How awe-inspiring your works are! Because of your great power,Your enemies will cringe before you.

14938.label: Psalms 66:4
14938.text: All the earth will bow down to you; They will sing praises to you;They will sing praises to your name.” (Selah)

14939.label: Psalms 66:5
14939.text: Come and see the works of God. His deeds toward the sons of men are awe-inspiring.

14940.label: Psalms 66:6
14940.text: He changed the sea into dry land; They crossed the river on foot. There we rejoiced in him.

14941.label: Psalms 66:7
14941.text: He rules forever by his might. His eyes keep watch on the nations. Those who are stubborn should not exalt themselves. (Selah)

14942.label: Psalms 66:8
14942.text: Praise our God, you peoples, And let the sound of his praise be heard.

14943.label: Psalms 66:9
14943.text: He preserves us alive; He does not allow our feet to stumble.

14944.label: Psalms 66:10
14944.text: For you have examined us, O God; As silver is refined, so you have refined us.

14945.label: Psalms 66:11
14945.text: You brought us into a hunting net;You put a crushing burden upon us.

14946.label: Psalms 66:12
14946.text: You allowed mortal man to ride over us; We came through fire and through water;Then you brought us to a place of relief.

14947.label: Psalms 66:13
14947.text: I will come into your house with whole burnt offerings; I will pay my vows to you

14948.label: Psalms 66:14
14948.text: That my lips promised And my mouth spoke when I was in distress.

14949.label: Psalms 66:15
14949.text: I will offer burnt offerings of fattened animals to youWith the smoke of sacrificial rams. I will offer bulls along with male goats. (Selah)

14950.label: Psalms 66:16
14950.text: Come and listen, all you who fear God,And I will tell you what he has done for me.

14951.label: Psalms 66:17
14951.text: I called to him with my mouthAnd glorified him with my tongue.

14952.label: Psalms 66:18
14952.text: If I had harbored anything hurtful in my heart,Jehovah would not have heard me.

14953.label: Psalms 66:19
14953.text: But God did hear; He paid attention to my prayer.

14954.label: Psalms 66:20
14954.text: Praise to God, who did not reject my prayerOr withhold his loyal love from me.

14956.label: Psalms 67:1
14956.text: God will show us favor and bless us;He will make his face shine upon us (Selah)

14957.label: Psalms 67:2
14957.text: So that your way may be known throughout the earth, Your acts of salvation among all the nations.

14958.label: Psalms 67:3
14958.text: Let peoples praise you, O God;Let all the peoples praise you.

14959.label: Psalms 67:4
14959.text: Let nations rejoice and shout joyfully, For you will judge the peoples fairly. You will guide the nations of the earth. (Selah)

14960.label: Psalms 67:5
14960.text: Let peoples praise you, O God;Let all the peoples praise you.

14961.label: Psalms 67:6
14961.text: The earth will give its produce; God, our God, will bless us.

14962.label: Psalms 67:7
14962.text: God will bless us,And all the ends of the earth will fear him.

14964.label: Psalms 68:1
14964.text: Let God rise up, let his enemies be scattered,And let those who hate him flee from before him.

14965.label: Psalms 68:2
14965.text: As smoke is driven away, may you drive them away;As wax melts before the fire,So let the wicked perish before God.

14966.label: Psalms 68:3
14966.text: But let the righteous rejoice; May they be overjoyed before God;May they exult with rejoicing.

14967.label: Psalms 68:4
14967.text: Sing to God; sing praises to his name. Sing to the One riding through the desert plains. Jah is his name! Rejoice before him!

14968.label: Psalms 68:5
14968.text: A father of the fatherless and a protector of widows Is God in his holy dwelling.

14969.label: Psalms 68:6
14969.text: God gives those who are alone a home to dwell in; He leads prisoners out into prosperity. But the stubborn must live in a parched land.

14970.label: Psalms 68:7
14970.text: O God, when you led your people, When you marched through the desert, (Selah)

14971.label: Psalms 68:8
14971.text: The earth quaked; Heaven poured down rain because of God;This Siʹnai quaked because of God, the God of Israel.

14972.label: Psalms 68:9
14972.text: You made it rain in abundance, O God;You reinvigorated your exhausted people.

14973.label: Psalms 68:10
14973.text: They dwelled in your tent community; In your goodness, you provided for the poor, O God.

14974.label: Psalms 68:11
14974.text: Jehovah gives the command;The women proclaiming the good news are a large army.

14975.label: Psalms 68:12
14975.text: The kings of armies flee, they flee! She who remains at home shares in the spoil.

14976.label: Psalms 68:13
14976.text: Although you men were lying among the campfires, There will be the wings of a dove covered with silver,With pinions of fine gold.

14977.label: Psalms 68:14
14977.text: When the Almighty One scattered its kings, Snow fell in Zalʹmon.

14978.label: Psalms 68:15
14978.text: The mountain of Baʹshan is a mountain of God; The mountain of Baʹshan is a mountain of peaks.

14979.label: Psalms 68:16
14979.text: Why do you look with envy, you mountains of peaks,Toward the mountain that God has chosen as his dwelling? Indeed, Jehovah will reside there forever.

14980.label: Psalms 68:17
14980.text: The war chariots of God are tens of thousands, thousands upon thousands. Jehovah has come from Siʹnai into the holy place.

14981.label: Psalms 68:18
14981.text: You ascended on high; You carried away captives;You took gifts in the form of men, Yes, even stubborn ones, to reside among them, O Jah God.

14982.label: Psalms 68:19
14982.text: May Jehovah be praised, who daily carries our load, The true God of our salvation. (Selah)

14983.label: Psalms 68:20
14983.text: The true God is for us a God who saves; And Jehovah the Sovereign Lord provides escape from death.

14984.label: Psalms 68:21
14984.text: Yes, God will smash the heads of his enemies,The hairy crown of the head of anyone who continues in his guilt.

14985.label: Psalms 68:22
14985.text: Jehovah has said: “I will bring them back from Baʹshan; I will bring them back from the depths of the sea,

14986.label: Psalms 68:23
14986.text: So that your foot may be awash in blood And the tongue of your dogs may have its portion from the enemies.”

14987.label: Psalms 68:24
14987.text: They see your processions, O God,The processions of my God, my King, into the holy place.

14988.label: Psalms 68:25
14988.text: The singers walk in front, the musicians playing stringed instruments after them; In between are the young women playing tambourines.

14989.label: Psalms 68:26
14989.text: In congregated throngs, praise God;Praise Jehovah, you who are from the Source of Israel.

14990.label: Psalms 68:27
14990.text: There Benjamin, the youngest, is subduing them,Also the princes of Judah with their noisy crowd,The princes of Zebʹu·lun, the princes of Naphʹta·li.

14991.label: Psalms 68:28
14991.text: Your God has decreed that you will be strong. Show your strength, O God, you who have acted in our behalf.

14992.label: Psalms 68:29
14992.text: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, Kings will bring gifts to you.

14993.label: Psalms 68:30
14993.text: Rebuke the wild beasts of the reeds,The assembly of bulls and their calves,Until the peoples bow down bringing pieces of silver. But he scatters the peoples who delight in war.

14994.label: Psalms 68:31
14994.text: Bronze articles will be brought out of Egypt; Cush will hasten to offer gifts to God.

14995.label: Psalms 68:32
14995.text: O kingdoms of the earth, sing to God, Sing praises to Jehovah, (Selah)

14996.label: Psalms 68:33
14996.text: To the one who rides the ancient heaven of heavens. Look! He thunders with his voice, his mighty voice.

14997.label: Psalms 68:34
14997.text: Acknowledge God’s strength. His majesty is over Israel,And his strength is in the skies.

14998.label: Psalms 68:35
14998.text: God is awe-inspiring from his grand sanctuary. He is the God of Israel,Who gives strength and power to the people. Praise to God.

15000.label: Psalms 69:1
15000.text: Save me, O God, for the waters threaten my life.

15001.label: Psalms 69:2
15001.text: I have sunk down into the deep mud, where there is no solid ground. I have come into deep waters,And the rushing stream has swept me away.

15002.label: Psalms 69:3
15002.text: I am exhausted from calling out; My throat has become hoarse. My eyes have grown weary while waiting for my God.

15003.label: Psalms 69:4
15003.text: Those hating me without cause Are more numerous than the hairs of my head. Those who would do away with me,My treacherous enemies, have become many. I was forced to hand over what I had not stolen.

15004.label: Psalms 69:5
15004.text: O God, you are aware of my foolishness,And my guilt is not hidden from you.

15005.label: Psalms 69:6
15005.text: May those hoping in you not be put to shame because of me,O Sovereign Lord, Jehovah of armies. May those seeking you not be humiliated because of me,O God of Israel.

15006.label: Psalms 69:7
15006.text: I suffer reproach on your account; Humiliation covers my face.

15007.label: Psalms 69:8
15007.text: I have become a stranger to my brothers,A foreigner to the sons of my mother.

15008.label: Psalms 69:9
15008.text: Zeal for your house has consumed me, And the reproaches of those reproaching you have fallen upon me.

15009.label: Psalms 69:10
15009.text: When I humbled myself with fasting, I was reproached for it.

15010.label: Psalms 69:11
15010.text: When I made sackcloth my clothing,I became an object of scorn to them.

15011.label: Psalms 69:12
15011.text: I am the talk of those sitting in the city gate,And the drunkards make me the subject of their songs.

15012.label: Psalms 69:13
15012.text: But may my prayer come to you,O Jehovah, at an acceptable time. In your abundant loyal love, O God,Answer me with your sure acts of salvation.

15013.label: Psalms 69:14
15013.text: Rescue me from the mire;Do not let me sink down. Rescue me from those who hate meAnd from the deep waters.

15014.label: Psalms 69:15
15014.text: Do not let the rushing floodwaters sweep me away, Or let the deep swallow me,Or let the well close its mouth over me.

15015.label: Psalms 69:16
15015.text: Answer me, O Jehovah, for your loyal love is good. According to your abundant mercy turn toward me,

15016.label: Psalms 69:17
15016.text: And do not hide your face from your servant. Answer me quickly, for I am in distress.

15017.label: Psalms 69:18
15017.text: Come near to me and rescue me; Redeem me on account of my enemies.

15018.label: Psalms 69:19
15018.text: You know my reproach and my disgrace and my humiliation. You see all my foes.

15019.label: Psalms 69:20
15019.text: Reproach has broken my heart, and the wound is incurable. I was hoping for sympathy, but there was none, And for comforters, but I found none.

15020.label: Psalms 69:21
15020.text: But for food they gave me poison, And for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

15021.label: Psalms 69:22
15021.text: Let their table become a trap for them,And their prosperity, a snare.

15022.label: Psalms 69:23
15022.text: Let their eyes become darkened so that they cannot see,And make their hips tremble constantly.

15023.label: Psalms 69:24
15023.text: Pour out upon them your indignation, And may your burning anger overtake them.

15024.label: Psalms 69:25
15024.text: Let their encampment become desolate;Let there be no inhabitant in their tents.

15025.label: Psalms 69:26
15025.text: For they pursue the one whom you struck,And they keep recounting the pains of those you wounded.

15026.label: Psalms 69:27
15026.text: Add more guilt to their guilt,And may they have no share in your righteousness.

15027.label: Psalms 69:28
15027.text: Let them be erased from the book of the living, And may they not be enrolled among the righteous.

15028.label: Psalms 69:29
15028.text: But I am afflicted and in pain. May your saving power, O God, protect me.

15029.label: Psalms 69:30
15029.text: I will sing praises to the name of God,And I will magnify him with thanksgiving.

15030.label: Psalms 69:31
15030.text: This will please Jehovah more than a bull,More than a young bull with horns and hooves.

15031.label: Psalms 69:32
15031.text: The meek will see it and rejoice. You who are seeking God, may your hearts revive.

15032.label: Psalms 69:33
15032.text: For Jehovah is listening to the poor, And he will not despise his captive people.

15033.label: Psalms 69:34
15033.text: Let heaven and earth praise him, The seas and everything that moves in them.

15034.label: Psalms 69:35
15034.text: For God will save Zion And will rebuild the cities of Judah,And they will dwell there and possess it.

15035.label: Psalms 69:36
15035.text: The descendants of his servants will inherit it, And those who love his name will reside in it.

15037.label: Psalms 70:1
15037.text: O God, save me;O Jehovah, hurry to help me.

15038.label: Psalms 70:2
15038.text: May those seeking to take my life Be put to shame and disgraced. May those who delight in my calamityRetreat in humiliation.

15039.label: Psalms 70:3
15039.text: May those who are saying: “Aha! Aha!” Be driven back in shame.

15040.label: Psalms 70:4
15040.text: But let those who are seeking youExult and rejoice in you. May those who love your acts of salvation always say: “May God be magnified!”

15041.label: Psalms 70:5
15041.text: But I am helpless and poor; O God, act quickly in my behalf. You are my helper and my rescuer; O Jehovah, do not delay.

15042.label: Psalms 71:1
15042.text: In you, O Jehovah, I have taken refuge. May I never be put to shame.

15043.label: Psalms 71:2
15043.text: In your righteousness save me and rescue me. Incline your ear to me and save me.

15044.label: Psalms 71:3
15044.text: Become for me a rock fortressWhere I can always enter. Give the command to save me,For you are my crag and my stronghold.

15045.label: Psalms 71:4
15045.text: O my God, rescue me from the hand of the wicked, From the grasp of the unjust oppressor.

15046.label: Psalms 71:5
15046.text: For you are my hope, O Sovereign Lord Jehovah;I have trusted in you since my youth.

15047.label: Psalms 71:6
15047.text: I have depended on you from birth;It was you who took me from my mother’s womb. I praise you constantly.

15048.label: Psalms 71:7
15048.text: I have become like a miracle to many,But you are my strong refuge.

15049.label: Psalms 71:8
15049.text: My mouth is filled with your praise; All day long I tell about your splendor.

15050.label: Psalms 71:9
15050.text: Do not cast me off in my old age; Do not abandon me when my strength fails.

15051.label: Psalms 71:10
15051.text: My enemies speak against me,And those seeking to take my life conspire together,

15052.label: Psalms 71:11
15052.text: Saying: “God has abandoned him. Chase after him and seize him, for there is no one to save him.”

15053.label: Psalms 71:12
15053.text: O God, do not remain far away from me. O my God, hurry to help me.

15054.label: Psalms 71:13
15054.text: May those who are resisting me Be put to shame and perish. May those seeking my calamityBe covered with disgrace and humiliation.

15055.label: Psalms 71:14
15055.text: But as for me, I will continue to wait;I will add to your praise.

15056.label: Psalms 71:15
15056.text: My mouth will recount your righteousness, All day long your acts of salvation,Though they are too many for me to grasp.

15057.label: Psalms 71:16
15057.text: I will come and tell about your mighty acts,O Sovereign Lord Jehovah;I will mention your righteousness, yours alone.

15058.label: Psalms 71:17
15058.text: O God, you have taught me from my youth, And until now I keep declaring your wonderful works.

15059.label: Psalms 71:18
15059.text: Even when I am old and gray, O God, do not abandon me. Let me tell the next generation about your power And about your mightiness to all those who are to come.

15060.label: Psalms 71:19
15060.text: Your righteousness, O God, reaches to the heights; You have done great things;O God, who is like you?

15061.label: Psalms 71:20
15061.text: Though you have made me experience much distress and calamity, Revive me again;Bring me up from the depths of the earth.

15062.label: Psalms 71:21
15062.text: May you increase my greatnessAnd surround and comfort me.

15063.label: Psalms 71:22
15063.text: Then I will praise you on a stringed instrumentBecause of your faithfulness, O my God. I will sing your praises with the harp,O Holy One of Israel.

15064.label: Psalms 71:23
15064.text: My lips will shout joyfully as I sing praises to you, For you have saved my life.

15065.label: Psalms 71:24
15065.text: My tongue will speak about your righteousness all day long, For those seeking my destruction will be ashamed and disgraced.

15067.label: Psalms 72:1
15067.text: O God, give your judgments to the king,And endow the son of the king with your righteousness.

15068.label: Psalms 72:2
15068.text: May he plead the cause of your people with righteousness,And of your lowly ones with justice.

15069.label: Psalms 72:3
15069.text: May the mountains bring peace to the people,And may the hills bring righteousness.

15070.label: Psalms 72:4
15070.text: Let him defend the lowly among the people,Let him save the sons of the poor,And let him crush the defrauder.

15071.label: Psalms 72:5
15071.text: They will fear you as long as there is a sunAnd as long as the moon remains,For generation after generation.

15072.label: Psalms 72:6
15072.text: He will be like the rain that falls on the mown grass,Like showers of rain that water the earth.

15073.label: Psalms 72:7
15073.text: In his days the righteous will flourish, And peace will abound until the moon is no more.

15074.label: Psalms 72:8
15074.text: He will have subjects from sea to seaAnd from the River to the ends of the earth.

15075.label: Psalms 72:9
15075.text: The desert dwellers will bow down before him,And his enemies will lick the dust.

15076.label: Psalms 72:10
15076.text: The kings of Tarʹshish and of the islands will pay tribute. The kings of Sheʹba and of Seʹba will present gifts.

15077.label: Psalms 72:11
15077.text: All the kings will bow down before him,And all the nations will serve him.

15078.label: Psalms 72:12
15078.text: For he will rescue the poor who cry for help,Also the lowly one and whoever has no helper.

15079.label: Psalms 72:13
15079.text: He will have pity on the lowly and the poor,And the lives of the poor he will save.

15080.label: Psalms 72:14
15080.text: From oppression and from violence he will rescue them, And their blood will be precious in his eyes.

15081.label: Psalms 72:15
15081.text: May he live and be given the gold of Sheʹba. May prayers be said for him continually,And may he be blessed all day long.

15082.label: Psalms 72:16
15082.text: There will be an abundance of grain on the earth; On the top of the mountains it will overflow. His fruit will flourish as in Lebʹa·non, And in the cities people will blossom like the vegetation of the earth.

15083.label: Psalms 72:17
15083.text: May his name endure forever, And may it prosper as long as the sun. May people obtain a blessing for themselves by means of him; May all nations pronounce him happy.

15084.label: Psalms 72:18
15084.text: May Jehovah God be praised, Israel’s God, Who alone does wonderful things.

15085.label: Psalms 72:19
15085.text: May his glorious name be praised forever, And may his glory fill the whole earth. Amen and Amen.

15086.label: Psalms 72:20
15086.text: This completes the prayers of David, the son of Jesʹse.

15088.label: Psalms 73:1
15088.text: God is truly good to Israel, to those pure in heart.

15089.label: Psalms 73:2
15089.text: As for me, my feet had almost strayed;My steps had nearly slipped.

15090.label: Psalms 73:3
15090.text: For I became envious of the arrogant When I would see the peace of the wicked.

15091.label: Psalms 73:4
15091.text: For they have no pain in their death;Their bodies are healthy.

15092.label: Psalms 73:5
15092.text: They are not troubled like other humans, Nor do they suffer like other men.

15093.label: Psalms 73:6
15093.text: Therefore, haughtiness is their necklace; Violence clothes them as a garment.

15094.label: Psalms 73:7
15094.text: Their prosperity makes their eyes bulge;They have exceeded the imaginations of the heart.

15095.label: Psalms 73:8
15095.text: They scoff and say evil things. They arrogantly threaten oppression.

15096.label: Psalms 73:9
15096.text: They speak as if they were as high as heaven,And their tongues swagger about in the earth.

15097.label: Psalms 73:10
15097.text: So his people turn aside to them,And they drink from their abundant water.

15098.label: Psalms 73:11
15098.text: They say: “How does God know? Does the Most High really have knowledge?”

15099.label: Psalms 73:12
15099.text: Yes, these are the wicked, who always have it easy. They keep increasing their wealth.

15100.label: Psalms 73:13
15100.text: Surely in vain I have kept my heart pureAnd washed my hands in innocence.

15101.label: Psalms 73:14
15101.text: And I was troubled all day long; Every morning I was chastised.

15102.label: Psalms 73:15
15102.text: But if I had said these things,I would have betrayed your people.

15103.label: Psalms 73:16
15103.text: When I tried to understand it,It was troubling to me

15104.label: Psalms 73:17
15104.text: Until I entered the grand sanctuary of God,And I discerned their future.

15105.label: Psalms 73:18
15105.text: Surely you place them on slippery ground. You make them fall to their ruin.

15106.label: Psalms 73:19
15106.text: How suddenly they are devastated! How sudden is their finish as they come to a terrible end!

15107.label: Psalms 73:20
15107.text: Like a dream when one wakes up, O Jehovah,When you rouse yourself, you will dismiss their image.

15108.label: Psalms 73:21
15108.text: But my heart was sour, And deep inside I felt sharp pain.

15109.label: Psalms 73:22
15109.text: I was unreasoning and lacked understanding;I was like a senseless beast before you.

15110.label: Psalms 73:23
15110.text: But now I am continually with you;You have taken hold of my right hand.

15111.label: Psalms 73:24
15111.text: You guide me with your advice, And afterward you will lead me to glory.

15112.label: Psalms 73:25
15112.text: Whom do I have in the heavens? And besides you I desire nothing on earth.

15113.label: Psalms 73:26
15113.text: My body and my heart may fail,But God is the rock of my heart and my portion forever.

15114.label: Psalms 73:27
15114.text: Truly, those keeping far from you will perish. You will put an end to everyone who immorally leaves you.

15115.label: Psalms 73:28
15115.text: But as for me, drawing near to God is good for me. I have made the Sovereign Lord Jehovah my refuge,To declare all your works.

15117.label: Psalms 74:1
15117.text: Why, O God, have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger burn against the flock of your pasture?

15118.label: Psalms 74:2
15118.text: Remember the people you acquired long ago, The tribe you redeemed as your inheritance. Remember Mount Zion, where you have resided.

15119.label: Psalms 74:3
15119.text: Direct your steps to the perpetual ruins. The enemy has devastated everything in the holy place.

15120.label: Psalms 74:4
15120.text: Your foes roared inside your meeting place. They have set up their own banners as signs there.

15121.label: Psalms 74:5
15121.text: They were like men wielding axes against a thick forest.

15122.label: Psalms 74:6
15122.text: They broke up all its engravings with axes and iron bars.

15123.label: Psalms 74:7
15123.text: They set your sanctuary on fire. They profaned the tabernacle bearing your name, casting it to the ground.

15124.label: Psalms 74:8
15124.text: They and their offspring have said in their hearts: “All the meeting places of God in the land must be burned.”

15125.label: Psalms 74:9
15125.text: There are no signs for us to see;There is no longer any prophet,And no one among us knows how long this will last.

15126.label: Psalms 74:10
15126.text: How long, O God, will the adversary keep taunting? Will the enemy treat your name with disrespect forever?

15127.label: Psalms 74:11
15127.text: Why do you hold back your hand, your right hand? Draw it out of your bosom and put an end to them.

15128.label: Psalms 74:12
15128.text: But God is my King from long ago,The one performing acts of salvation on the earth.

15129.label: Psalms 74:13
15129.text: You stirred up the sea with your strength; You smashed the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

15130.label: Psalms 74:14
15130.text: You crushed the heads of Le·viʹa·than; You gave it as food to the people, to those inhabiting the deserts.

15131.label: Psalms 74:15
15131.text: You cut openings for the springs and the streams; You dried up ever-flowing rivers.

15132.label: Psalms 74:16
15132.text: The day belongs to you, also the night. You made the light and the sun.

15133.label: Psalms 74:17
15133.text: You set up all the boundaries of the earth; You made summer and winter.

15134.label: Psalms 74:18
15134.text: Remember the enemy’s taunts, O Jehovah,How a foolish people treats your name with disrespect.

15135.label: Psalms 74:19
15135.text: Do not surrender the life of your turtledove to the wild beasts. Do not forget the life of your afflicted people forever.

15136.label: Psalms 74:20
15136.text: Remember the covenant,For the dark places of the earth have become full of the haunts of violence.

15137.label: Psalms 74:21
15137.text: May the crushed one not turn away disappointed; May the lowly and the poor praise your name.

15138.label: Psalms 74:22
15138.text: Rise up, O God, and plead your legal case. Remember how the foolish taunt you all day long.

15139.label: Psalms 74:23
15139.text: Do not forget what your foes are saying. The uproar of those who defy you is ascending constantly.

15141.label: Psalms 75:1
15141.text: We give thanks to you, O God, we give thanks to you;Your name is near, And people declare your wondrous works.

15142.label: Psalms 75:2
15142.text: You say: “When I set a time,I judge with fairness.

15143.label: Psalms 75:3
15143.text: When the earth and all its inhabitants were dissolved,It was I who kept its pillars firm.” (Selah)

15144.label: Psalms 75:4
15144.text: I say to the boastful, “Do not boast,” And to the wicked, “Do not exalt your strength.

15145.label: Psalms 75:5
15145.text: Do not exalt your strength up highOr speak with arrogance.

15146.label: Psalms 75:6
15146.text: For exaltation does not comeFrom the east or the west or the south.

15147.label: Psalms 75:7
15147.text: For God is Judge. He puts one man down and exalts another.

15148.label: Psalms 75:8
15148.text: For there is a cup in Jehovah’s hand; The wine is foaming and is fully mixed. He will surely pour it out,And all the wicked of the earth will drink it, down to the dregs.”

15149.label: Psalms 75:9
15149.text: But as for me, I will proclaim it forever;I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

15150.label: Psalms 75:10
15150.text: For he says: “I will cut off all the strength of the wicked,But the strength of the righteous will be exalted.”

15152.label: Psalms 76:1
15152.text: God is known in Judah; In Israel his name is great.

15153.label: Psalms 76:2
15153.text: His shelter is in Saʹlem, And his dwelling is in Zion.

15154.label: Psalms 76:3
15154.text: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow,The shield and the sword and the weapons of war. (Selah)

15155.label: Psalms 76:4
15155.text: You shine brightly; You are more majestic than the mountains of prey.

15156.label: Psalms 76:5
15156.text: The courageous of heart have been plundered. They have fallen asleep;The warriors were all helpless.

15157.label: Psalms 76:6
15157.text: From your rebuke, O God of Jacob,Both the charioteer and the horse have fallen fast asleep.

15158.label: Psalms 76:7
15158.text: You alone are awe-inspiring. Who can withstand your intense anger?

15159.label: Psalms 76:8
15159.text: From heaven you pronounced judgment; The earth was afraid and was silent

15160.label: Psalms 76:9
15160.text: When God rose up to execute judgment,To save all the meek of the earth. (Selah)

15161.label: Psalms 76:10
15161.text: For the rage of man will serve to your praise; With the remnants of their rage you will adorn yourself.

15162.label: Psalms 76:11
15162.text: Make your vows to Jehovah your God and pay them, Let all who are around him bring their gift in fear.

15163.label: Psalms 76:12
15163.text: He will humble the pride of leaders;He inspires fear in the kings of the earth.

15165.label: Psalms 77:1
15165.text: With my voice I will cry out to God;To God I will cry out, and he will hear me.

15166.label: Psalms 77:2
15166.text: In the day of my distress I search for Jehovah. At night my hands are stretched out to him without ceasing. I cannot be comforted.

15167.label: Psalms 77:3
15167.text: When I remember God, I groan; I am troubled and my strength fails. (Selah)

15168.label: Psalms 77:4
15168.text: You hold my eyelids open;I am agitated and cannot speak.

15169.label: Psalms 77:5
15169.text: My thoughts turn to the days of long ago, The years of the distant past.

15170.label: Psalms 77:6
15170.text: During the night I remember my song; I ponder in my heart; I make a diligent search.

15171.label: Psalms 77:7
15171.text: Will Jehovah cast us off forever? Will he never again show his favor?

15172.label: Psalms 77:8
15172.text: Has his loyal love ceased forever? Will his promise come to nothing for all generations?

15173.label: Psalms 77:9
15173.text: Has God forgotten to show his favor, Or has his anger caused his mercy to cease? (Selah)

15174.label: Psalms 77:10
15174.text: Must I keep saying: “This is what distresses me: The Most High has changed his position toward us”?

15175.label: Psalms 77:11
15175.text: I will remember the works of Jah;I will remember your marvelous deeds of long ago.

15176.label: Psalms 77:12
15176.text: And I will meditate on all your activityAnd ponder over your dealings.

15177.label: Psalms 77:13
15177.text: O God, your ways are holy. What god is as great as you, O God?

15178.label: Psalms 77:14
15178.text: You are the true God, who does marvelous things. You have revealed your strength to the peoples.

15179.label: Psalms 77:15
15179.text: With your power you have rescued your people, The sons of Jacob and of Joseph. (Selah)

15180.label: Psalms 77:16
15180.text: The waters saw you, O God;The waters saw you and were disturbed. And the deep waters became agitated.

15181.label: Psalms 77:17
15181.text: The clouds poured down water. The cloudy skies thundered,And your arrows flew here and there.

15182.label: Psalms 77:18
15182.text: The sound of your thunder was like chariot wheels;Flashes of lightning lit up the inhabited earth; The earth trembled and quaked.

15183.label: Psalms 77:19
15183.text: Your way was through the sea, Your path through many waters;But your footprints could not be traced.

15184.label: Psalms 77:20
15184.text: You led your people just like a flock, In the care of Moses and Aaron.

15186.label: Psalms 78:1
15186.text: Listen, my people, to my law; Incline your ear to the words of my mouth.

15187.label: Psalms 78:2
15187.text: I will open my mouth in a proverb. I will propound riddles of long ago.

15188.label: Psalms 78:3
15188.text: The things we have heard and know,Which our fathers have related to us,

15189.label: Psalms 78:4
15189.text: We will not hide from their sons;We will relate to the generation to come The praiseworthy deeds of Jehovah and his strength, The wonderful things he has done.

15190.label: Psalms 78:5
15190.text: He established a reminder in JacobAnd set a law in Israel;He commanded our forefathersTo make these things known to their children,

15191.label: Psalms 78:6
15191.text: So that the next generation,The children yet to be born, might know them. They in turn would relate them to their children.

15192.label: Psalms 78:7
15192.text: Then these would put their confidence in God. They would not forget God’s works But would observe his commandments.

15193.label: Psalms 78:8
15193.text: Then they would not be like their forefathers,A stubborn and rebellious generation, A generation whose heart was unsteady And whose spirit was not faithful to God.

15194.label: Psalms 78:9
15194.text: The Eʹphra·im·ites were armed with the bow,But they retreated in the day of battle.

15195.label: Psalms 78:10
15195.text: They did not keep the covenant of God And refused to walk in his law.

15196.label: Psalms 78:11
15196.text: They also forgot what he had done, His wonderful works that he showed them.

15197.label: Psalms 78:12
15197.text: He did marvelous things in the sight of their forefathers, In the land of Egypt, the region of Zoʹan.

15198.label: Psalms 78:13
15198.text: He split the sea to let them pass through,And he made the waters stand up like a dam.

15199.label: Psalms 78:14
15199.text: He led them with a cloud by dayAnd the whole night with the light of a fire.

15200.label: Psalms 78:15
15200.text: He split rocks in the wilderness,He let them drink their fill as if from deep waters.

15201.label: Psalms 78:16
15201.text: He brought streams out of a cragAnd caused waters to flow down like rivers.

15202.label: Psalms 78:17
15202.text: But they continued to sin against himBy rebelling against the Most High in the desert;

15203.label: Psalms 78:18
15203.text: They challenged God in their heart By demanding food that they craved.

15204.label: Psalms 78:19
