15204.text: So they spoke against God,Saying: “Can God spread a table in the wilderness?”

15205.label: Psalms 78:20
15205.text: Look! He struck a rockSo that waters flowed and streams flooded out. “Can he also give us bread,Or can he provide meat for his people?”

15206.label: Psalms 78:21
15206.text: When Jehovah heard them, he became furious; A fire blazed against Jacob,And his anger flared up against Israel

15207.label: Psalms 78:22
15207.text: Because they did not put faith in God; They did not trust in his ability to save them.

15208.label: Psalms 78:23
15208.text: So he commanded the cloudy skies above,And he opened the doors of heaven.

15209.label: Psalms 78:24
15209.text: He kept raining down manna for them to eat;He gave them the grain of heaven.

15210.label: Psalms 78:25
15210.text: Men ate the bread of mighty ones; He provided enough to satisfy them.

15211.label: Psalms 78:26
15211.text: He stirred up the east wind in the heavensAnd made a south wind blow by his power.

15212.label: Psalms 78:27
15212.text: And he rained down meat on them like dust,Birds like the sand of the seashore.

15213.label: Psalms 78:28
15213.text: He made them fall in the midst of his camp,All around his tents.

15214.label: Psalms 78:29
15214.text: And they ate and gorged themselves;He gave them what they desired.

15215.label: Psalms 78:30
15215.text: But before they fully satisfied their craving,While their food was yet in their mouth,

15216.label: Psalms 78:31
15216.text: God’s wrath flared up against them. He put to death their strongest men; He brought down the young men of Israel.

15217.label: Psalms 78:32
15217.text: Despite this they sinned even more And did not put faith in his wonderful works.

15218.label: Psalms 78:33
15218.text: So he brought their days to an end as if a mere breath, And their years by sudden terrors.

15219.label: Psalms 78:34
15219.text: But as often as he killed them, they would search for him; They would return and look for God,

15220.label: Psalms 78:35
15220.text: Remembering that God was their Rock And that the Most High God was their Redeemer.

15221.label: Psalms 78:36
15221.text: But they tried to deceive him with their mouthAnd lied to him with their tongue.

15222.label: Psalms 78:37
15222.text: Their heart was not steadfast toward him; And they were not faithful to his covenant.

15223.label: Psalms 78:38
15223.text: But he was merciful; He would forgive their error and not bring them to ruin. He often held back his anger Instead of stirring up all his wrath.

15224.label: Psalms 78:39
15224.text: For he remembered that they were flesh, A wind that blows past and does not return.

15225.label: Psalms 78:40
15225.text: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness And made him feel hurt in the desert!

15226.label: Psalms 78:41
15226.text: Again and again they put God to the test, And they grieved the Holy One of Israel.

15227.label: Psalms 78:42
15227.text: They did not remember his power, The day that he rescued them from the adversary,

15228.label: Psalms 78:43
15228.text: How he displayed his signs in Egypt And his miracles in the region of Zoʹan,

15229.label: Psalms 78:44
15229.text: And how he turned the Nile canals into blood So that they could not drink from their streams.

15230.label: Psalms 78:45
15230.text: He sent swarms of gadflies to devour them And frogs to bring them to ruin.

15231.label: Psalms 78:46
15231.text: He gave their crops to the voracious locusts,The fruit of their labor to the swarming locusts.

15232.label: Psalms 78:47
15232.text: He destroyed their vines with hail And their sycamore trees with hailstones.

15233.label: Psalms 78:48
15233.text: He gave their beasts of burden over to the hail And their livestock to the lightning bolts.

15234.label: Psalms 78:49
15234.text: He inflicted his burning anger on them,Fury and indignation and distress,Companies of angels bringing calamity.

15235.label: Psalms 78:50
15235.text: He cleared a pathway for his anger. He did not spare them from death;And he gave them over to pestilence.

15236.label: Psalms 78:51
15236.text: Finally he struck down all the firstborn of Egypt, The beginning of their procreative power in the tents of Ham.

15237.label: Psalms 78:52
15237.text: Then he brought his people out like a flock And guided them like a drove in the wilderness.

15238.label: Psalms 78:53
15238.text: He led them in security,And they felt no fear; The sea covered their enemies.

15239.label: Psalms 78:54
15239.text: And he brought them to his holy territory, This mountainous region that his right hand acquired.

15240.label: Psalms 78:55
15240.text: He drove out the nations from before them; He allotted to them an inheritance by the measuring line; He settled the tribes of Israel in their homes.

15241.label: Psalms 78:56
15241.text: But they kept challenging God the Most High, and rebelling against him; They did not pay attention to his reminders.

15242.label: Psalms 78:57
15242.text: They also turned away and were as treacherous as their forefathers. They were as unreliable as a loose bow.

15243.label: Psalms 78:58
15243.text: They kept offending him with their high places, And they incited him to fury with their carved images.

15244.label: Psalms 78:59
15244.text: God heard and became furious, So he utterly rejected Israel.

15245.label: Psalms 78:60
15245.text: He finally forsook the tabernacle of Shiʹloh, The tent where he had resided among men.

15246.label: Psalms 78:61
15246.text: He let the symbol of his strength go into captivity;His splendor into the hand of the adversary.

15247.label: Psalms 78:62
15247.text: He handed his people over to the sword And became furious with his inheritance.

15248.label: Psalms 78:63
15248.text: Fire consumed his young men,And to his virgins no wedding songs were sung.

15249.label: Psalms 78:64
15249.text: His priests fell by the sword, And their own widows did not weep.

15250.label: Psalms 78:65
15250.text: Then Jehovah woke up as from sleep, Like a mighty man waking up from wine.

15251.label: Psalms 78:66
15251.text: And he drove his adversaries back; He put them to lasting disgrace.

15252.label: Psalms 78:67
15252.text: He rejected the tent of Joseph;He did not choose the tribe of Eʹphra·im.

15253.label: Psalms 78:68
15253.text: But he chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which he loves.

15254.label: Psalms 78:69
15254.text: He made his sanctuary as enduring as the heavens, Like the earth that he has established forever.

15255.label: Psalms 78:70
15255.text: He chose David his servantAnd took him from the sheep pens,

15256.label: Psalms 78:71
15256.text: From tending the nursing ewes;He made him the shepherd over Jacob, his people, And over Israel, his inheritance.

15257.label: Psalms 78:72
15257.text: He shepherded them with integrity of heart, And with skillful hands he led them.

15259.label: Psalms 79:1
15259.text: O God, the nations have invaded your inheritance; They have defiled your holy temple; They have turned Jerusalem into a heap of ruins.

15260.label: Psalms 79:2
15260.text: They have given the dead bodies of your servants as food to the birds of the heavensAnd the flesh of your loyal ones to the wild beasts of the earth.

15261.label: Psalms 79:3
15261.text: They have poured out their blood like water around Jerusalem,And no one is left to bury them.

15262.label: Psalms 79:4
15262.text: We have become an object of reproach to our neighbors; Those around us ridicule and jeer us.

15263.label: Psalms 79:5
15263.text: How long, O Jehovah, will you be furious? Forever? How long will your indignation burn just like fire?

15264.label: Psalms 79:6
15264.text: Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not know youAnd on the kingdoms that do not call on your name.

15265.label: Psalms 79:7
15265.text: For they have devoured JacobAnd have desolated his homeland.

15266.label: Psalms 79:8
15266.text: Do not hold us accountable for the errors of our ancestors. Quickly show us your mercy, For we have been brought very low.

15267.label: Psalms 79:9
15267.text: Help us, O God of our salvation, For the sake of your glorious name;Rescue us and forgive our sins for the sake of your name.

15268.label: Psalms 79:10
15268.text: Why should the nations say: “Where is their God?” Before our eyes may it become known among the nationsThat the shed blood of your servants has been avenged.

15269.label: Psalms 79:11
15269.text: May you hear the sighing of the prisoner. Use your great power to preserve those sentenced to death.

15270.label: Psalms 79:12
15270.text: Repay our neighbors sevenfold For the taunts they have leveled at you, O Jehovah.

15271.label: Psalms 79:13
15271.text: Then we, your people and the flock of your pasture, Will give thanks to you forever;And we will declare your praise from generation to generation.

15273.label: Psalms 80:1
15273.text: O Shepherd of Israel, listen,You who are guiding Joseph just like a flock. You who sit enthroned above the cherubs, Shine forth.

15274.label: Psalms 80:2
15274.text: Before Eʹphra·im and Benjamin and Ma·nasʹseh,Do stir up your mightiness; Come and save us.

15275.label: Psalms 80:3
15275.text: O God, restore us; Let your face shine upon us, so that we may be saved.

15276.label: Psalms 80:4
15276.text: Jehovah God of armies, how long will you be hostile toward the prayer of your people?

15277.label: Psalms 80:5
15277.text: You feed them tears as their bread,And you make them drink tears beyond measure.

15278.label: Psalms 80:6
15278.text: You let our neighbors quarrel over us;Our enemies keep mocking us as they please.

15279.label: Psalms 80:7
15279.text: O God of armies, restore us;Let your face shine upon us, so that we may be saved.

15280.label: Psalms 80:8
15280.text: You made a vine depart from Egypt. You drove out the nations and planted it.

15281.label: Psalms 80:9
15281.text: You cleared a space for it,And it took root and filled the land.

15282.label: Psalms 80:10
15282.text: The mountains were covered by its shadow,And the cedars of God by its branches.

15283.label: Psalms 80:11
15283.text: Its branches reached as far as the sea,And its shoots to the River.

15284.label: Psalms 80:12
15284.text: Why have you broken down the stone walls of the vineyard, So that all those passing by pluck its fruit?

15285.label: Psalms 80:13
15285.text: The boars of the forest ravage it,And the wild animals of the field feed on it.

15286.label: Psalms 80:14
15286.text: O God of armies, please return. Look down from heaven and see! Take care of this vine,

15287.label: Psalms 80:15
15287.text: The stock that your right hand has planted, And look upon the son whom you made strong for yourself.

15288.label: Psalms 80:16
15288.text: It is burned with fire, cut down. They perish at your rebuke.

15289.label: Psalms 80:17
15289.text: May your hand give support to the man at your right hand,To the son of man you have made strong for yourself.

15290.label: Psalms 80:18
15290.text: Then we will not turn away from you. Preserve us alive, so that we may call on your name.

15291.label: Psalms 80:19
15291.text: O Jehovah God of armies, restore us;Let your face shine upon us, so that we may be saved.

15293.label: Psalms 81:1
15293.text: Shout joyfully to God our strength. Shout in triumph to the God of Jacob.

15294.label: Psalms 81:2
15294.text: Begin the music and take a tambourine,The melodious harp together with the stringed instrument.

15295.label: Psalms 81:3
15295.text: Blow the horn on the new moon, On the full moon, for the day of our festival.

15296.label: Psalms 81:4
15296.text: For it is a decree for Israel,A ruling of the God of Jacob.

15297.label: Psalms 81:5
15297.text: He established it as a reminder for Joseph When He went out against the land of Egypt. I heard a voice that I did not recognize:

15298.label: Psalms 81:6
15298.text: “I lifted the burden from his shoulder; His hands were freed from the basket.

15299.label: Psalms 81:7
15299.text: In your distress you called, and I rescued you; I answered you from the thundercloud. I tested you at the waters of Merʹi·bah. (Selah)

15300.label: Psalms 81:8
15300.text: Hear, my people, and I will testify against you. O Israel, if you would only listen to me.

15301.label: Psalms 81:9
15301.text: Among you, there will be no strange god,And you will not bow down to a foreign god.

15302.label: Psalms 81:10
15302.text: I, Jehovah, am your God,The one who brought you out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

15303.label: Psalms 81:11
15303.text: But my people did not listen to my voice;Israel would not submit to me.

15304.label: Psalms 81:12
15304.text: So I let them follow their stubborn hearts;They did what they thought was right.

15305.label: Psalms 81:13
15305.text: If only my people would listen to me, If only Israel would walk in my ways!

15306.label: Psalms 81:14
15306.text: Their enemies I would quickly subdue;I would turn my hand against their adversaries.

15307.label: Psalms 81:15
15307.text: Those who hate Jehovah will cringe in his presence,And their outcome will be forever.

15308.label: Psalms 81:16
15308.text: But he will feed you with the finest wheat And satisfy you with honey from the rock.”

15310.label: Psalms 82:1
15310.text: God takes his place in the divine assembly; In the middle of the gods he judges:

15311.label: Psalms 82:2
15311.text: “How long will you continue to judge with injustice And show partiality to the wicked? (Selah)

15312.label: Psalms 82:3
15312.text: Defend the lowly and the fatherless. Render justice to the helpless and destitute.

15313.label: Psalms 82:4
15313.text: Rescue the lowly and the poor;Save them out of the hand of the wicked.”

15314.label: Psalms 82:5
15314.text: They do not know, nor do they understand; They are walking about in darkness;All the foundations of the earth are being shaken.

15315.label: Psalms 82:6
15315.text: “I have said, ‘You are gods, All of you are sons of the Most High.

15316.label: Psalms 82:7
15316.text: But you will die just as men do; And like any other prince you will fall!’”

15317.label: Psalms 82:8
15317.text: Rise up, O God, and judge the earth, For all the nations belong to you.

15319.label: Psalms 83:1
15319.text: O God, do not be silent; Do not keep quiet or still, O Divine One.

15320.label: Psalms 83:2
15320.text: For look! your enemies are in an uproar; Those who hate you act arrogantly.

15321.label: Psalms 83:3
15321.text: With cunning they secretly plot against your people;They conspire against your treasured ones.

15322.label: Psalms 83:4
15322.text: They say: “Come, let us annihilate them as a nation, So that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”

15323.label: Psalms 83:5
15323.text: They devise a unified strategy; They have made an alliance against you —

15324.label: Psalms 83:6
15324.text: The tents of Eʹdom and the Ishʹma·el·ites, Moʹab and the Hagʹrites,

15325.label: Psalms 83:7
15325.text: Geʹbal and Amʹmon and Amʹa·lek,Phi·lisʹti·a together with the inhabitants of Tyre.

15326.label: Psalms 83:8
15326.text: As·syrʹi·a too has joined them;They give support to the sons of Lot. (Selah)

15327.label: Psalms 83:9
15327.text: Do to them as you did to Midʹi·an, As you did to Sisʹe·ra and Jaʹbin at the stream of Kiʹshon.

15328.label: Psalms 83:10
15328.text: They were annihilated at En-dor; They became manure for the ground.

15329.label: Psalms 83:11
15329.text: Make their nobles like Oʹreb and Zeʹeb And their princes like Zeʹbah and Zal·munʹna,

15330.label: Psalms 83:12
15330.text: For they said: “Let us take possession of the land where God dwells.”

15331.label: Psalms 83:13
15331.text: O my God, make them like a whirling thistle, Like stubble blown about by the wind.

15332.label: Psalms 83:14
15332.text: Like a fire that burns up the forest,Like a flame that scorches the mountains,

15333.label: Psalms 83:15
15333.text: So may you pursue them with your tempest And terrify them with your windstorm.

15334.label: Psalms 83:16
15334.text: Cover their faces with dishonor,So that they may search for your name, O Jehovah.

15335.label: Psalms 83:17
15335.text: May they be put to shame and be terrified forever;May they be disgraced and perish;

15336.label: Psalms 83:18
15336.text: May people know that you, whose name is Jehovah, You alone are the Most High over all the earth.

15338.label: Psalms 84:1
15338.text: How lovely your grand tabernacle is, O Jehovah of armies!

15339.label: Psalms 84:2
15339.text: My whole being yearns,Yes, I am faint with longing,For the courtyards of Jehovah. My heart and my flesh shout joyfully to the living God.

15340.label: Psalms 84:3
15340.text: Even the bird finds a home thereAnd the swallow a nest for herself,Where she cares for her youngNear your grand altar, O Jehovah of armies,My King and my God!

15341.label: Psalms 84:4
15341.text: Happy are those dwelling in your house! They continue to praise you. (Selah)

15342.label: Psalms 84:5
15342.text: Happy are the men who find their strength in you, Whose hearts are set on the highways.

15343.label: Psalms 84:6
15343.text: When they pass through the Baʹca Valley, They make it into a place of springs;And the early rain clothes it with blessings.

15344.label: Psalms 84:7
15344.text: They will walk on from strength to strength; Each one appears before God in Zion.

15345.label: Psalms 84:8
15345.text: O Jehovah God of armies, hear my prayer;Listen, O God of Jacob. (Selah)

15346.label: Psalms 84:9
15346.text: Look, our shield and our God, Look upon the face of your anointed one.

15347.label: Psalms 84:10
15347.text: For a day in your courtyards is better than a thousand anywhere else! I choose to stand at the threshold of the house of my GodRather than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

15348.label: Psalms 84:11
15348.text: For Jehovah God is a sun and a shield; He gives favor and glory. Jehovah will not hold back anything goodFrom those walking in integrity.

15349.label: Psalms 84:12
15349.text: O Jehovah of armies,Happy is the man who trusts in you.

15351.label: Psalms 85:1
15351.text: You have shown favor, O Jehovah, to your land; You brought back those of Jacob who were taken captive.

15352.label: Psalms 85:2
15352.text: You have pardoned the error of your people;You forgave all their sin. (Selah)

15353.label: Psalms 85:3
15353.text: You held back all your fury;You turned away from your hot anger.

15354.label: Psalms 85:4
15354.text: Restore us, O God of our salvation,And set aside your displeasure with us.

15355.label: Psalms 85:5
15355.text: Will you be furious with us forever? Will you prolong your anger to generation after generation?

15356.label: Psalms 85:6
15356.text: Will you not revive us againSo that your people may rejoice in you?

15357.label: Psalms 85:7
15357.text: Show your loyal love to us, O Jehovah, And grant us your salvation.

15358.label: Psalms 85:8
15358.text: I will listen to what the true God Jehovah says,For he will speak peace to his people, to his loyal ones,But let them not return to overconfidence.

15359.label: Psalms 85:9
15359.text: Surely his salvation is near to those who fear him, So that his glory may reside in our land.

15360.label: Psalms 85:10
15360.text: Loyal love and faithfulness will meet together;Righteousness and peace will kiss each other.

15361.label: Psalms 85:11
15361.text: Faithfulness will sprout from the earth,And righteousness will look down from the heavens.

15362.label: Psalms 85:12
15362.text: Yes, Jehovah will give what is good, And our land will yield its harvest.

15363.label: Psalms 85:13
15363.text: Righteousness will walk before him And make a path for his footsteps.

15365.label: Psalms 86:1
15365.text: Incline your ear, O Jehovah, and answer me,For I am afflicted and poor.

15366.label: Psalms 86:2
15366.text: Guard my life, for I am loyal. Save your servant who is trusting in you,For you are my God.

15367.label: Psalms 86:3
15367.text: Show me favor, O Jehovah, For I call to you all day long.

15368.label: Psalms 86:4
15368.text: Make your servant rejoice,For to you, O Jehovah, I turn.

15369.label: Psalms 86:5
15369.text: For you, O Jehovah, are good and ready to forgive; You abound in loyal love for all those who call on you.

15370.label: Psalms 86:6
15370.text: Listen, O Jehovah, to my prayer;And pay attention to my pleas for help.

15371.label: Psalms 86:7
15371.text: I call on you in the day of my distress, For you will answer me.

15372.label: Psalms 86:8
15372.text: There is none like you among the gods, O Jehovah, There are no works like yours.

15373.label: Psalms 86:9
15373.text: All the nations that you madeWill come and bow down before you, O Jehovah, And they will give glory to your name.

15374.label: Psalms 86:10
15374.text: For you are great and do wondrous things; You are God, you alone.

15375.label: Psalms 86:11
15375.text: Instruct me, O Jehovah, about your way. I will walk in your truth. Unify my heart to fear your name.

15376.label: Psalms 86:12
15376.text: I praise you, O Jehovah my God, with all my heart, And I will glorify your name forever,

15377.label: Psalms 86:13
15377.text: For your loyal love toward me is great,And you have saved my life from the depths of the Grave.

15378.label: Psalms 86:14
15378.text: O God, presumptuous men rise up against me; A band of ruthless men seek to take my life, And they have no regard for you.

15379.label: Psalms 86:15
15379.text: But you, O Jehovah, are a God merciful and compassionate, Slow to anger and abundant in loyal love and faithfulness.

15380.label: Psalms 86:16
15380.text: Turn to me and show me favor. Give your strength to your servant, And save the son of your slave girl.

15381.label: Psalms 86:17
15381.text: Show me a sign of your goodness,So that those who hate me may see it and be put to shame. For you, O Jehovah, are my helper and comforter.

15383.label: Psalms 87:1
15383.text: His city’s foundation is in the holy mountains.

15384.label: Psalms 87:2
15384.text: Jehovah loves the gates of Zion More than all the tents of Jacob.

15385.label: Psalms 87:3
15385.text: Glorious things are being said about you, O city of the true God. (Selah)

15386.label: Psalms 87:4
15386.text: I will count Raʹhab and Babylon among those who know me;Here are Phi·lisʹti·a and Tyre, together with Cush. It will be said: “This is one who was born there.”

15387.label: Psalms 87:5
15387.text: And about Zion it will be said: “Each and every one was born in her.” And the Most High will firmly establish her.

15388.label: Psalms 87:6
15388.text: Jehovah will declare, when recording the peoples: “This is one who was born there.” (Selah)

15389.label: Psalms 87:7
15389.text: Singers and those performing circle dances will say: “All my springs are in you.”

15391.label: Psalms 88:1
15391.text: O Jehovah, the God of my salvation, By day I cry out,And by night I come before you.

15392.label: Psalms 88:2
15392.text: Let my prayer come to you, Incline your ear to my cry for help.

15393.label: Psalms 88:3
15393.text: For my soul has been filled with calamity, And my life is on the brink of the Grave.

15394.label: Psalms 88:4
15394.text: I am already counted among those going down to the pit; I have become a helpless man,

15395.label: Psalms 88:5
15395.text: Left among the deadLike the slain lying in a grave,Whom you remember no longerAnd who have been separated from your care.

15396.label: Psalms 88:6
15396.text: You have put me in the lowest pit,In dark places, in a large abyss.

15397.label: Psalms 88:7
15397.text: Your rage weighs heavily on me, And you overwhelm me with your crashing waves. (Selah)

15398.label: Psalms 88:8
15398.text: You have driven my acquaintances far away from me; You have made me something detestable to them. I am trapped and cannot escape.

15399.label: Psalms 88:9
15399.text: My eye is worn out because of my affliction. I call on you, O Jehovah, all day long; To you I spread out my hands.

15400.label: Psalms 88:10
15400.text: Will you perform wonders for the dead? Can those powerless in death rise up to praise you? (Selah)

15401.label: Psalms 88:11
15401.text: Will your loyal love be declared in the grave,Your faithfulness in the place of destruction?

15402.label: Psalms 88:12
15402.text: Will your wonders be known in the darknessOr your righteousness in the land of oblivion?

15403.label: Psalms 88:13
15403.text: But I still cry to you for help, O Jehovah, Each morning my prayer comes before you.

15404.label: Psalms 88:14
15404.text: Why, O Jehovah, do you reject me? Why do you hide your face from me?

15405.label: Psalms 88:15
15405.text: From my youth on,I have been afflicted and ready to perish; I am numb from the terrible things you allow me to suffer.

15406.label: Psalms 88:16
15406.text: Your burning anger overwhelms me; Your terrors destroy me.

15407.label: Psalms 88:17
15407.text: They surround me like waters all day long;They close in on me from all sides.

15408.label: Psalms 88:18
15408.text: You have driven my friends and companions far away from me; Darkness has become my companion.

15410.label: Psalms 89:1
15410.text: I will sing about Jehovah’s expressions of loyal love forever. With my mouth I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.

15411.label: Psalms 89:2
15411.text: For I have said: “Loyal love will be built up forever, And you have firmly established your faithfulness in the heavens.”

15412.label: Psalms 89:3
15412.text: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one; I have sworn to David my servant:

15413.label: Psalms 89:4
15413.text: ‘I will firmly establish your offspring forever,And I will build up your throne for all generations.’” (Selah)

15414.label: Psalms 89:5
15414.text: The heavens praise your marvels, O Jehovah,Yes, your faithfulness in the congregation of the holy ones.

15415.label: Psalms 89:6
15415.text: For who in the skies can compare to Jehovah? Who among the sons of God is like Jehovah?

15416.label: Psalms 89:7
15416.text: God is held in awe in the council of holy ones; He is grand and awe-inspiring to all who are around him.

15417.label: Psalms 89:8
15417.text: O Jehovah God of armies,Who is mighty like you, O Jah? Your faithfulness surrounds you.

15418.label: Psalms 89:9
15418.text: You rule over the raging of the sea; When its waves surge, you calm them.

15419.label: Psalms 89:10
15419.text: You have crushed Raʹhab like one who is slain. With your strong arm you have scattered your enemies.

15420.label: Psalms 89:11
15420.text: The heavens are yours, and the earth is yours; The productive land and what fills it —you have founded them.

15421.label: Psalms 89:12
15421.text: The north and the south—you created them;Taʹbor and Herʹmon joyously praise your name.

15422.label: Psalms 89:13
15422.text: Your arm is mighty; Your hand is strong; Your right hand is exalted.

15423.label: Psalms 89:14
15423.text: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne; Loyal love and faithfulness stand before you.

15424.label: Psalms 89:15
15424.text: Happy are the people who know the joyful shouting. O Jehovah, they walk in the light of your face.

15425.label: Psalms 89:16
15425.text: They rejoice in your name all day long,And in your righteousness they are exalted.

15426.label: Psalms 89:17
15426.text: For you are the glory of their strength, And by your approval our strength is exalted.

15427.label: Psalms 89:18
15427.text: For our shield belongs to Jehovah,Our king belongs to the Holy One of Israel.

15428.label: Psalms 89:19
15428.text: At that time you spoke in a vision to your loyal ones and said: “I have granted strength to a mighty one; I have exalted a chosen one from among the people.

15429.label: Psalms 89:20
15429.text: I have found David my servant; With my holy oil I have anointed him.

15430.label: Psalms 89:21
15430.text: My hand will support him, And my arm will strengthen him.

15431.label: Psalms 89:22
15431.text: No enemy will exact tribute from him,And no unrighteous man will oppress him.

15432.label: Psalms 89:23
15432.text: I will crush to pieces his adversaries from before him And strike down those who hate him.

15433.label: Psalms 89:24
15433.text: My faithfulness and loyal love are with him, And in my name his strength will be exalted.

15434.label: Psalms 89:25
15434.text: I will put his hand over the seaAnd his right hand over the rivers.

15435.label: Psalms 89:26
15435.text: He will call out to me: ‘You are my Father,My God and the Rock of my salvation.’

15436.label: Psalms 89:27
15436.text: And I will place him as firstborn, The highest of the kings of the earth.

15437.label: Psalms 89:28
15437.text: I will maintain my loyal love for him forever, And my covenant with him will never fail.

15438.label: Psalms 89:29
15438.text: I will establish his offspring foreverAnd make his throne as enduring as the heavens.

15439.label: Psalms 89:30
15439.text: If his sons leave my lawAnd do not walk according to my decrees,

15440.label: Psalms 89:31
15440.text: If they violate my statutesAnd do not keep my commandments,

15441.label: Psalms 89:32
15441.text: Then I will punish their disobedience with a rod And their error with flogging.

15442.label: Psalms 89:33
15442.text: But I will never abandon my loyal love for him Nor be untrue to my promise.

15443.label: Psalms 89:34
15443.text: I will not violate my covenant Or change what my lips have spoken.

15444.label: Psalms 89:35
15444.text: I have sworn in my holiness, once and for all;I will not tell lies to David.

15445.label: Psalms 89:36
15445.text: His offspring will endure forever; His throne will endure like the sun before me.

15446.label: Psalms 89:37
15446.text: Like the moon, it will be firmly established foreverAs a faithful witness in the skies.” (Selah)

15447.label: Psalms 89:38
15447.text: But you yourself have cast off and rejected him; You have become furious with your anointed one.

15448.label: Psalms 89:39
15448.text: You have spurned the covenant with your servant;You have profaned his crown by throwing it to the ground.

15449.label: Psalms 89:40
15449.text: You have broken down all his stone walls; You have reduced his fortifications to ruins.

15450.label: Psalms 89:41
15450.text: All who pass by have pillaged him;He is a reproach to his neighbors.

15451.label: Psalms 89:42
15451.text: You have made his adversaries victorious; You have caused all his enemies to rejoice.

15452.label: Psalms 89:43
15452.text: You have also driven back his sword,And you have made him lose ground in the battle.

15453.label: Psalms 89:44
15453.text: You have brought an end to his splendorAnd hurled his throne to the ground.

15454.label: Psalms 89:45
15454.text: You have cut short the days of his youth;You have clothed him with shame. (Selah)

15455.label: Psalms 89:46
15455.text: How long, O Jehovah, will you hide yourself? Will it be forever? Will your rage continue to burn like a fire?

15456.label: Psalms 89:47
15456.text: Remember how short my life is! Was it to no purpose that you created all humans?

15457.label: Psalms 89:48
15457.text: What man can live and never see death? Can he save himself from the power of the Grave? (Selah)

15458.label: Psalms 89:49
15458.text: Where are your former acts of loyal love, O Jehovah,That you swore about to David in your faithfulness?

15459.label: Psalms 89:50
15459.text: Remember, O Jehovah, the taunts hurled at your servants;How I have to bear the taunts of all the peoples;

15460.label: Psalms 89:51
15460.text: How your enemies have hurled insults, O Jehovah;How they have insulted every footstep of your anointed one.

15461.label: Psalms 89:52
15461.text: May Jehovah be praised forever. Amen and Amen.

15463.label: Psalms 90:1
15463.text: O Jehovah, you have been our dwelling place throughout all generations.

15464.label: Psalms 90:2
15464.text: Before the mountains were bornOr you brought forth the earth and the productive land, From everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

15465.label: Psalms 90:3
15465.text: You make mortal man return to dust;You say: “Return, you sons of men.”

15466.label: Psalms 90:4
15466.text: For a thousand years are in your eyes just as yesterday when it is past, Just as a watch during the night.

15467.label: Psalms 90:5
15467.text: You sweep them away; they become like mere sleep;In the morning they are like grass that sprouts.

15468.label: Psalms 90:6
15468.text: In the morning it blossoms and is renewed,But by evening it withers and dries up.

15469.label: Psalms 90:7
15469.text: For we are consumed by your anger And terrified by your rage.

15470.label: Psalms 90:8
15470.text: You place our errors in front of you; Our secrets are exposed by the light of your face.

15471.label: Psalms 90:9
15471.text: Our days ebb away because of your fury;And our years come to an end like a whisper.

15472.label: Psalms 90:10
15472.text: The span of our life is 70 years,Or 80 if one is especially strong. But they are filled with trouble and sorrow;They quickly pass by, and away we fly.

15473.label: Psalms 90:11
15473.text: Who can fathom the power of your anger? Your fury is as great as the fear you deserve.

15474.label: Psalms 90:12
15474.text: Teach us how to count our days So that we may acquire a heart of wisdom.

15475.label: Psalms 90:13
15475.text: Return, O Jehovah! How long will this last? Have pity on your servants.

15476.label: Psalms 90:14
15476.text: Satisfy us with your loyal love in the morning,So that we may shout joyfully and rejoice during all our days.

15477.label: Psalms 90:15
15477.text: Make us rejoice in proportion to the days you have afflicted us, For as many years as we have experienced calamity.

15478.label: Psalms 90:16
15478.text: May your servants see your activity,And may their sons see your splendor.

15479.label: Psalms 90:17
15479.text: May the favor of Jehovah our God be upon us;May you prosper the work of our hands. Yes, prosper the work of our hands.

15480.label: Psalms 91:1
15480.text: Anyone dwelling in the secret place of the Most High Will lodge under the shadow of the Almighty.

15481.label: Psalms 91:2
15481.text: I will say to Jehovah: “You are my refuge and my stronghold, My God in whom I trust.”

15482.label: Psalms 91:3
15482.text: For he will rescue you from the trap of the birdcatcher,From the destructive pestilence.

15483.label: Psalms 91:4
15483.text: With his pinions he will cover you,And under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness will be a large shield and a protective wall.

15484.label: Psalms 91:5
15484.text: You will not fear the terrors of the night, Nor the arrow that flies by day,

15485.label: Psalms 91:6
15485.text: Nor the pestilence that stalks in the gloom,Nor the destruction that ravages at midday.

15486.label: Psalms 91:7
15486.text: A thousand will fall at your sideAnd ten thousand at your right hand,But to you it will not come near.

15487.label: Psalms 91:8
15487.text: You will only see it with your eyesAs you witness the punishment of the wicked.

15488.label: Psalms 91:9
15488.text: Because you said: “Jehovah is my refuge,” You have made the Most High your dwelling;

15489.label: Psalms 91:10
15489.text: No disaster will befall you, And no plague will come near your tent.

15490.label: Psalms 91:11
15490.text: For he will give his angels a command concerning you,To guard you in all your ways.

15491.label: Psalms 91:12
15491.text: They will carry you on their hands, So that you may not strike your foot against a stone.

15492.label: Psalms 91:13
15492.text: On the young lion and the cobra you will tread;You will trample underfoot the maned lion and the big snake.

15493.label: Psalms 91:14
15493.text: God said: “Because he has affection for me, I will rescue him. I will protect him because he knows my name.

15494.label: Psalms 91:15
15494.text: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in distress. I will rescue him and glorify him.

15495.label: Psalms 91:16
15495.text: I will satisfy him with long life, And I will cause him to see my acts of salvation.”

15497.label: Psalms 92:1
15497.text: It is good to give thanks to Jehovah And to sing praises to your name, O Most High,

15498.label: Psalms 92:2
15498.text: To declare your loyal love in the morningAnd your faithfulness during the nights,

15499.label: Psalms 92:3
15499.text: Accompanied by a ten-stringed instrument and a lute,By the melodious sound of a harp.

15500.label: Psalms 92:4
15500.text: For you have made me rejoice, O Jehovah, because of your deeds;Because of the works of your hands I shout joyfully.

15501.label: Psalms 92:5
15501.text: How great your works are, O Jehovah! How very deep your thoughts are!

15502.label: Psalms 92:6
15502.text: No unreasoning man can know them;And no foolish person can understand this:

15503.label: Psalms 92:7
15503.text: When the wicked sprout like weeds And all the wrongdoers flourish,It is that they may be annihilated forever.

15504.label: Psalms 92:8
15504.text: But you are exalted forever, O Jehovah.

15505.label: Psalms 92:9
15505.text: Indeed, look in triumph on your enemies, O Jehovah,Look at how your enemies will perish;All the wrongdoers will be scattered.

15506.label: Psalms 92:10
15506.text: But you will exalt my strength like that of a wild bull;I will moisten my skin with fresh oil.

15507.label: Psalms 92:11
15507.text: My eyes will look in triumph on my foes; My ears will hear about the downfall of the evil men who attack me.

15508.label: Psalms 92:12
15508.text: But the righteous will flourish like a palm treeAnd grow big like a cedar in Lebʹa·non.

15509.label: Psalms 92:13
15509.text: They are planted in the house of Jehovah;They flourish in the courtyards of our God.

15510.label: Psalms 92:14
15510.text: Even in old age they will still be thriving; They will remain vigorous and fresh,

15511.label: Psalms 92:15
15511.text: Declaring that Jehovah is upright. He is my Rock, in whom there is no unrighteousness.

15512.label: Psalms 93:1
15512.text: Jehovah has become King! With grandeur he is clothed;Jehovah is clothed with strength;He wears it like a belt. The earth is firmly established;It cannot be moved.

15513.label: Psalms 93:2
15513.text: Your throne was firmly established long ago; From eternity you have existed.

15514.label: Psalms 93:3
15514.text: The rivers have surged, O Jehovah,The rivers have surged and roared;The rivers keep surging and pounding.

15515.label: Psalms 93:4
15515.text: Above the sound of many waters,Mightier than the breaking waves of the sea, Jehovah is majestic in the heights.

15516.label: Psalms 93:5
15516.text: Your reminders are very trustworthy. Holiness adorns your house, O Jehovah, for all times.

15517.label: Psalms 94:1
15517.text: O God of vengeance, Jehovah, O God of vengeance, shine forth!

15518.label: Psalms 94:2
15518.text: Rise up, O Judge of the earth. Repay to the haughty what they deserve.

15519.label: Psalms 94:3
15519.text: How long will the wicked, O Jehovah,How long will the wicked continue to exult?

15520.label: Psalms 94:4
15520.text: They babble and speak arrogantly;All the wrongdoers brag about themselves.

15521.label: Psalms 94:5
15521.text: They crush your people, O Jehovah, And oppress your inheritance.

15522.label: Psalms 94:6
15522.text: They kill the widow and the foreign resident,And they murder the fatherless children.

15523.label: Psalms 94:7
15523.text: They say: “Jah does not see; The God of Jacob does not take notice of it.”

15524.label: Psalms 94:8
15524.text: Understand this, you who are unreasoning;You foolish ones, when will you ever show insight?

15525.label: Psalms 94:9
15525.text: The One who made the ear, can he not hear? The One who formed the eye, can he not see?

15526.label: Psalms 94:10
15526.text: The One correcting the nations, can he not reprove? He is the One who imparts knowledge to people!

15527.label: Psalms 94:11
15527.text: Jehovah knows the thoughts of men,That they are but a mere breath.

15528.label: Psalms 94:12
15528.text: Happy is the man whom you correct, O Jah, Whom you teach from your law,

15529.label: Psalms 94:13
15529.text: To give him tranquility during days of calamity,Until a pit is dug for the wicked.

15530.label: Psalms 94:14
15530.text: For Jehovah will not forsake his people, Nor will he abandon his inheritance.

15531.label: Psalms 94:15
15531.text: For judgment will once again be righteous,And all the upright in heart will follow it.

15532.label: Psalms 94:16
15532.text: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will take a stand for me against the wrongdoers?

15533.label: Psalms 94:17
15533.text: If Jehovah had not been my helper,I would soon have perished.

15534.label: Psalms 94:18
15534.text: When I said: “My foot is slipping,” Your loyal love, O Jehovah, kept supporting me.

15535.label: Psalms 94:19
15535.text: When anxieties overwhelmed me, You comforted and soothed me.

15536.label: Psalms 94:20
15536.text: Can a throne of corruption be allied with youWhile it is framing trouble in the name of the law?

15537.label: Psalms 94:21
15537.text: They make vicious attacks on the righteous one And condemn the innocent one to death.

15538.label: Psalms 94:22
15538.text: But Jehovah will become a secure refuge for me,My God is my rock of refuge.

15539.label: Psalms 94:23
15539.text: He will make their wicked deeds come back upon them. He will do away with them by means of their own evil. Jehovah our God will do away with them.

15540.label: Psalms 95:1
15540.text: Come, let us shout joyfully to Jehovah! Let us shout in triumph to our Rock of salvation.

15541.label: Psalms 95:2
15541.text: Let us come into his presence with thanksgiving; Let us sing and shout in triumph to him.

15542.label: Psalms 95:3
15542.text: For Jehovah is a great God,A great King over all other gods.

15543.label: Psalms 95:4
15543.text: In his hand are the depths of the earth;The mountain peaks belong to him.

15544.label: Psalms 95:5
15544.text: The sea, which he made, belongs to him, And his hands formed the dry land.

15545.label: Psalms 95:6
15545.text: Come, let us worship and bow down;Let us kneel before Jehovah our Maker.

15546.label: Psalms 95:7
15546.text: For he is our God,And we are the people of his pasture,The sheep in his care. Today if you listen to his voice,

15547.label: Psalms 95:8
15547.text: Do not harden your heart as at Merʹi·bah, As in the day of Masʹsah in the wilderness,

15548.label: Psalms 95:9
15548.text: When your forefathers tested me; They challenged me, though they had seen my works.

15549.label: Psalms 95:10
15549.text: For 40 years I felt a loathing toward that generation, and I said: “They are a people who always go astray in their hearts;They have not come to know my ways.”

15550.label: Psalms 95:11
15550.text: So I swore in my anger: “They will not enter into my rest.”

15551.label: Psalms 96:1
15551.text: Sing to Jehovah a new song. Sing to Jehovah, all the earth!

15552.label: Psalms 96:2
15552.text: Sing to Jehovah; praise his name. Proclaim the good news of his salvation day after day.

15553.label: Psalms 96:3
15553.text: Declare his glory among the nations,His wonderful works among all the peoples.

15554.label: Psalms 96:4
15554.text: Jehovah is great and most worthy of praise. He is more awe-inspiring than all other gods.

15555.label: Psalms 96:5
15555.text: All the gods of the peoples are worthless gods, But Jehovah is the one who made the heavens.

15556.label: Psalms 96:6
15556.text: In his presence are majesty and splendor; Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

15557.label: Psalms 96:7
15557.text: Give Jehovah his due, you families of the peoples,Give Jehovah his due for his glory and strength.

15558.label: Psalms 96:8
15558.text: Give Jehovah the glory due his name; Bring a gift and come into his courtyards.

15559.label: Psalms 96:9
15559.text: Bow down to Jehovah in holy adornment; Tremble before him, all the earth!

15560.label: Psalms 96:10
15560.text: Declare among the nations: “Jehovah has become King! The earth is firmly established, it cannot be moved. He will judge the peoples fairly.”

15561.label: Psalms 96:11
15561.text: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be joyful;Let the sea thunder and all that fills it;

15562.label: Psalms 96:12
15562.text: Let the fields and everything in them rejoice. At the same time let all the trees of the forest shout joyfully

15563.label: Psalms 96:13
15563.text: Before Jehovah, for he is coming, He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the inhabited earth with righteousness And the peoples with his faithfulness.

15564.label: Psalms 97:1
15564.text: Jehovah has become King! Let the earth be joyful. Let the many islands rejoice.

15565.label: Psalms 97:2
15565.text: Clouds and thick gloom are all around him; Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

15566.label: Psalms 97:3
15566.text: Fire goes before him And consumes his adversaries on every side.

15567.label: Psalms 97:4
15567.text: His lightning bolts light up the land;The earth sees it and trembles.

15568.label: Psalms 97:5
15568.text: The mountains melt like wax before Jehovah, Before the Lord of the whole earth.

15569.label: Psalms 97:6
15569.text: The heavens proclaim his righteousness,And all the peoples see his glory.

15570.label: Psalms 97:7
15570.text: Let all those serving any carved image be put to shame, Those who boast about their worthless gods. Bow down to him, all you gods.

15571.label: Psalms 97:8
15571.text: Zion hears and rejoices; The towns of Judah are joyfulBecause of your judgments, O Jehovah.

15572.label: Psalms 97:9
15572.text: For you, O Jehovah, are the Most High over all the earth;You are exalted far above all other gods.

15573.label: Psalms 97:10
15573.text: O you who love Jehovah, hate what is bad. He is guarding the lives of his loyal ones; He rescues them from the hand of the wicked.

15574.label: Psalms 97:11
15574.text: Light has flashed up for the righteous And rejoicing for those upright in heart.

15575.label: Psalms 97:12
15575.text: Rejoice in Jehovah, you righteous ones,And give thanks to his holy name.

15577.label: Psalms 98:1
15577.text: Sing to Jehovah a new song, For he has done wonderful things. His right hand, his holy arm, has brought about salvation.

15578.label: Psalms 98:2
15578.text: Jehovah has made known his salvation; He has revealed his righteousness before the nations.

15579.label: Psalms 98:3
15579.text: He has remembered his loyal love and faithfulness to the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation by our God.

15580.label: Psalms 98:4
15580.text: Shout in triumph to Jehovah, all the earth. Be cheerful and shout joyfully and sing praises.

15581.label: Psalms 98:5
15581.text: Sing praises to Jehovah with the harp,With the harp and the melodious song.

15582.label: Psalms 98:6
15582.text: With the trumpets and the sound of the horn, Shout in triumph before the King, Jehovah.

15583.label: Psalms 98:7
15583.text: Let the sea thunder and all that fills it,The earth and those dwelling in it.

15584.label: Psalms 98:8
15584.text: Let the rivers clap their hands;Let the mountains shout joyfully together

15585.label: Psalms 98:9
15585.text: Before Jehovah, for he is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the inhabited earth with righteousness And the peoples with fairness.

15586.label: Psalms 99:1
15586.text: Jehovah has become King. Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned above the cherubs. Let the earth shake.

15587.label: Psalms 99:2
15587.text: Jehovah is great in Zion,And he is high over all the peoples.

15588.label: Psalms 99:3
15588.text: Let them praise your great name, For it is awe-inspiring and holy.

15589.label: Psalms 99:4
15589.text: He is a mighty king who loves justice. You have firmly established what is upright. You have brought about justice and righteousness in Jacob.

15590.label: Psalms 99:5
15590.text: Exalt Jehovah our God and bow down at his footstool; He is holy.

15591.label: Psalms 99:6
15591.text: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, And Samuel was among those calling on his name. They would call to Jehovah,And he would answer them.

15592.label: Psalms 99:7
15592.text: He would speak to them from the pillar of cloud. They kept his reminders and the decree that he gave to them.

15593.label: Psalms 99:8
15593.text: O Jehovah our God, you answered them. You were a God who pardoned them, But you punished them for their sinful deeds.

15594.label: Psalms 99:9
15594.text: Exalt Jehovah our God And bow down before his holy mountain, For Jehovah our God is holy.

15596.label: Psalms 100:1
15596.text: Shout in triumph to Jehovah, all the earth.

15597.label: Psalms 100:2
15597.text: Serve Jehovah with rejoicing. Come into his presence with joyful shouting.

15598.label: Psalms 100:3
15598.text: Know that Jehovah is God. He is the one who made us, and we belong to him. We are his people and the sheep of his pasture.

15599.label: Psalms 100:4
15599.text: Come into his gates with thanksgiving, Into his courtyards with praise. Give thanks to him; praise his name.

15600.label: Psalms 100:5
15600.text: For Jehovah is good; His loyal love endures forever,And his faithfulness through all generations.

15602.label: Psalms 101:1
15602.text: I will sing about loyal love and justice. To you, O Jehovah, I will sing praises.

15603.label: Psalms 101:2
15603.text: I will act with discretion and blamelessness. When will you come to me? I will walk with integrity of heart inside my house.

15604.label: Psalms 101:3
15604.text: I will not set anything worthless before my eyes. I hate the deeds of those who deviate from what is right; I will have nothing to do with them.

15605.label: Psalms 101:4
15605.text: A crooked heart is far from me;I will not accept what is bad.

15606.label: Psalms 101:5
15606.text: Anyone slandering his neighbor in secret, I will silence. Anyone with haughty eyes and an arrogant heart,I will not tolerate.

15607.label: Psalms 101:6
15607.text: I will look to the faithful ones of the earth,So that they may dwell with me. The one walking in blamelessness will minister to me.

15608.label: Psalms 101:7
15608.text: No deceitful person will dwell in my house,And no liar will stand in my presence.

15609.label: Psalms 101:8
15609.text: Every morning I will silence all the wicked of the earth,To cut off all wrongdoers from the city of Jehovah.

15611.label: Psalms 102:1
15611.text: O Jehovah, hear my prayer; Let my cry for help reach you.

15612.label: Psalms 102:2
15612.text: Do not hide your face from me in my time of distress. Incline your ear to me;Do answer me quickly when I call.

15613.label: Psalms 102:3
15613.text: For my days are vanishing like smoke,And my bones are charred like a fireplace.

15614.label: Psalms 102:4
15614.text: My heart has been struck down like grass and has withered, For I forget to eat my food.

15615.label: Psalms 102:5
15615.text: Because of my loud groaning, My bones cling to my flesh.

15616.label: Psalms 102:6
15616.text: I resemble the pelican of the wilderness;I am like a little owl among the ruins.

15617.label: Psalms 102:7
15617.text: I lie awake; I am like a solitary bird on a roof.

15618.label: Psalms 102:8
15618.text: All day long my enemies taunt me. Those who mock me use my name as a curse.

15619.label: Psalms 102:9
15619.text: For I eat ashes as my bread, And my drink is mingled with tears,

15620.label: Psalms 102:10
15620.text: Because of your anger and your indignation,For you lifted me up only to cast me aside.

15621.label: Psalms 102:11
15621.text: My days are like a fading shadow, And I am withering like grass.

15622.label: Psalms 102:12
15622.text: But you remain forever, O Jehovah, And your fame will endure for all generations.

15623.label: Psalms 102:13
15623.text: Surely you will rise up and show mercy on Zion, For it is time to show her your favor; The appointed time has come.

15624.label: Psalms 102:14
15624.text: For your servants find pleasure in her stones And have affection even for her dust.

15625.label: Psalms 102:15
15625.text: The nations will fear the name of Jehovah,And all the kings of the earth your glory.

15626.label: Psalms 102:16
15626.text: For Jehovah will rebuild Zion; He will appear in his glory.

15627.label: Psalms 102:17
15627.text: He will pay attention to the prayer of the destitute; He will not despise their prayer.

15628.label: Psalms 102:18
15628.text: This is written for the future generation, So that a people yet to be brought forth will praise Jah.

15629.label: Psalms 102:19
15629.text: For he looks down from his holy height, From the heavens Jehovah views the earth,

15630.label: Psalms 102:20
15630.text: To hear the sighing of the prisoner, To release those sentenced to death,

15631.label: Psalms 102:21
15631.text: So that the name of Jehovah will be declared in Zion And his praise in Jerusalem,

15632.label: Psalms 102:22
15632.text: When the peoples and kingdomsGather together to serve Jehovah.

15633.label: Psalms 102:23
15633.text: He prematurely robbed me of my strength;He cut short my days.

15634.label: Psalms 102:24
15634.text: I said: “O my God,Do not do away with me in the middle of my life,You whose years span all generations.

15635.label: Psalms 102:25
15635.text: Long ago you laid the foundations of the earth,And the heavens are the work of your hands.

15636.label: Psalms 102:26
15636.text: They will perish, but you will remain;Just like a garment they will all wear out. Just like clothing you will replace them, and they will pass away.

15637.label: Psalms 102:27
15637.text: But you are the same, and your years will never end.

15638.label: Psalms 102:28
15638.text: The children of your servants will dwell securely,And their offspring will be firmly established before you.”

15640.label: Psalms 103:1
15640.text: Let me praise Jehovah;Let everything within me praise his holy name.

15641.label: Psalms 103:2
15641.text: Let me praise Jehovah;May I never forget all that he has done.

15642.label: Psalms 103:3
15642.text: He forgives all your errors And heals all your ailments;

15643.label: Psalms 103:4
15643.text: He reclaims your life from the pit And crowns you with his loyal love and mercy.

15644.label: Psalms 103:5
15644.text: He satisfies you with good things all your life,So that your youth is renewed like that of an eagle.

15645.label: Psalms 103:6
15645.text: Jehovah acts with righteousness and justiceFor all who are oppressed.

15646.label: Psalms 103:7
15646.text: He made known his ways to Moses, His deeds to the sons of Israel.

15647.label: Psalms 103:8
15647.text: Jehovah is merciful and compassionate, Slow to anger and abundant in loyal love.

15648.label: Psalms 103:9
15648.text: He will not always find fault, Nor will he stay resentful forever.

15649.label: Psalms 103:10
15649.text: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, Nor has he repaid us what our errors deserve.

15650.label: Psalms 103:11
15650.text: For as the heavens are higher than the earth,So great is his loyal love toward those who fear him.

15651.label: Psalms 103:12
15651.text: As far off as the sunrise is from the sunset,So far off from us he has put our transgressions.

15652.label: Psalms 103:13
15652.text: As a father shows mercy to his sons,Jehovah has shown mercy to those who fear him.

15653.label: Psalms 103:14
15653.text: For he well knows how we are formed, Remembering that we are dust.

15654.label: Psalms 103:15
15654.text: As for mortal man, his days are like those of grass; He blooms like a blossom of the field.

15655.label: Psalms 103:16
15655.text: But when a wind blows, it is no more,As though it was never there.

15656.label: Psalms 103:17
15656.text: But the loyal love of Jehovah is for all eternity Toward those who fear him, And his righteousness toward their children’s children,

15657.label: Psalms 103:18
15657.text: Toward those who keep his covenant And those who are careful to observe his orders.

15658.label: Psalms 103:19
15658.text: Jehovah has firmly established his throne in the heavens; And his kingship rules over everything.

15659.label: Psalms 103:20
15659.text: Praise Jehovah, all you his angels, mighty in power,Who carry out his word, obeying his voice.

15660.label: Psalms 103:21
15660.text: Praise Jehovah, all his armies, His ministers who do his will.

15661.label: Psalms 103:22
15661.text: Praise Jehovah, all his works,In all the places where he rules. Let my whole being praise Jehovah.

15662.label: Psalms 104:1
15662.text: Let me praise Jehovah. O Jehovah my God, you are very great. With majesty and splendor you are clothed.

15663.label: Psalms 104:2
15663.text: You are wrapped in light as with a garment;You stretch out the heavens like a tent cloth.

15664.label: Psalms 104:3
15664.text: He lays beams of his upper rooms in the waters above, Making the clouds his chariot, Moving on the wings of the wind.

15665.label: Psalms 104:4
15665.text: He makes his angels spirits,His ministers a consuming fire.

15666.label: Psalms 104:5
15666.text: He has established the earth on its foundations; It will not be moved from its place forever and ever.

15667.label: Psalms 104:6
15667.text: You covered it with deep waters as with a garment. The waters stood above the mountains.

15668.label: Psalms 104:7
15668.text: At your rebuke they fled; At the sound of your thunder they ran away in panic

15669.label: Psalms 104:8
15669.text: —Mountains ascended and valleys descended—To the place you established for them.

15670.label: Psalms 104:9
15670.text: You set a boundary that they should not pass, That they should never again cover the earth.

15671.label: Psalms 104:10
15671.text: He sends springs into the valleys; Between the mountains they flow.

15672.label: Psalms 104:11
15672.text: They provide water for all the wild beasts of the field;The wild donkeys quench their thirst.

15673.label: Psalms 104:12
15673.text: Above them roost the birds of the sky;They sing among the thick foliage.

15674.label: Psalms 104:13
15674.text: He is watering the mountains from his upper rooms. With the fruitage of your works the earth is satisfied.

15675.label: Psalms 104:14
15675.text: He is making grass grow for the cattleAnd vegetation for mankind’s use, To grow food from the land

15676.label: Psalms 104:15
15676.text: And wine that makes man’s heart rejoice, Oil that makes the face shine,And bread that sustains the heart of mortal man.

15677.label: Psalms 104:16
15677.text: The trees of Jehovah are satisfied,The cedars of Lebʹa·non that he planted,

15678.label: Psalms 104:17
15678.text: Where the birds make nests. The home of the stork is in the juniper trees.

15679.label: Psalms 104:18
15679.text: The high mountains are for the mountain goats; The crags are a refuge for the rock badgers.

15680.label: Psalms 104:19
15680.text: He has made the moon to mark the appointed times;The sun well knows when to set.

15681.label: Psalms 104:20
15681.text: You bring darkness, and night falls, When all the wild animals of the forest roam about.

15682.label: Psalms 104:21
15682.text: The young lions roar for their prey And seek their food from God.

15683.label: Psalms 104:22
15683.text: When the sun rises,They withdraw and lie down in their dens.

15684.label: Psalms 104:23
15684.text: Man goes to his work,And he labors until evening.

15685.label: Psalms 104:24
15685.text: How many your works are, O Jehovah! You have made all of them in wisdom. The earth is full of what you have made.

15686.label: Psalms 104:25
15686.text: There is the sea, so great and wide,Teeming with countless living things, both small and great.

15687.label: Psalms 104:26
15687.text: There the ships travel,And Le·viʹa·than, which you formed to play in it.

15688.label: Psalms 104:27
15688.text: All of them wait for youTo give them their food in its season.

15689.label: Psalms 104:28
15689.text: What you give them, they gather. When you open your hand, they are satisfied with good things.

15690.label: Psalms 104:29
15690.text: When you hide your face, they are disturbed. If you take away their spirit, they die and return to the dust.

15691.label: Psalms 104:30
15691.text: If you send out your spirit, they are created, And you renew the surface of the ground.

15692.label: Psalms 104:31
15692.text: The glory of Jehovah will last forever. Jehovah will rejoice in his works.

15693.label: Psalms 104:32
15693.text: He looks at the earth, and it trembles;He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

15694.label: Psalms 104:33
15694.text: I will sing to Jehovah throughout my life;I will sing praises to my God as long as I live.

15695.label: Psalms 104:34
15695.text: Let my thoughts be pleasing to him. I will rejoice in Jehovah.

15696.label: Psalms 104:35
15696.text: The sinners will vanish from the earth,And the wicked will no longer exist. Let me praise Jehovah. Praise Jah!

15697.label: Psalms 105:1
15697.text: Give thanks to Jehovah, call on his name,Make his deeds known among the peoples!

15698.label: Psalms 105:2
15698.text: Sing to him, sing praises to him,Ponder over all his wonderful works.

15699.label: Psalms 105:3
15699.text: Boast about his holy name. Let the hearts of those seeking Jehovah rejoice.

15700.label: Psalms 105:4
15700.text: Search for Jehovah and his strength. Seek his face constantly.

15701.label: Psalms 105:5
15701.text: Remember the wonderful works he has performed,His miracles and the judgments he has pronounced,

15702.label: Psalms 105:6
15702.text: You offspring of Abraham his servant, You sons of Jacob, his chosen ones.

15703.label: Psalms 105:7
15703.text: He is Jehovah our God. His judgments are throughout the earth.

15704.label: Psalms 105:8
15704.text: He remembers his covenant forever, The promise he made, to a thousand generations,

15705.label: Psalms 105:9
15705.text: The covenant he made with Abraham, And the oath he swore to Isaac,

15706.label: Psalms 105:10
15706.text: Which he established as a decree to JacobAnd as a lasting covenant to Israel,

15707.label: Psalms 105:11
15707.text: Saying, “I will give you the land of Caʹnaan As your allotted inheritance.”

15708.label: Psalms 105:12
15708.text: This was when they were few in number, Yes, very few, and they were foreigners in the land.

15709.label: Psalms 105:13
15709.text: They walked about from nation to nation,From one kingdom to another people.

15710.label: Psalms 105:14
15710.text: He did not allow any man to oppress them, But on their account he reproved kings,

15711.label: Psalms 105:15
15711.text: Saying, “Do not touch my anointed ones,And to my prophets do nothing bad.”

15712.label: Psalms 105:16
15712.text: He called down a famine on the land; He cut off their supply of bread.

15713.label: Psalms 105:17
15713.text: He sent ahead of them a manWho was sold to be a slave, Joseph.

15714.label: Psalms 105:18
15714.text: With fetters they bound his feet, His neck was put in irons;

15715.label: Psalms 105:19
15715.text: Until the time that his word proved true, The saying of Jehovah is what refined him.

15716.label: Psalms 105:20
15716.text: The king sent to release him, The ruler of the peoples set him free.

15717.label: Psalms 105:21
15717.text: He made him master of his household,Ruler over all his property,

15718.label: Psalms 105:22
15718.text: To have authority over his princes as he pleased And to teach his elders wisdom.

15719.label: Psalms 105:23
15719.text: Then Israel came into Egypt, And Jacob lived as a foreigner in the land of Ham.

15720.label: Psalms 105:24
15720.text: God made his people very fruitful; He made them mightier than their adversaries,

15721.label: Psalms 105:25
15721.text: Whose hearts he let change to hate his people,To plot against his servants.

15722.label: Psalms 105:26
15722.text: He sent his servant Moses, And Aaron, whom he had chosen.

15723.label: Psalms 105:27
15723.text: They performed his signs among them,His miracles in the land of Ham.

15724.label: Psalms 105:28
15724.text: He sent darkness and the land became dark; They did not rebel against his words.

15725.label: Psalms 105:29
15725.text: He changed their waters into bloodAnd killed their fish.

15726.label: Psalms 105:30
15726.text: Their land swarmed with frogs, Even in the royal chambers.

15727.label: Psalms 105:31
15727.text: He ordered the gadflies to invadeAnd gnats in all their territories.

15728.label: Psalms 105:32
15728.text: He turned their rain to hailAnd sent lightning on their land.

15729.label: Psalms 105:33
15729.text: He struck their vines and their fig treesAnd shattered the trees of their territory.

15730.label: Psalms 105:34
15730.text: He said that the locusts should invade,Young locusts without number.

15731.label: Psalms 105:35
15731.text: They devoured all the vegetation in the land,And they devoured the produce of the ground.

15732.label: Psalms 105:36
15732.text: Then he struck down every firstborn in their land, The beginning of their procreative power.

15733.label: Psalms 105:37
15733.text: He brought his people out with silver and gold; And no one among his tribes stumbled.

15734.label: Psalms 105:38
15734.text: Egypt rejoiced when they left,For the dread of Israel had fallen on them.

15735.label: Psalms 105:39
15735.text: He spread a cloud to screen them off And fire to give light by night.

15736.label: Psalms 105:40
15736.text: They asked, and he brought quail; He kept satisfying them with bread from heaven.

15737.label: Psalms 105:41
15737.text: He opened a rock, and waters flowed out; These flowed through the desert like a river.

15738.label: Psalms 105:42
15738.text: For he remembered the holy promise he had made to Abraham his servant.

15739.label: Psalms 105:43
15739.text: So he brought out his people with exultation, His chosen ones with a joyful cry.

15740.label: Psalms 105:44
15740.text: He gave them the lands of nations; They inherited what other peoples had worked hard to produce,

15741.label: Psalms 105:45
15741.text: So that they would keep his decrees And observe his laws. Praise Jah!

15742.label: Psalms 106:1
15742.text: Praise Jah! Give thanks to Jehovah, for he is good; His loyal love endures forever.

15743.label: Psalms 106:2
15743.text: Who can fully declare Jehovah’s mighty actsOr proclaim all his praiseworthy deeds?

15744.label: Psalms 106:3
15744.text: Happy are those who act with justice,Who always do what is right.

15745.label: Psalms 106:4
15745.text: Remember me, O Jehovah, when you show favor toward your people. Take care of me with your acts of salvation,

15746.label: Psalms 106:5
15746.text: So that I may enjoy the goodness you show your chosen ones, That I may rejoice along with your nation,That I may proudly praise you along with your inheritance.

15747.label: Psalms 106:6
15747.text: We have sinned just as our forefathers did; We have done wrong; we have acted wickedly.

15748.label: Psalms 106:7
15748.text: Our forefathers in Egypt did not appreciate your wonderful works. They did not remember your abundant loyal love,But they rebelled at the sea, by the Red Sea.

15749.label: Psalms 106:8
15749.text: But he saved them for the sake of his name, To make his mightiness known.

15750.label: Psalms 106:9
15750.text: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up;He led them through its depths as through a desert;

15751.label: Psalms 106:10
15751.text: He saved them from the hand of their foe And reclaimed them from the hand of the enemy.

15752.label: Psalms 106:11
15752.text: The waters covered their adversaries;Not one of them survived.

15753.label: Psalms 106:12
15753.text: Then they had faith in his promise; They began to sing his praise.

15754.label: Psalms 106:13
15754.text: But they quickly forgot what he did; They did not wait for his counsel.

15755.label: Psalms 106:14
15755.text: They gave way to their selfish desires in the wilderness; They tested God in the desert.

15756.label: Psalms 106:15
15756.text: He gave them what they requested,But then struck them with disease that made them waste away.

15757.label: Psalms 106:16
15757.text: In the camp they grew jealous of MosesAnd of Aaron, the holy one of Jehovah.

15758.label: Psalms 106:17
15758.text: The earth then opened up and swallowed DaʹthanAnd covered those assembled with A·biʹram.

15759.label: Psalms 106:18
15759.text: A fire blazed among their group;A flame consumed the wicked.

15760.label: Psalms 106:19
15760.text: They made a calf in HorʹebAnd bowed down to a statue of metal;

15761.label: Psalms 106:20
15761.text: They exchanged my gloryFor the representation of a grass-eating bull.

15762.label: Psalms 106:21
15762.text: They forgot God their Savior,Who did great things in Egypt,

15763.label: Psalms 106:22
15763.text: Wonderful works in the land of Ham, Awe-inspiring deeds at the Red Sea.

15764.label: Psalms 106:23
15764.text: He was about to order their annihilation,But Moses his chosen one interceded with him To avert his destructive anger.

15765.label: Psalms 106:24
15765.text: Then they despised the desirable land; They had no faith in his promise.

15766.label: Psalms 106:25
15766.text: They kept grumbling in their tents; They did not listen to the voice of Jehovah.

15767.label: Psalms 106:26
15767.text: So he raised his hand in an oath concerning themThat he would make them fall in the wilderness;

15768.label: Psalms 106:27
15768.text: He would make their descendants fall among the nations,And he would scatter them throughout the lands.

15769.label: Psalms 106:28
15769.text: Then they joined in worship of Baʹal of Peʹor, And they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.

15770.label: Psalms 106:29
15770.text: They provoked Him by their actions, And a scourge broke out among them.

15771.label: Psalms 106:30
15771.text: But when Phinʹe·has stood up and intervened,The scourge was halted.

15772.label: Psalms 106:31
15772.text: And it was counted to him as righteousnessThrough all generations forever.

15773.label: Psalms 106:32
15773.text: They provoked Him at the waters of Merʹi·bah, And it went badly for Moses because of them.

15774.label: Psalms 106:33
15774.text: They embittered his spirit,And he spoke rashly with his lips.

15775.label: Psalms 106:34
15775.text: They did not annihilate the peoples, As Jehovah had commanded them.

15776.label: Psalms 106:35
15776.text: But they mingled with the nations And adopted their ways.

15777.label: Psalms 106:36
15777.text: They kept serving their idols, And these became a snare to them.

15778.label: Psalms 106:37
15778.text: They would sacrifice their sonsAnd their daughters to demons.

15779.label: Psalms 106:38
15779.text: They kept spilling innocent blood, The blood of their own sons and daughtersWhom they sacrificed to the idols of Caʹnaan; And the land was polluted with bloodshed.

15780.label: Psalms 106:39
15780.text: They became unclean by their works;They committed spiritual prostitution by their deeds.

15781.label: Psalms 106:40
15781.text: So the anger of Jehovah blazed against his people,And he grew to detest his inheritance.

15782.label: Psalms 106:41
15782.text: He repeatedly handed them over to the nations, So that those who hated them might rule over them.

15783.label: Psalms 106:42
15783.text: Their enemies oppressed them,And they were subject to their power.

15784.label: Psalms 106:43
15784.text: Many times he rescued them, But they would rebel and disobey, And they would be brought low for their error.

15785.label: Psalms 106:44
15785.text: But he would see their distress And hear their cry for help.

15786.label: Psalms 106:45
15786.text: For their sake he would remember his covenant,And he would feel pity, moved by his great loyal love.

15787.label: Psalms 106:46
15787.text: He would cause them to be pitiedBy all who held them captive.

15788.label: Psalms 106:47
15788.text: Save us, O Jehovah our God, And gather us from the nations So that we may give thanks to your holy nameAnd exult in praising you.

15789.label: Psalms 106:48
15789.text: May Jehovah, the God of Israel, be praisedThroughout all eternity. And let all the people say, “Amen!” Praise Jah!

15790.label: Psalms 107:1
15790.text: Give thanks to Jehovah, for he is good; His loyal love endures forever.

15791.label: Psalms 107:2
15791.text: Let those reclaimed by Jehovah say this,Those whom he reclaimed from the hand of the adversary,

15792.label: Psalms 107:3
15792.text: Whom he gathered together from the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and from the south.

15793.label: Psalms 107:4
15793.text: They wandered about in the wilderness, in the desert;They did not find a way to a city where they could live.

15794.label: Psalms 107:5
15794.text: They were hungry and thirsty;They were faint from exhaustion.

15795.label: Psalms 107:6
15795.text: They kept crying out to Jehovah in their distress; He rescued them from their plight.

15796.label: Psalms 107:7
15796.text: He had them walk in the right way To come to a city where they could live.

15797.label: Psalms 107:8
15797.text: Let people give thanks to Jehovah for his loyal loveAnd for his wonderful works in behalf of the sons of men.

15798.label: Psalms 107:9
15798.text: For he has satisfied the thirsty And filled the hungry with good things.

15799.label: Psalms 107:10
15799.text: Some were living in deepest darkness,Prisoners in affliction and in irons.

15800.label: Psalms 107:11
15800.text: For they had rebelled against the word of God;They disrespected the counsel of the Most High.

15801.label: Psalms 107:12
15801.text: So he humbled their hearts through hardship; They stumbled, and there was no one to help them.

15802.label: Psalms 107:13
15802.text: They called to Jehovah for help in their distress;He saved them from their plight.

15803.label: Psalms 107:14
15803.text: He brought them out of deepest darkness,And he tore off their shackles.

15804.label: Psalms 107:15
15804.text: Let people give thanks to Jehovah for his loyal love And for his wonderful works in behalf of the sons of men.

15805.label: Psalms 107:16
15805.text: For he has broken down the doors of copperAnd cut through the bars of iron.

15806.label: Psalms 107:17
15806.text: They were foolish and suffered affliction On account of their transgressions and their errors.

15807.label: Psalms 107:18
15807.text: They lost their appetite for all food;They drew near the gates of death.

15808.label: Psalms 107:19
15808.text: They would call to Jehovah for help in their distress;He would save them from their plight.

15809.label: Psalms 107:20
15809.text: He would send his word and heal them And rescue them from the pits they were trapped in.

15810.label: Psalms 107:21
15810.text: Let people give thanks to Jehovah for his loyal loveAnd for his wonderful works in behalf of the sons of men.

15811.label: Psalms 107:22
15811.text: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving And declare his works with a joyful cry.

15812.label: Psalms 107:23
15812.text: Those who travel on the sea in ships,Who ply their trade over the vast waters,

15813.label: Psalms 107:24
15813.text: They have seen the works of JehovahAnd his wonderful works in the deep;

15814.label: Psalms 107:25
15814.text: How by his word a windstorm arises, Lifting up the waves of the sea.

15815.label: Psalms 107:26
15815.text: They rise up to the sky;They plunge down to the depths. Their courage melts away because of the impending calamity.

15816.label: Psalms 107:27
15816.text: They reel and stagger like a drunken man,And all their skill proves useless.

15817.label: Psalms 107:28
15817.text: Then they cry out to Jehovah in their distress, And he rescues them from their plight.

15818.label: Psalms 107:29
15818.text: He calms the windstorm;The waves of the sea grow quiet.

15819.label: Psalms 107:30
15819.text: They rejoice when these grow still,And he leads them to their desired harbor.

15820.label: Psalms 107:31
15820.text: Let people give thanks to Jehovah for his loyal loveAnd for his wonderful works in behalf of the sons of men.

15821.label: Psalms 107:32
15821.text: Let them exalt him in the congregation of the people, And let them praise him in the council of the elders.

15822.label: Psalms 107:33
15822.text: He turns rivers into a desertAnd springs of water into parched ground,

15823.label: Psalms 107:34
15823.text: Fruitful land into salty wasteland, Because of the wickedness of those dwelling in it.

15824.label: Psalms 107:35
15824.text: He turns the desert into reedy pools of water,And dry land into springs of water.

15825.label: Psalms 107:36
15825.text: He causes the hungry to dwell there, So that they may establish a city where they can live.

15826.label: Psalms 107:37
15826.text: They sow fields and plant vineyards That yield fruitful crops.

15827.label: Psalms 107:38
15827.text: He blesses them and they increase greatly;He does not let their cattle diminish.

15828.label: Psalms 107:39
15828.text: But again they become few and are humiliatedBecause of oppression, calamity, and grief.

15829.label: Psalms 107:40
15829.text: He pours out contempt upon noblesAnd makes them wander in trackless wastelands.

15830.label: Psalms 107:41
15830.text: But he protects the poor from oppression And makes their families as numerous as a flock.

15831.label: Psalms 107:42
15831.text: The upright see this and rejoice; But all the unrighteous shut their mouths.

15832.label: Psalms 107:43
15832.text: Whoever is wise will observe these things And will carefully consider Jehovah’s acts of loyal love.

15834.label: Psalms 108:1
15834.text: My heart is steadfast, O God. I will sing and make music with my whole being.

15835.label: Psalms 108:2
15835.text: Do awake, O stringed instrument; you too, O harp. I will awaken the dawn.

15836.label: Psalms 108:3
15836.text: I will praise you among the peoples, O Jehovah,And I will sing praises to you among the nations.

15837.label: Psalms 108:4
15837.text: For your loyal love is great, as high as the heavens, And your faithfulness, up to the skies.

15838.label: Psalms 108:5
15838.text: Be exalted above the heavens, O God;May your glory be over all the earth.

15839.label: Psalms 108:6
15839.text: So that your loved ones may be rescued,Save us with your right hand and answer me.

15840.label: Psalms 108:7
15840.text: God has spoken in his holiness: “I will exult, I will give out Sheʹchem as an inheritance,And I will measure off the Valley of Sucʹcoth.

15841.label: Psalms 108:8
15841.text: Gilʹe·ad belongs to me, as does Ma·nasʹseh,And Eʹphra·im is the helmet for my head; Judah is my commander’s staff.

15842.label: Psalms 108:9
15842.text: Moʹab is my washbasin. Over Eʹdom I will throw my sandal. Over Phi·lisʹti·a I will shout in triumph.”

15843.label: Psalms 108:10
15843.text: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me as far as Eʹdom?

15844.label: Psalms 108:11
15844.text: Is it not you, O God, who have rejected us,Our God, who no longer goes out with our armies?

15845.label: Psalms 108:12
15845.text: Help us in our distress, For salvation by humans is worthless.

15846.label: Psalms 108:13
15846.text: By God we will gain power, And he will trample on our adversaries.

15848.label: Psalms 109:1
15848.text: O God whom I praise, do not remain silent.

15849.label: Psalms 109:2
15849.text: For the wicked and the deceitful open their mouths against me. They speak about me with lying tongues;

15850.label: Psalms 109:3
15850.text: They surround me with hateful words,And they attack me without cause.

15851.label: Psalms 109:4
15851.text: They resist me in response to my love; But I continue to pray.

15852.label: Psalms 109:5
15852.text: They repay me with bad for good And hatred for my love.

15853.label: Psalms 109:6
