15853.text: Appoint a wicked man over him;May a resister stand at his right hand.

15854.label: Psalms 109:7
15854.text: When he is judged, may he be found guilty; May even his prayer be counted as a sin.

15855.label: Psalms 109:8
15855.text: Let his days be few; His office of oversight let someone else take.

15856.label: Psalms 109:9
15856.text: Let his children become fatherless,And his wife, a widow.

15857.label: Psalms 109:10
15857.text: May his children become wandering beggars,Foraging for food from their ruined homes.

15858.label: Psalms 109:11
15858.text: May his creditor seize all that he has,And may strangers plunder his possessions.

15859.label: Psalms 109:12
15859.text: May no one extend kindness to him,And may no one show favor to his fatherless children.

15860.label: Psalms 109:13
15860.text: Let his descendants be cut off; May their name be erased within a generation.

15861.label: Psalms 109:14
15861.text: Let the error of his forefathers be remembered by Jehovah, And may the sin of his mother not be erased.

15862.label: Psalms 109:15
15862.text: May Jehovah always be mindful of what they have done;And may he cut off the memory of them from the earth.

15863.label: Psalms 109:16
15863.text: For he did not remember to show kindness, But he kept pursuing the oppressed, poor, and brokenhearted manTo put him to death.

15864.label: Psalms 109:17
15864.text: He loved to pronounce a curse, so that is what came upon him;He had no desire to bless, so he received no blessing.

15865.label: Psalms 109:18
15865.text: He was clothed with curses as his garment. And they were poured into his body like water,Into his bones like oil.

15866.label: Psalms 109:19
15866.text: May his curses be like the clothing in which he wraps himself And like a belt he always wears.

15867.label: Psalms 109:20
15867.text: This is the payment from Jehovah for the one who resists me And for those who speak evil things against me.

15868.label: Psalms 109:21
15868.text: But you, Jehovah the Sovereign Lord,Act in my behalf for the sake of your name. Rescue me, because your loyal love is good.

15869.label: Psalms 109:22
15869.text: For I am helpless and poor, And my heart has been pierced within me.

15870.label: Psalms 109:23
15870.text: I am passing away like a fading shadow;I have been shaken off like a locust.

15871.label: Psalms 109:24
15871.text: My knees give way from fasting;My body is thin, and I am wasting away.

15872.label: Psalms 109:25
15872.text: I have become the object of their taunts. When they see me, they shake their heads.

15873.label: Psalms 109:26
15873.text: Help me, O Jehovah my God;Save me by your loyal love.

15874.label: Psalms 109:27
15874.text: May they know that this is by your hand;That you, O Jehovah, have done it.

15875.label: Psalms 109:28
15875.text: Let them pronounce a curse, but may you give a blessing. When they rise up against me, may they be put to shame,But let your servant rejoice.

15876.label: Psalms 109:29
15876.text: Let those who resist me be clothed with humiliation;May they be wrapped in their shame as in a robe.

15877.label: Psalms 109:30
15877.text: My mouth will fervently praise Jehovah;I will praise him in front of many people.

15878.label: Psalms 109:31
15878.text: For he will stand at the right hand of the poorTo save him from those who condemn him.

15880.label: Psalms 110:1
15880.text: Jehovah declared to my Lord: “Sit at my right hand Until I place your enemies as a stool for your feet.”

15881.label: Psalms 110:2
15881.text: Jehovah will extend the scepter of your power out of Zion, saying: “Go subduing in the midst of your enemies.”

15882.label: Psalms 110:3
15882.text: Your people will offer themselves willingly on the day of your military force. In splendid holiness, from the womb of the dawn,You have your company of young men just like dewdrops.

15883.label: Psalms 110:4
15883.text: Jehovah has sworn an oath, and he will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever In the manner of Mel·chizʹe·dek!”

15884.label: Psalms 110:5
15884.text: Jehovah will be at your right hand; He will crush kings on the day of his anger.

15885.label: Psalms 110:6
15885.text: He will execute judgment against the nations; He will fill the land with dead bodies. He will crush the leader of a vast land.

15886.label: Psalms 110:7
15886.text: He will drink from the stream along the road. Therefore, he will hold his head high.

15887.label: Psalms 111:1
15887.text: Praise Jah! א [Aleph] I will praise Jehovah with all my heart ב [Beth]In the assembled group of upright ones and in the congregation.

15888.label: Psalms 111:2
15888.text: The works of Jehovah are great; ד [Daleth]They are studied by all those finding pleasure in them.

15889.label: Psalms 111:3
15889.text: His activity is glorious and splendid,ו [Waw]And his righteousness endures forever.

15890.label: Psalms 111:4
15890.text: He causes his wonderful works to be remembered. ח [Heth] Jehovah is compassionate and merciful.

15891.label: Psalms 111:5
15891.text: Food he gives to those fearing him. י [Yod] He remembers his covenant forever.

15892.label: Psalms 111:6
15892.text: He has revealed to his people his powerful worksל [Lamed]By giving them the inheritance of the nations.

15893.label: Psalms 111:7
15893.text: The works of his hands are truth and justice; נ [Nun]Trustworthy are all his orders.

15894.label: Psalms 111:8
15894.text: They are always reliable, now and forever;ע [Ayin]They are made in truth and righteousness.

15895.label: Psalms 111:9
15895.text: He has given redemption to his people. צ [Tsade] He commanded that his covenant should last forever. ק [Qoph] His name is holy and awe-inspiring.

15896.label: Psalms 111:10
15896.text: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom. ש [Sin] All those observing his orders show good insight. ת [Taw] His praise endures forever.

15897.label: Psalms 112:1
15897.text: Praise Jah! א [Aleph] Happy is the man who fears Jehovah, ב [Beth]Who takes great pleasure in his commandments.

15898.label: Psalms 112:2
15898.text: His descendants will be mighty in the earth,ד [Daleth]And the generation of the upright will be blessed.

15899.label: Psalms 112:3
15899.text: Wealth and riches are in his house,ו [Waw]And his righteousness continues forever.

15900.label: Psalms 112:4
15900.text: To the upright he shines like a light in the darkness. ח [Heth] He is compassionate and merciful and righteous.

15901.label: Psalms 112:5
15901.text: It goes well for the man who generously lends. י [Yod] He conducts his affairs with justice.

15902.label: Psalms 112:6
15902.text: He will never be shaken. ל [Lamed] The righteous will be remembered forever.

15903.label: Psalms 112:7
15903.text: He will not fear bad news. נ [Nun] His heart is steadfast, trusting in Jehovah.

15904.label: Psalms 112:8
15904.text: His heart is unshakable; he is not afraid; ע [Ayin]In the end he will look in triumph on his adversaries.

15905.label: Psalms 112:9
15905.text: He has distributed widely; he has given to the poor. צ [Tsade] His righteousness continues forever. ק [Qoph] His own strength will be exalted with glory.

15906.label: Psalms 112:10
15906.text: The wicked one will see and be upset. ש [Shin] He will grind his teeth and melt away. ת [Taw] The desires of the wicked will perish.

15907.label: Psalms 113:1
15907.text: Praise Jah! Offer praise, you servants of Jehovah,Praise the name of Jehovah.

15908.label: Psalms 113:2
15908.text: May Jehovah’s name be praisedFrom now on and forever.

15909.label: Psalms 113:3
15909.text: From the rising of the sun to its setting,Let Jehovah’s name be praised.

15910.label: Psalms 113:4
15910.text: Jehovah is high above all the nations; His glory is above the heavens.

15911.label: Psalms 113:5
15911.text: Who is like Jehovah our God, The one who dwells on high?

15912.label: Psalms 113:6
15912.text: He stoops down to look on heaven and earth,

15913.label: Psalms 113:7
15913.text: Raising the lowly from the dust. He lifts up the poor from the ash heap

15914.label: Psalms 113:8
15914.text: In order to make him sit with nobles,With the nobles of his people.

15915.label: Psalms 113:9
15915.text: He gives the barren woman a homeAs a happy mother with children. Praise Jah!

15916.label: Psalms 114:1
15916.text: When Israel went out of Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people speaking a foreign language,

15917.label: Psalms 114:2
15917.text: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel, his dominion.

15918.label: Psalms 114:3
15918.text: The sea saw it and fled; The Jordan turned back.

15919.label: Psalms 114:4
15919.text: The mountains skipped about like rams, The hills, like lambs.

15920.label: Psalms 114:5
15920.text: What made you flee, O sea? Why, O Jordan, did you turn back?

15921.label: Psalms 114:6
15921.text: Why did you skip about like rams, O mountains,Like lambs, O hills?

15922.label: Psalms 114:7
15922.text: Tremble, O earth, because of the Lord,Because of the God of Jacob,

15923.label: Psalms 114:8
15923.text: Who turns the rock into a reedy pool of water,The flinty rock into springs of water.

15924.label: Psalms 115:1
15924.text: Not to us, O Jehovah, not to us, But to your name give glory Because of your loyal love and your faithfulness.

15925.label: Psalms 115:2
15925.text: Why should the nations say: “Where is their God?”

15926.label: Psalms 115:3
15926.text: Our God is in the heavens;He does whatever he pleases.

15927.label: Psalms 115:4
15927.text: Their idols are silver and gold,The work of human hands.

15928.label: Psalms 115:5
15928.text: A mouth they have, but they cannot speak; Eyes, but they cannot see;

15929.label: Psalms 115:6
15929.text: Ears they have, but they cannot hear;A nose, but they cannot smell;

15930.label: Psalms 115:7
15930.text: Hands they have, but they cannot feel;Feet, but they cannot walk; They make no sound with their throat.

15931.label: Psalms 115:8
15931.text: The people who make them will become just like them, As will all those who trust in them.

15932.label: Psalms 115:9
15932.text: O Israel, trust in Jehovah —He is their help and their shield.

15933.label: Psalms 115:10
15933.text: O house of Aaron, trust in Jehovah—He is their help and their shield.

15934.label: Psalms 115:11
15934.text: You who fear Jehovah, trust in Jehovah —He is their help and their shield.

15935.label: Psalms 115:12
15935.text: Jehovah remembers us and will bless;He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.

15936.label: Psalms 115:13
15936.text: He will bless those who fear Jehovah,The small as well as the great.

15937.label: Psalms 115:14
15937.text: Jehovah will give you an increase,To you and your children.

15938.label: Psalms 115:15
15938.text: May you be blessed by Jehovah, The Maker of heaven and earth.

15939.label: Psalms 115:16
15939.text: As for the heavens, they belong to Jehovah, But the earth he has given to the sons of men.

15940.label: Psalms 115:17
15940.text: The dead do not praise Jah; Nor do any who go down into the silence of death.

15941.label: Psalms 115:18
15941.text: But we will praise JahFrom now on and forever. Praise Jah!

15942.label: Psalms 116:1
15942.text: I love JehovahBecause he hears my voice, my pleas for help.

15943.label: Psalms 116:2
15943.text: For he inclines his ear to me, And I will call on him as long as I live.

15944.label: Psalms 116:3
15944.text: The ropes of death encircled me;The Grave had me in its grip. I was overcome by distress and grief.

15945.label: Psalms 116:4
15945.text: But I called on the name of Jehovah: “O Jehovah, rescue me!”

15946.label: Psalms 116:5
15946.text: Jehovah is compassionate and righteous; Our God is merciful.

15947.label: Psalms 116:6
15947.text: Jehovah is guarding the inexperienced. I was brought low, and he saved me.

15948.label: Psalms 116:7
15948.text: Let my soul rest once again,For Jehovah has dealt kindly with me.

15949.label: Psalms 116:8
15949.text: You have rescued me from death,My eye from tears, my foot from stumbling.

15950.label: Psalms 116:9
15950.text: I will walk before Jehovah in the land of the living.

15951.label: Psalms 116:10
15951.text: I had faith, for I spoke; I was greatly afflicted.

15952.label: Psalms 116:11
15952.text: As for me, I panicked and said: “Every man is a liar.”

15953.label: Psalms 116:12
15953.text: With what will I repay JehovahFor all the good he has done for me?

15954.label: Psalms 116:13
15954.text: I will take up the cup of salvation, And I will call on the name of Jehovah.

15955.label: Psalms 116:14
15955.text: I will pay my vows to JehovahIn the presence of all his people.

15956.label: Psalms 116:15
15956.text: Costly in the eyes of JehovahIs the death of his loyal ones.

15957.label: Psalms 116:16
15957.text: I beg you, O Jehovah,For I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your slave girl. You have freed me from my bonds.

15958.label: Psalms 116:17
15958.text: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving; I will call on the name of Jehovah.

15959.label: Psalms 116:18
15959.text: I will pay my vows to Jehovah In the presence of all his people,

15960.label: Psalms 116:19
15960.text: In the courtyards of the house of Jehovah, In your midst, O Jerusalem. Praise Jah!

15961.label: Psalms 117:1
15961.text: Praise Jehovah, all you nations; Glorify him, all you peoples.

15962.label: Psalms 117:2
15962.text: For his loyal love toward us is great; The faithfulness of Jehovah endures forever. Praise Jah!

15963.label: Psalms 118:1
15963.text: Give thanks to Jehovah, for he is good; His loyal love endures forever.

15964.label: Psalms 118:2
15964.text: Let Israel now say: “His loyal love endures forever.”

15965.label: Psalms 118:3
15965.text: Let those of the house of Aaron now say: “His loyal love endures forever.”

15966.label: Psalms 118:4
15966.text: Let those fearing Jehovah now say: “His loyal love endures forever.”

15967.label: Psalms 118:5
15967.text: I called on Jah in my distress;Jah answered and brought me into a place of safety.

15968.label: Psalms 118:6
15968.text: Jehovah is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

15969.label: Psalms 118:7
15969.text: Jehovah is on my side as my helper; I will look in triumph on those who hate me.

15970.label: Psalms 118:8
15970.text: It is better to take refuge in JehovahThan to trust in humans.

15971.label: Psalms 118:9
15971.text: It is better to take refuge in JehovahThan to trust in princes.

15972.label: Psalms 118:10
15972.text: All the nations surrounded me,But in the name of Jehovah,I warded them off.

15973.label: Psalms 118:11
15973.text: They surrounded me, yes, I was completely surrounded,But in the name of Jehovah,I warded them off.

15974.label: Psalms 118:12
15974.text: They surrounded me like bees,But they were extinguished as quickly as a fire among thorns. In the name of Jehovah,I warded them off.

15975.label: Psalms 118:13
15975.text: I was pushed hard to make me fall,But Jehovah helped me.

15976.label: Psalms 118:14
15976.text: Jah is my shelter and my strength,And he has become my salvation.

15977.label: Psalms 118:15
15977.text: The sound of rejoicing and salvation Is in the tents of the righteous. The right hand of Jehovah is demonstrating its power.

15978.label: Psalms 118:16
15978.text: The right hand of Jehovah is exalting itself;The right hand of Jehovah is demonstrating its power.

15979.label: Psalms 118:17
15979.text: I will not die, no, I will live,In order to declare the works of Jah.

15980.label: Psalms 118:18
15980.text: Jah disciplined me severely, But he did not hand me over to death.

15981.label: Psalms 118:19
15981.text: Open to me the gates of righteousness; I will enter them and praise Jah.

15982.label: Psalms 118:20
15982.text: This is the gate of Jehovah. The righteous will enter through it.

15983.label: Psalms 118:21
15983.text: I will praise you, for you answered me And you became my salvation.

15984.label: Psalms 118:22
15984.text: The stone that the builders rejectedHas become the chief cornerstone.

15985.label: Psalms 118:23
15985.text: This has come from Jehovah; It is wonderful in our eyes.

15986.label: Psalms 118:24
15986.text: This is the day that Jehovah has made;We will be joyful and rejoice in it.

15987.label: Psalms 118:25
15987.text: Jehovah, save us, please, we beg! Jehovah, grant us victory, please!

15988.label: Psalms 118:26
15988.text: Blessed is the one who comes in the name of Jehovah; We bless you from the house of Jehovah.

15989.label: Psalms 118:27
15989.text: Jehovah is God;He gives us light. Join in the festival procession with branches in hand, Up to the horns of the altar.

15990.label: Psalms 118:28
15990.text: You are my God, and I will praise you;My God, I will exalt you.

15991.label: Psalms 118:29
15991.text: Give thanks to Jehovah, for he is good;His loyal love endures forever.

15992.label: Psalms 119:1
15992.text: Happy are those who are blameless in their way,Who walk in the law of Jehovah.

15993.label: Psalms 119:2
15993.text: Happy are those who observe his reminders, Who search for him with all their heart.

15994.label: Psalms 119:3
15994.text: They practice no unrighteousness;They walk in his ways.

15995.label: Psalms 119:4
15995.text: You have commandedThat your orders be carefully kept.

15996.label: Psalms 119:5
15996.text: If only I could remain steadfast So as to observe your regulations!

15997.label: Psalms 119:6
15997.text: Then I would not be put to shame When I consider all your commandments.

15998.label: Psalms 119:7
15998.text: I will praise you with an upright heartWhen I learn your righteous judgments.

15999.label: Psalms 119:8
15999.text: I will observe your regulations. May you never utterly forsake me.

16000.label: Psalms 119:9
16000.text: How can a young man keep his path clean? By keeping on guard according to your word.

16001.label: Psalms 119:10
16001.text: With my whole heart I seek you. Do not let me stray from your commandments.

16002.label: Psalms 119:11
16002.text: In my heart I treasure up your saying So that I may not sin against you.

16003.label: Psalms 119:12
16003.text: May you be praised, O Jehovah;Teach me your regulations.

16004.label: Psalms 119:13
16004.text: With my lips I declareAll the judgments that you have spoken.

16005.label: Psalms 119:14
16005.text: I rejoice over your reminders More than over all other valuable things.

16006.label: Psalms 119:15
16006.text: I will ponder over your orders And keep my eyes on your paths.

16007.label: Psalms 119:16
16007.text: I am fond of your statutes. I will not forget your word.

16008.label: Psalms 119:17
16008.text: Deal kindly with your servant,So that I may live and observe your word.

16009.label: Psalms 119:18
16009.text: Open my eyes so that I may see clearlyThe wonderful things from your law.

16010.label: Psalms 119:19
16010.text: I am but a foreigner in the land. Do not hide your commandments from me.

16011.label: Psalms 119:20
16011.text: I am consumed with longingFor your judgments at all times.

16012.label: Psalms 119:21
16012.text: You rebuke the presumptuous,The cursed ones who stray from your commandments.

16013.label: Psalms 119:22
16013.text: Remove from me scorn and contempt,For I have observed your reminders.

16014.label: Psalms 119:23
16014.text: Even when princes sit together and speak against me,Your servant ponders over your regulations.

16015.label: Psalms 119:24
16015.text: I am fond of your reminders; They are my advisers.

16016.label: Psalms 119:25
16016.text: I lie prostrate in the dust. Preserve me alive according to your word.

16017.label: Psalms 119:26
16017.text: I told you of my ways, and you answered me;Teach me your regulations.

16018.label: Psalms 119:27
16018.text: Make me understand the meaning of your orders,So that I may ponder over your wonderful works.

16019.label: Psalms 119:28
16019.text: I have been sleepless from grief. Strengthen me according to your word.

16020.label: Psalms 119:29
16020.text: Remove from me the way of deception, And favor me with your law.

16021.label: Psalms 119:30
16021.text: The way of faithfulness I have chosen. I recognize that your judgments are right.

16022.label: Psalms 119:31
16022.text: I cling to your reminders. O Jehovah, do not let me be disappointed.

16023.label: Psalms 119:32
16023.text: I will eagerly pursue the way of your commandmentsBecause you make room for it in my heart.

16024.label: Psalms 119:33
16024.text: Teach me, O Jehovah, the way of your regulations,And I will follow it to the end.

16025.label: Psalms 119:34
16025.text: Give me understanding,So that I may observe your lawAnd keep it with my whole heart.

16026.label: Psalms 119:35
16026.text: Guide me in the pathway of your commandments, For in it I take delight.

16027.label: Psalms 119:36
16027.text: Incline my heart to your reminders,Not to selfish gain.

16028.label: Psalms 119:37
16028.text: Turn my eyes away from looking at what is worthless; Preserve me alive in your way.

16029.label: Psalms 119:38
16029.text: Fulfill your promise to your servant,So that you may be feared.

16030.label: Psalms 119:39
16030.text: Remove the disgrace that I dread,For your judgments are good.

16031.label: Psalms 119:40
16031.text: See how I long for your orders. Preserve me alive in your righteousness.

16032.label: Psalms 119:41
16032.text: May I experience your loyal love, O Jehovah, Your salvation in harmony with your promise;

16033.label: Psalms 119:42
16033.text: Then I will reply to the one taunting me,For I put my trust in your word.

16034.label: Psalms 119:43
16034.text: Do not utterly remove the word of truth from my mouth,For I have hoped in your judgment.

16035.label: Psalms 119:44
16035.text: I will keep your law constantly,Forever and ever.

16036.label: Psalms 119:45
16036.text: And I will walk about in a place of safety, For I search for your orders.

16037.label: Psalms 119:46
16037.text: I will speak about your reminders in front of kings,And I will not be ashamed.

16038.label: Psalms 119:47
16038.text: I am fond of your commandments,Yes, I love them.

16039.label: Psalms 119:48
16039.text: I will raise my hands to your commandments, which I love, And I will ponder over your regulations.

16040.label: Psalms 119:49
16040.text: Remember your word to your servant,Through which you give me hope.

16041.label: Psalms 119:50
16041.text: This is my comfort in my affliction, For your saying has preserved me alive.

16042.label: Psalms 119:51
16042.text: The presumptuous utterly scorn me,But I do not deviate from your law.

16043.label: Psalms 119:52
16043.text: I remember your judgments from of old, O Jehovah,And I find comfort in them.

16044.label: Psalms 119:53
16044.text: I am seized with burning rage because of the wicked,Who forsake your law.

16045.label: Psalms 119:54
16045.text: Your regulations are songs to meWherever I dwell.

16046.label: Psalms 119:55
16046.text: During the night I remember your name, O Jehovah, So that I may keep your law.

16047.label: Psalms 119:56
16047.text: This has been my practiceBecause I have observed your orders.

16048.label: Psalms 119:57
16048.text: Jehovah is my portion; I have promised to keep your words.

16049.label: Psalms 119:58
16049.text: I appeal to you with all my heart; Show me favor according to your promise.

16050.label: Psalms 119:59
16050.text: I have examined my ways,In order to turn my feet back to your reminders.

16051.label: Psalms 119:60
16051.text: I hurry and do not delayTo keep your commandments.

16052.label: Psalms 119:61
16052.text: The ropes of the wicked surround me,But your law I do not forget.

16053.label: Psalms 119:62
16053.text: At midnight I get up to give you thanks For your righteous judgments.

16054.label: Psalms 119:63
16054.text: I am a friend of all who fear youAnd of those who keep your orders.

16055.label: Psalms 119:64
16055.text: Your loyal love, O Jehovah, fills the earth; Teach me your regulations.

16056.label: Psalms 119:65
16056.text: You have dealt well with your servant,O Jehovah, according to your word.

16057.label: Psalms 119:66
16057.text: Teach me good sense and knowledge, For I have put my trust in your commandments.

16058.label: Psalms 119:67
16058.text: Before I was afflicted, I used to go astray, But now I keep your saying.

16059.label: Psalms 119:68
16059.text: You are good and your works are good. Teach me your regulations.

16060.label: Psalms 119:69
16060.text: The presumptuous smear me with lies,But I observe your orders with all my heart.

16061.label: Psalms 119:70
16061.text: Their heart is insensitive, But I am fond of your law.

16062.label: Psalms 119:71
16062.text: It is good that I have been afflicted, So that I may learn your regulations.

16063.label: Psalms 119:72
16063.text: The law that you have proclaimed is good for me, More so than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.

16064.label: Psalms 119:73
16064.text: Your hands made me and formed me. Give me understanding,So that I may learn your commandments.

16065.label: Psalms 119:74
16065.text: Those who fear you see me and rejoice,For your word is my hope.

16066.label: Psalms 119:75
16066.text: I know, O Jehovah, that your judgments are righteous And that you have afflicted me in your faithfulness.

16067.label: Psalms 119:76
16067.text: May your loyal love please comfort me,According to the promise you made to your servant.

16068.label: Psalms 119:77
16068.text: Show me mercy, so that I may keep living, For I am fond of your law.

16069.label: Psalms 119:78
16069.text: May the presumptuous be put to shame,For they wrong me without cause. But I will ponder over your orders.

16070.label: Psalms 119:79
16070.text: Let those who fear you return to me,Those who know your reminders.

16071.label: Psalms 119:80
16071.text: May my heart be blameless in following your regulations, So that I may not be put to shame.

16072.label: Psalms 119:81
16072.text: I long for your salvation, For your word is my hope.

16073.label: Psalms 119:82
16073.text: My eyes long for your saying While I say: “When will you comfort me?”

16074.label: Psalms 119:83
16074.text: For I am like a skin bottle dried up in the smoke,But your regulations I do not forget.

16075.label: Psalms 119:84
16075.text: How many days must your servant wait? When will you bring judgment against those persecuting me?

16076.label: Psalms 119:85
16076.text: The presumptuous dig pits for me,Those who defy your law.

16077.label: Psalms 119:86
16077.text: All your commandments are trustworthy. Men persecute me without cause; help me!

16078.label: Psalms 119:87
16078.text: They almost exterminated me from the earth,But I did not abandon your orders.

16079.label: Psalms 119:88
16079.text: Preserve me alive because of your loyal love,So that I may keep the reminders you have spoken.

16080.label: Psalms 119:89
16080.text: Forever, O Jehovah,Your word will remain in the heavens.

16081.label: Psalms 119:90
16081.text: Your faithfulness is through all generations. You have firmly established the earth, so that it continues to stand.

16082.label: Psalms 119:91
16082.text: By your judgments they remain until today,For they are all your servants.

16083.label: Psalms 119:92
16083.text: If I had not been fond of your law,I would have perished in my affliction.

16084.label: Psalms 119:93
16084.text: I will never forget your orders,Because by them you have preserved me alive.

16085.label: Psalms 119:94
16085.text: I belong to you; save me, Because I have searched for your orders.

16086.label: Psalms 119:95
16086.text: The wicked wait to destroy me,But I give close attention to your reminders.

16087.label: Psalms 119:96
16087.text: I have seen a limit to all perfection,But your commandment has no limit.

16088.label: Psalms 119:97
16088.text: How I do love your law! I ponder over it all day long.

16089.label: Psalms 119:98
16089.text: Your commandment makes me wiser than my enemies, Because it is with me forever.

16090.label: Psalms 119:99
16090.text: I have more insight than all my teachers, Because I ponder over your reminders.

16091.label: Psalms 119:100
16091.text: I act with more understanding than older men,Because I observe your orders.

16092.label: Psalms 119:101
16092.text: I refuse to walk on any evil path, So that I may keep your word.

16093.label: Psalms 119:102
16093.text: I do not turn aside from your judgments,For you have instructed me.

16094.label: Psalms 119:103
16094.text: How sweet your sayings are to my palate,More so than honey to my mouth!

16095.label: Psalms 119:104
16095.text: By your orders I act with understanding. That is why I hate every false path.

16096.label: Psalms 119:105
16096.text: Your word is a lamp to my foot,And a light for my path.

16097.label: Psalms 119:106
16097.text: I have sworn an oath, and I will carry it out,To observe your righteous judgments.

16098.label: Psalms 119:107
16098.text: I have been greatly afflicted. O Jehovah, preserve me alive according to your word.

16099.label: Psalms 119:108
16099.text: Please take pleasure in my voluntary offerings of praise, O Jehovah,And teach me your judgments.

16100.label: Psalms 119:109
16100.text: My life is in constant danger, But I have not forgotten your law.

16101.label: Psalms 119:110
16101.text: The wicked have set a trap for me,But I have not strayed from your orders.

16102.label: Psalms 119:111
16102.text: I take your reminders as my permanent possession, For they are the joy of my heart.

16103.label: Psalms 119:112
16103.text: I have resolved to obey your regulationsAt all times, down to the last.

16104.label: Psalms 119:113
16104.text: I hate the halfhearted ones, But I love your law.

16105.label: Psalms 119:114
16105.text: You are my shelter and my shield, For your word is my hope.

16106.label: Psalms 119:115
16106.text: Stay away from me, you evil men, So that I may observe the commandments of my God.

16107.label: Psalms 119:116
16107.text: Support me as you promised, So that I may keep living;Do not let my hope turn into disappointment.

16108.label: Psalms 119:117
16108.text: Support me that I may be saved; Then I will always concentrate on your regulations.

16109.label: Psalms 119:118
16109.text: You reject all those who stray from your regulations, For they are false and deceitful.

16110.label: Psalms 119:119
16110.text: You discard all the wicked of the earth as if they were worthless dross. That is why I love your reminders.

16111.label: Psalms 119:120
16111.text: The dread of you makes my body tremble;I am in fear of your judgments.

16112.label: Psalms 119:121
16112.text: I have done what is just and righteous. Do not abandon me to my oppressors!

16113.label: Psalms 119:122
16113.text: Guarantee the welfare of your servant;May the presumptuous not oppress me.

16114.label: Psalms 119:123
16114.text: My eyes have grown weary waiting for your salvation And for your righteous promise.

16115.label: Psalms 119:124
16115.text: Show your loyal love to your servant, And teach me your regulations.

16116.label: Psalms 119:125
16116.text: I am your servant; give me understanding, So that I may know your reminders.

16117.label: Psalms 119:126
16117.text: The time has come for Jehovah to act, For they have broken your law.

16118.label: Psalms 119:127
16118.text: That is why I love your commandmentsMore than gold, even fine gold.

16119.label: Psalms 119:128
16119.text: Therefore, I consider every instruction from you to be right; I hate every false path.

16120.label: Psalms 119:129
16120.text: Your reminders are wonderful. That is why I observe them.

16121.label: Psalms 119:130
16121.text: The disclosure of your words brings light, Giving understanding to the inexperienced.

16122.label: Psalms 119:131
16122.text: I open my mouth wide and sigh, Because I long for your commandments.

16123.label: Psalms 119:132
16123.text: Turn to me and show me favor, In keeping with your judgment toward those loving your name.

16124.label: Psalms 119:133
16124.text: Guide my steps safely by your saying;May nothing wicked dominate me.

16125.label: Psalms 119:134
16125.text: Rescue me from oppressive men,And I will keep your orders.

16126.label: Psalms 119:135
16126.text: Make your face shine upon your servant, And teach me your regulations.

16127.label: Psalms 119:136
16127.text: Tears stream down from my eyesBecause people do not keep your law.

16128.label: Psalms 119:137
16128.text: You are righteous, O Jehovah, And your judgments are fair.

16129.label: Psalms 119:138
16129.text: The reminders you give are righteousAnd completely reliable.

16130.label: Psalms 119:139
16130.text: My zeal consumes me, Because my adversaries have forgotten your words.

16131.label: Psalms 119:140
16131.text: Your saying is thoroughly refined, And your servant loves it.

16132.label: Psalms 119:141
16132.text: I am insignificant and despised; Yet, I have not forgotten your orders.

16133.label: Psalms 119:142
16133.text: Your righteousness is an eternal righteousness, And your law is truth.

16134.label: Psalms 119:143
16134.text: Though distress and difficulty come upon me,I remain fond of your commandments.

16135.label: Psalms 119:144
16135.text: The righteousness of your reminders is eternal. Give me understanding, so that I may keep living.

16136.label: Psalms 119:145
16136.text: I call with my whole heart. Answer me, O Jehovah. Your regulations I will observe.

16137.label: Psalms 119:146
16137.text: I call on you; save me! I will keep your reminders.

16138.label: Psalms 119:147
16138.text: I have been awake before dawn to cry for help, For your words are my hope.

16139.label: Psalms 119:148
16139.text: My eyes open before the night watches,So that I can ponder over your saying.

16140.label: Psalms 119:149
16140.text: Do listen to my voice because of your loyal love. O Jehovah, preserve me alive according to your justice.

16141.label: Psalms 119:150
16141.text: Those who engage in shameful conduct come near;They are far away from your law.

16142.label: Psalms 119:151
16142.text: You are near, O Jehovah, And all your commandments are truth.

16143.label: Psalms 119:152
16143.text: Long ago I learned about your reminders,That you have established them to last forever.

16144.label: Psalms 119:153
16144.text: Look on my affliction and rescue me, For I have not forgotten your law.

16145.label: Psalms 119:154
16145.text: Defend me and rescue me; Preserve me alive in harmony with your promise.

16146.label: Psalms 119:155
16146.text: Salvation is far away from the wicked,For they have not searched for your regulations.

16147.label: Psalms 119:156
16147.text: Your mercy is great, O Jehovah. Preserve me alive in harmony with your justice.

16148.label: Psalms 119:157
16148.text: My persecutors and my adversaries are many; But I have not deviated from your reminders.

16149.label: Psalms 119:158
16149.text: I look on the treacherous with loathing,Because they do not keep your saying.

16150.label: Psalms 119:159
16150.text: See how I love your orders! O Jehovah, preserve me alive because of your loyal love.

16151.label: Psalms 119:160
16151.text: The very essence of your word is truth, And all your righteous judgments endure forever.

16152.label: Psalms 119:161
16152.text: Princes persecute me for no cause,But my heart stands in awe of your words.

16153.label: Psalms 119:162
16153.text: I rejoice over your saying Like someone who finds great spoil.

16154.label: Psalms 119:163
16154.text: I hate falsehood—I detest it —I love your law.

16155.label: Psalms 119:164
16155.text: Seven times a day I praise youBecause of your righteous judgments.

16156.label: Psalms 119:165
16156.text: Abundant peace belongs to those who love your law; Nothing can make them stumble.

16157.label: Psalms 119:166
16157.text: I hope for your acts of salvation, O Jehovah,And I observe your commandments.

16158.label: Psalms 119:167
16158.text: I keep your reminders,And I love them dearly.

16159.label: Psalms 119:168
16159.text: I observe your orders and your reminders,For you are aware of all that I do.

16160.label: Psalms 119:169
16160.text: May my cry for help reach you, O Jehovah. According to your word, make me understand.

16161.label: Psalms 119:170
16161.text: May my request for favor come before you. Save me, as you have promised.

16162.label: Psalms 119:171
16162.text: May my lips overflow with praise, For you teach me your regulations.

16163.label: Psalms 119:172
16163.text: May my tongue sing about your saying, For all your commandments are righteous.

16164.label: Psalms 119:173
16164.text: May your hand be ready to help me, Because I choose to obey your orders.

16165.label: Psalms 119:174
16165.text: I long for your salvation, O Jehovah,And I am fond of your law.

16166.label: Psalms 119:175
16166.text: Let me live so that I may praise you; May your judgments be my help.

16167.label: Psalms 119:176
16167.text: I have strayed like a lost sheep. Search for your servant,For I have not forgotten your commandments.

16169.label: Psalms 120:1
16169.text: I called to Jehovah in my distress, And he answered me.

16170.label: Psalms 120:2
16170.text: O Jehovah, rescue me from lying lipsAnd from the deceitful tongue.

16171.label: Psalms 120:3
16171.text: What will He do to you, and how will He punish you, You deceitful tongue?

16172.label: Psalms 120:4
16172.text: With sharp arrows of a warriorAnd burning coals of broomwood.

16173.label: Psalms 120:5
16173.text: Woe to me, for I have lived as a foreigner in Meʹshech! I have been dwelling among the tents of Keʹdar.

16174.label: Psalms 120:6
16174.text: I have been dwelling far too longWith those who hate peace.

16175.label: Psalms 120:7
16175.text: I am for peace, but when I speak,They are for war.

16177.label: Psalms 121:1
16177.text: I raise my eyes to the mountains. From where will my help come?

16178.label: Psalms 121:2
16178.text: My help comes from Jehovah, The Maker of heaven and earth.

16179.label: Psalms 121:3
16179.text: He will never allow your foot to slip. The One guarding you will never be drowsy.

16180.label: Psalms 121:4
16180.text: Look! He will never be drowsy nor go to sleep,The One guarding Israel.

16181.label: Psalms 121:5
16181.text: Jehovah is guarding you. Jehovah is the shade at your right hand.

16182.label: Psalms 121:6
16182.text: By day the sun will not strike you, Nor the moon by night.

16183.label: Psalms 121:7
16183.text: Jehovah will guard you against all harm. He will guard your life.

16184.label: Psalms 121:8
16184.text: Jehovah will guard you in all you do From now on and forever.

16186.label: Psalms 122:1
16186.text: I rejoiced when they said to me: “Let us go to the house of Jehovah.”

16187.label: Psalms 122:2
16187.text: And now our feet are standingWithin your gates, O Jerusalem.

16188.label: Psalms 122:3
16188.text: Jerusalem is built as a cityThat is joined together as one.

16189.label: Psalms 122:4
16189.text: The tribes have gone up to it,The tribes of Jah, According to the reminder to Israel,To give thanks to the name of Jehovah.

16190.label: Psalms 122:5
16190.text: For thrones for judgment were set up there, Thrones of the house of David.

16191.label: Psalms 122:6
16191.text: Ask for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you, O city, will be secure.

16192.label: Psalms 122:7
16192.text: May peace continue within your ramparts, Security within your fortified towers.

16193.label: Psalms 122:8
16193.text: For the sake of my brothers and my companions I will say: “May there be peace within you.”

16194.label: Psalms 122:9
16194.text: For the sake of the house of Jehovah our God, I will seek good for you.

16196.label: Psalms 123:1
16196.text: To you I raise my eyes, You who are enthroned in the heavens.

16197.label: Psalms 123:2
16197.text: As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master,And the eyes of a servant girl to the hand of her mistress,So our eyes look to Jehovah our God Until he shows us favor.

16198.label: Psalms 123:3
16198.text: Show us favor, O Jehovah, show us favor,For we have had our full share of contempt.

16199.label: Psalms 123:4
16199.text: We have had our full share of ridicule from the self-assuredAnd the contempt of the arrogant.

16201.label: Psalms 124:1
16201.text: “If Jehovah had not been with us” —Let Israel now say—

16202.label: Psalms 124:2
16202.text: “If Jehovah had not been with us When men rose up to attack us,

16203.label: Psalms 124:3
16203.text: Then they would have swallowed us up alive When their anger was burning against us.

16204.label: Psalms 124:4
16204.text: Then the waters would have washed us away,The torrent would have swept over us.

16205.label: Psalms 124:5
16205.text: The raging waters would have overwhelmed us.

16206.label: Psalms 124:6
16206.text: May Jehovah be praised,For he has not given us as prey to their teeth.

16207.label: Psalms 124:7
16207.text: We are like a bird that escapedFrom the hunter’s trap; The trap was broken,And we escaped.

16208.label: Psalms 124:8
16208.text: Our help is in the name of Jehovah, The Maker of heaven and earth.”

16210.label: Psalms 125:1
16210.text: Those who trust in Jehovah Are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shakenBut endures forever.

16211.label: Psalms 125:2
16211.text: Just as mountains surround Jerusalem, So Jehovah surrounds his people From now on and forever.

16212.label: Psalms 125:3
16212.text: The scepter of wickedness will not remain upon the land allotted to the righteous, So that the righteous do not turn to doing what is wrong.

16213.label: Psalms 125:4
16213.text: Do good, O Jehovah, to those who are good, To those who are upright in heart.

16214.label: Psalms 125:5
16214.text: As for those who turn aside to their crooked ways,Jehovah will remove them along with the wrongdoers. May there be peace upon Israel.

16216.label: Psalms 126:1
16216.text: When Jehovah gathered back the captives of Zion, We thought we were dreaming.

16217.label: Psalms 126:2
16217.text: At that time our mouth was filled with laughterAnd our tongue with a joyful shout. At that time they said among the nations: “Jehovah has done great things for them.”

16218.label: Psalms 126:3
16218.text: Jehovah has done great things for us, And we are overjoyed.

16219.label: Psalms 126:4
16219.text: Do gather back our captives, O Jehovah,Like streams in the Negʹeb.

16220.label: Psalms 126:5
16220.text: Those sowing seed with tearsWill reap with a joyful shout.

16221.label: Psalms 126:6
16221.text: The one who does go out, though weeping,Carrying his bag of seed,Will surely return with a joyful shout, Carrying in his sheaves.

16223.label: Psalms 127:1
16223.text: Unless Jehovah builds the house,It is in vain that its builders work hard on it. Unless Jehovah guards the city, It is in vain that the guard stays awake.

16224.label: Psalms 127:2
16224.text: It is in vain that you rise up early,That you stay up late,That you toil for your food,Since he provides for his loved ones while giving them sleep.

16225.label: Psalms 127:3
16225.text: Look! Sons are an inheritance from Jehovah; The fruit of the womb is a reward.

16226.label: Psalms 127:4
16226.text: Like arrows in the hand of a mighty man,So are the sons of one’s youth.

16227.label: Psalms 127:5
16227.text: Happy is the man who fills his quiver with them. They will not be put to shame,For they will speak with enemies in the city gate.

16229.label: Psalms 128:1
16229.text: Happy is everyone who fears Jehovah, Who walks in His ways.

16230.label: Psalms 128:2
16230.text: You will eat what your hands worked hard to produce. You will be happy and will enjoy prosperity.

16231.label: Psalms 128:3
16231.text: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house; Your sons will be like shoots of an olive tree around your table.

16232.label: Psalms 128:4
16232.text: Look! That is how the man who fears JehovahWill be blessed.

16233.label: Psalms 128:5
16233.text: Jehovah will bless you from Zion. May you see Jerusalem prosper all the days of your life

16234.label: Psalms 128:6
16234.text: And see the sons of your sons. May there be peace upon Israel.

16236.label: Psalms 129:1
16236.text: “Since my youth they have constantly attacked me” —Let Israel now say—

16237.label: Psalms 129:2
16237.text: “Since my youth they have constantly attacked me; But they have not defeated me.

16238.label: Psalms 129:3
16238.text: Plowmen have plowed across my back; They have made their furrows long.”

16239.label: Psalms 129:4
16239.text: But Jehovah is righteous; He has cut up the ropes of the wicked.

16240.label: Psalms 129:5
16240.text: They will be put to shame and will retreat in disgrace,All those who hate Zion.

16241.label: Psalms 129:6
16241.text: They will become like grass on the rooftopsThat withers before it is pulled up,

16242.label: Psalms 129:7
16242.text: That cannot fill the reaper’s handNor the arms of the one gathering sheaves.

16243.label: Psalms 129:8
16243.text: Those passing by will not say: “May the blessing of Jehovah be upon you;We bless you in the name of Jehovah.”

16245.label: Psalms 130:1
16245.text: From the depths I call to you, O Jehovah.

16246.label: Psalms 130:2
16246.text: O Jehovah, hear my voice. May your ears pay attention to my pleas for help.

16247.label: Psalms 130:3
16247.text: If errors were what you watch, O Jah, Then who, O Jehovah, could stand?

16248.label: Psalms 130:4
16248.text: For with you there is true forgiveness, So that you may be held in awe.

16249.label: Psalms 130:5
16249.text: I hope in Jehovah, my whole being hopes in him;I wait for his word.

16250.label: Psalms 130:6
16250.text: I eagerly wait for Jehovah, More than watchmen wait for the morning, Yes, more than watchmen wait for the morning.

16251.label: Psalms 130:7
16251.text: Let Israel keep waiting for Jehovah,For Jehovah is loyal in his love, And he has great power to redeem.

16252.label: Psalms 130:8
16252.text: He will redeem Israel from all their errors.

16254.label: Psalms 131:1
16254.text: O Jehovah, my heart is not haughty,Nor are my eyes lofty; Nor do I aspire to things too great, Or to things that are beyond me.

16255.label: Psalms 131:2
16255.text: No, but I have calmed and quieted my soul Like a weaned child with its mother;I am contented like a weaned child.

16256.label: Psalms 131:3
16256.text: Let Israel wait for Jehovah From now on and forever.

16258.label: Psalms 132:1
16258.text: O Jehovah, remember DavidAnd all his suffering;

16259.label: Psalms 132:2
16259.text: How he swore to Jehovah,How he vowed to the Powerful One of Jacob:

16260.label: Psalms 132:3
16260.text: “I will not go into my tent, my home. I will not lie upon my couch, my bed;

16261.label: Psalms 132:4
16261.text: I will not allow my eyes to sleep,Nor my eyelids to slumber

16262.label: Psalms 132:5
16262.text: Until I find a place for Jehovah,A fine residence for the Powerful One of Jacob.”

16263.label: Psalms 132:6
16263.text: Look! We heard about it in Ephʹra·thah; We found it in the fields of the forest.

16264.label: Psalms 132:7
16264.text: Let us come into his residence; Let us bow down at his footstool.

16265.label: Psalms 132:8
16265.text: Rise up, O Jehovah, to come to your resting-place, You and the Ark of your strength.

16266.label: Psalms 132:9
16266.text: May your priests be clothed with righteousness,And may your loyal ones shout joyfully.

16267.label: Psalms 132:10
16267.text: For the sake of David your servant,Do not reject your anointed one.

16268.label: Psalms 132:11
16268.text: Jehovah has sworn to David;He will surely not go back on his word: “One of your offspring, I will place on your throne.

16269.label: Psalms 132:12
16269.text: If your sons keep my covenantAnd my reminders that I teach them, Their sons tooWill sit on your throne forever.”

16270.label: Psalms 132:13
16270.text: For Jehovah has chosen Zion; He has desired it for his dwelling place:

16271.label: Psalms 132:14
16271.text: “This is my resting-place forever;Here I will dwell, for this is my desire.

16272.label: Psalms 132:15
16272.text: I will richly bless it with provisions;I will satisfy its poor with bread.

16273.label: Psalms 132:16
16273.text: Its priests I will clothe with salvation, And its loyal ones will shout joyfully.

16274.label: Psalms 132:17
16274.text: There I will make the strength of David grow. I have prepared a lamp for my anointed one.

16275.label: Psalms 132:18
16275.text: I will clothe his enemies with shame,But the crown on his head will flourish.”

16277.label: Psalms 133:1
16277.text: Look! How good and how pleasant it isFor brothers to dwell together in unity!

16278.label: Psalms 133:2
16278.text: It is like fine oil poured on the head That runs down the beard,Aaron’s beard, And runs down onto the collar of his garments.

16279.label: Psalms 133:3
16279.text: It is like the dew of Herʹmon That descends on the mountains of Zion. That is where Jehovah decreed his blessing—Life everlasting.

16281.label: Psalms 134:1
16281.text: Praise Jehovah,All you servants of Jehovah, You who stand in the house of Jehovah during the nights.

16282.label: Psalms 134:2
16282.text: Raise your hands in holiness And praise Jehovah.

16283.label: Psalms 134:3
16283.text: May Jehovah, the Maker of heaven and earth,Bless you from Zion.

16284.label: Psalms 135:1
16284.text: Praise Jah! Praise the name of Jehovah;Offer praise, you servants of Jehovah,

16285.label: Psalms 135:2
16285.text: You who are standing in the house of Jehovah,In the courtyards of the house of our God.

16286.label: Psalms 135:3
16286.text: Praise Jah, for Jehovah is good. Sing praises to his name, for it is pleasant.

16287.label: Psalms 135:4
16287.text: For Jah has chosen Jacob for himself,Israel for his special property.

16288.label: Psalms 135:5
16288.text: For I well know that Jehovah is great;Our Lord is greater than all other gods.

16289.label: Psalms 135:6
16289.text: Jehovah does everything he pleases to do In heaven and on earth, in the seas and all the depths.

16290.label: Psalms 135:7
16290.text: He causes clouds to ascend from the ends of the earth;He makes lightning for the rain;He brings the wind out of his storehouses.

16291.label: Psalms 135:8
16291.text: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt,Both man and beast.

16292.label: Psalms 135:9
16292.text: He sent signs and miracles among you, O Egypt, Against Pharʹaoh and all his servants.

16293.label: Psalms 135:10
16293.text: He struck down many nations And killed mighty kings

16294.label: Psalms 135:11
16294.text: —Siʹhon the king of the Amʹor·ites, Og the king of Baʹshan, And all the kingdoms of Caʹnaan.

16295.label: Psalms 135:12
16295.text: He gave their land as an inheritance,An inheritance to Israel his people.

16296.label: Psalms 135:13
16296.text: O Jehovah, your name endures forever. O Jehovah, your fame endures for all generations.

16297.label: Psalms 135:14
16297.text: For Jehovah will defend his people, And he will feel compassion for his servants.

16298.label: Psalms 135:15
16298.text: The idols of the nations are silver and gold,The work of human hands.

16299.label: Psalms 135:16
16299.text: A mouth they have, but they cannot speak; Eyes, but they cannot see;

16300.label: Psalms 135:17
16300.text: Ears they have, but they cannot hear. There is no breath in their mouth.

16301.label: Psalms 135:18
16301.text: The people who make them will become just like them, As will all those who trust in them.

16302.label: Psalms 135:19
16302.text: O house of Israel, praise Jehovah. O house of Aaron, praise Jehovah.

16303.label: Psalms 135:20
16303.text: O house of Leʹvi, praise Jehovah. You who fear Jehovah, praise Jehovah.

16304.label: Psalms 135:21
16304.text: May Jehovah be praised from Zion, The One residing in Jerusalem. Praise Jah!

16305.label: Psalms 136:1
16305.text: Give thanks to Jehovah, for he is good; His loyal love endures forever.

16306.label: Psalms 136:2
16306.text: Give thanks to the God of gods, For his loyal love endures forever.

16307.label: Psalms 136:3
16307.text: Give thanks to the Lord of lords,For his loyal love endures forever.

16308.label: Psalms 136:4
16308.text: He alone does great wonders, For his loyal love endures forever.

16309.label: Psalms 136:5
16309.text: He skillfully made the heavens, For his loyal love endures forever.

16310.label: Psalms 136:6
16310.text: He spread out the earth over the waters, For his loyal love endures forever.

16311.label: Psalms 136:7
16311.text: He made the great lights, For his loyal love endures forever,

16312.label: Psalms 136:8
16312.text: The sun to rule over the day, For his loyal love endures forever,

16313.label: Psalms 136:9
16313.text: The moon and the stars to rule over the night, For his loyal love endures forever.

16314.label: Psalms 136:10
16314.text: He struck down Egypt’s firstborn, For his loyal love endures forever.

16315.label: Psalms 136:11
16315.text: He brought Israel out from their midst, For his loyal love endures forever,

16316.label: Psalms 136:12
16316.text: With a mighty hand and an outstretched arm,For his loyal love endures forever.

16317.label: Psalms 136:13
16317.text: He split the Red Sea in two, For his loyal love endures forever.

16318.label: Psalms 136:14
16318.text: He caused Israel to pass through the middle of it, For his loyal love endures forever.

16319.label: Psalms 136:15
16319.text: He shook off Pharʹaoh and his army into the Red Sea, For his loyal love endures forever.

16320.label: Psalms 136:16
16320.text: He led his people through the wilderness, For his loyal love endures forever.

16321.label: Psalms 136:17
16321.text: He struck down great kings, For his loyal love endures forever.

16322.label: Psalms 136:18
16322.text: He killed mighty kings,For his loyal love endures forever,

16323.label: Psalms 136:19
16323.text: Siʹhon the king of the Amʹor·ites,For his loyal love endures forever,

16324.label: Psalms 136:20
16324.text: And Og the king of Baʹshan,For his loyal love endures forever.

16325.label: Psalms 136:21
16325.text: He gave their land as an inheritance, For his loyal love endures forever,

16326.label: Psalms 136:22
16326.text: An inheritance to Israel his servant,For his loyal love endures forever.

16327.label: Psalms 136:23
16327.text: He remembered us when we were low, For his loyal love endures forever.

16328.label: Psalms 136:24
16328.text: He kept rescuing us from our adversaries, For his loyal love endures forever.

16329.label: Psalms 136:25
16329.text: He gives food to every living thing, For his loyal love endures forever.

16330.label: Psalms 136:26
16330.text: Give thanks to the God of the heavens,For his loyal love endures forever.

16331.label: Psalms 137:1
16331.text: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat. We wept when we remembered Zion.

16332.label: Psalms 137:2
16332.text: Upon the poplar trees in her midst,We hung our harps.

16333.label: Psalms 137:3
16333.text: For there our captors asked us for a song, Those mocking us wanted amusement: “Sing for us one of the songs of Zion.”

16334.label: Psalms 137:4
16334.text: How can we sing the song of JehovahOn foreign soil?

16335.label: Psalms 137:5
16335.text: If I should forget you, O Jerusalem,Let my right hand be forgetful.

16336.label: Psalms 137:6
16336.text: Let my tongue stick to my palateIf I do not remember you,If I do not place Jerusalem aboveMy greatest reasons for rejoicing.

16337.label: Psalms 137:7
16337.text: Remember, O Jehovah,What the Eʹdom·ites said on the day Jerusalem fell: “Tear it down! Tear it down to its foundations!”

16338.label: Psalms 137:8
16338.text: O daughter of Babylon, who is soon to be devastated, Happy will be the one who rewards youWith the treatment you inflicted on us.

16339.label: Psalms 137:9
16339.text: Happy will be the one who seizes your childrenAnd dashes them against the rocks.

16341.label: Psalms 138:1
16341.text: I will praise you with all my heart. In the face of other gods,I will sing praises.

16342.label: Psalms 138:2
16342.text: I will bow down toward your holy temple, And I will praise your name Because of your loyal love and your faithfulness. For you have magnified your saying and your name above everything else.

16343.label: Psalms 138:3
16343.text: On the day I called, you answered me; You made me bold and strong.

16344.label: Psalms 138:4
16344.text: All the kings of the earth will praise you, O Jehovah, For they will have heard the promises you have spoken.

16345.label: Psalms 138:5
16345.text: They will sing about the ways of Jehovah,For the glory of Jehovah is great.

16346.label: Psalms 138:6
16346.text: Though Jehovah is high, he takes note of the humble, But the haughty he knows only from a distance.

16347.label: Psalms 138:7
16347.text: Even when I walk in the midst of danger, you will preserve me alive. You stretch out your hand against the anger of my enemies;Your right hand will save me.

16348.label: Psalms 138:8
16348.text: Jehovah will accomplish all things in my behalf. O Jehovah, your loyal love endures forever; Do not forsake the works of your hands.

16350.label: Psalms 139:1
16350.text: O Jehovah, you have searched through me, and you know me.

16351.label: Psalms 139:2
16351.text: You know when I sit down and when I rise up. You discern my thoughts from afar.

16352.label: Psalms 139:3
16352.text: You observe me when I travel and when I lie down;You are familiar with all my ways.

16353.label: Psalms 139:4
16353.text: There is not a word on my tongue,But look! O Jehovah, you already know it well.

16354.label: Psalms 139:5
16354.text: Behind and before me, you surround me;And you lay your hand upon me.

16355.label: Psalms 139:6
16355.text: Such knowledge is beyond my comprehension. It is too high for me to reach.

16356.label: Psalms 139:7
16356.text: Where can I escape from your spirit,And where can I run away from your face?

16357.label: Psalms 139:8
16357.text: If I were to ascend to heaven, you would be there,And if I were to make my bed in the Grave, look! you would be there.

16358.label: Psalms 139:9
16358.text: If I would fly away with the wings of the dawnTo reside by the most remote sea,

16359.label: Psalms 139:10
16359.text: Even there your hand would lead meAnd your right hand would take hold of me.

16360.label: Psalms 139:11
16360.text: If I say: “Surely darkness will conceal me!” Then the night around me would become light.

16361.label: Psalms 139:12
16361.text: Even the darkness would not be too dark for you,But night would be as bright as the day; Darkness is the same as light to you.

16362.label: Psalms 139:13
16362.text: For you produced my kidneys;You kept me screened off in my mother’s womb.

16363.label: Psalms 139:14
16363.text: I praise you because in an awe-inspiring way I am wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful, I know this very well.

16364.label: Psalms 139:15
16364.text: My bones were not hidden from youWhen I was made in secret,When I was woven in the depths of the earth.

16365.label: Psalms 139:16
16365.text: Your eyes even saw me as an embryo;All its parts were written in your bookRegarding the days when they were formed,Before any of them existed.

16366.label: Psalms 139:17
16366.text: So to me, how precious your thoughts are! O God, how vast is the sum of them!

16367.label: Psalms 139:18
16367.text: If I try to count them, they outnumber the grains of sand. When I awake, I am still with you.

16368.label: Psalms 139:19
16368.text: O God, if only you would slay the wicked! Then the violent men would depart from me,

16369.label: Psalms 139:20
16369.text: Those who say things against you with evil intent; They are your adversaries who take up your name in a worthless way.

16370.label: Psalms 139:21
16370.text: Do I not hate those who hate you, O Jehovah, And loathe those who revolt against you?

16371.label: Psalms 139:22
16371.text: I have nothing but hatred for them; They have become real enemies to me.

16372.label: Psalms 139:23
16372.text: Search through me, O God, and know my heart. Examine me, and know my anxious thoughts.

16373.label: Psalms 139:24
16373.text: See whether there is in me any harmful way, And lead me in the way of eternity.

16375.label: Psalms 140:1
16375.text: Rescue me, O Jehovah, from evil men;Protect me from violent men,

16376.label: Psalms 140:2
16376.text: Those who scheme evil in their hearts And stir up conflict all day long.

16377.label: Psalms 140:3
16377.text: They sharpen their tongue like that of a serpent; Venom of vipers is behind their lips. (Selah)

16378.label: Psalms 140:4
16378.text: Protect me, O Jehovah, from the hands of the wicked; Safeguard me from violent men,Those who scheme to trip me.

16379.label: Psalms 140:5
16379.text: The haughty ones hide a trap for me;With ropes they spread out a net beside the path. They set snares for me. (Selah)

16380.label: Psalms 140:6
16380.text: I say to Jehovah: “You are my God. Listen, O Jehovah, to my pleas for help.”

16381.label: Psalms 140:7
16381.text: O Jehovah the Sovereign Lord, my strong Savior,You shield my head in the day of battle.

16382.label: Psalms 140:8
16382.text: Do not grant, O Jehovah, the desires of the wicked. Do not let their plots succeed, so that they are not exalted. (Selah)

16383.label: Psalms 140:9
16383.text: May the heads of those surrounding meBe covered with the evil spoken by their lips.

16384.label: Psalms 140:10
16384.text: May burning coals rain down on them. May they be hurled into the fire,Into deep pits, never to rise again.

16385.label: Psalms 140:11
16385.text: May the slanderer find no place on the earth. May evil pursue men of violence and strike them down.

16386.label: Psalms 140:12
16386.text: I know that Jehovah will defend the lowlyAnd give justice to the poor.

16387.label: Psalms 140:13
16387.text: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name;The upright will dwell before your face.

16389.label: Psalms 141:1
16389.text: O Jehovah, I call on you. Come quickly to help me. Do pay attention when I call to you.

16390.label: Psalms 141:2
16390.text: May my prayer be as incense prepared before you, My uplifted hands like the evening grain offering.

16391.label: Psalms 141:3
16391.text: Station a guard for my mouth, O Jehovah,Do set a watch over the door of my lips.

16392.label: Psalms 141:4
16392.text: Do not let my heart incline to anything bad, To share in vile deeds with evil men;May I never feast on their delicacies.

16393.label: Psalms 141:5
16393.text: Should the righteous one strike me, it would be an act of loyal love; Should he reprove me, it would be like oil on my head, Which my head would never refuse. My prayer will continue even during their calamities.

16394.label: Psalms 141:6
16394.text: Though their judges are thrown down from the cliff,The people will pay attention to my words, for they are pleasant.

16395.label: Psalms 141:7
16395.text: Just as when someone plows and breaks up the soil,So our bones have been scattered at the mouth of the Grave.

16396.label: Psalms 141:8
16396.text: But my eyes look to you, O Sovereign Lord Jehovah. In you I have taken refuge. Do not take away my life.

16397.label: Psalms 141:9
16397.text: Protect me from the jaws of the trap they have laid for me,From the snares of evildoers.

16398.label: Psalms 141:10
16398.text: The wicked will fall into their own nets all together While I pass by safely.

16400.label: Psalms 142:1
16400.text: With my voice I call to Jehovah for help; With my voice I plead with Jehovah for favor.

16401.label: Psalms 142:2
16401.text: Before him I pour out my concern;Before him I tell about my distress

16402.label: Psalms 142:3
16402.text: When my spirit fails within me. Then you watch my roadway. In the path where I walk,They hide a trap for me.

16403.label: Psalms 142:4
16403.text: Look at my right hand and seeThat no one cares about me. There is nowhere I can flee; No one is concerned about me.

16404.label: Psalms 142:5
16404.text: I call to you, O Jehovah, for help. I say: “You are my refuge, All I have in the land of the living.”

16405.label: Psalms 142:6
16405.text: Pay attention to my cry for help,For I have been brought very low. Rescue me from my persecutors, For they are stronger than I am.

16406.label: Psalms 142:7
16406.text: Bring me out of the dungeonTo praise your name. May the righteous gather around meBecause you deal kindly with me.

16408.label: Psalms 143:1
16408.text: O Jehovah, hear my prayer; Listen to my plea for help. In your faithfulness and in your righteousness, answer me.

16409.label: Psalms 143:2
16409.text: Do not enter into judgment with your servant,For no one living can be righteous before you.

16410.label: Psalms 143:3
16410.text: For the enemy pursues me; He has crushed my life into the ground. He has caused me to dwell in darkness like those long dead.

16411.label: Psalms 143:4
16411.text: My spirit is failing; My heart is numb within me.

16412.label: Psalms 143:5
16412.text: I remember the days of old;I meditate on all your activity; I eagerly ponder over the work of your hands.

16413.label: Psalms 143:6
16413.text: I spread out my hands to you;I am like a parched land that thirsts for you. (Selah)

16414.label: Psalms 143:7
16414.text: Do answer me quickly, O Jehovah; My strength has come to an end. Do not hide your face from me, Or I will be like those going down into the pit.

16415.label: Psalms 143:8
16415.text: Let me hear your loyal love in the morning,For I trust in you. Make known to me the way I should walk, For to you I turn.

16416.label: Psalms 143:9
16416.text: Rescue me from my enemies, O Jehovah. I seek your protection.

16417.label: Psalms 143:10
16417.text: Teach me to do your will, For you are my God. Your spirit is good;May it lead me on level ground.

16418.label: Psalms 143:11
16418.text: For the sake of your name, O Jehovah, preserve me alive. In your righteousness, rescue me from distress.

16419.label: Psalms 143:12
16419.text: In your loyal love, put an end to my enemies; Destroy all those harassing me, For I am your servant.

16421.label: Psalms 144:1
16421.text: May Jehovah, my Rock, be praised,Who trains my hands for battle,My fingers for warfare.

16422.label: Psalms 144:2
16422.text: He is my loyal love and my stronghold,My secure refuge and my rescuer,My shield and the One in whom I have taken shelter, The One subduing peoples under me.

16423.label: Psalms 144:3
16423.text: O Jehovah, what is man that you should notice him,The son of mortal man that you should pay attention to him?

16424.label: Psalms 144:4
16424.text: Man resembles a mere breath; His days are like a passing shadow.

16425.label: Psalms 144:5
16425.text: O Jehovah, lower your heavens and descend; Touch the mountains and make them smoke.

16426.label: Psalms 144:6
16426.text: Make lightning flash and scatter the enemy; Shoot your arrows and throw them into confusion.

16427.label: Psalms 144:7
16427.text: Stretch out your hands from above;Rescue me and save me from the surging waters,From the hand of the foreigners,

16428.label: Psalms 144:8
16428.text: Whose mouths speak liesAnd who raise their right hand to swear to what is false.

16429.label: Psalms 144:9
16429.text: O God, I will sing to you a new song. I will sing praises to you, accompanied by a ten-stringed instrument,

16430.label: Psalms 144:10
16430.text: To the One who gives victory to kings, The One rescuing his servant David from the deadly sword.

16431.label: Psalms 144:11
16431.text: Rescue me and save me from the hand of the foreigners,Whose mouths speak liesAnd who raise their right hand to swear to what is false.

16432.label: Psalms 144:12
16432.text: Then our sons will be like young plants that grow up quickly,Our daughters like corner pillars carved for a palace.

16433.label: Psalms 144:13
16433.text: Our storehouses will overflow with every kind of produce;Our flocks in our fields will multiply by the thousands, by the tens of thousands.

16434.label: Psalms 144:14
16434.text: Our cattle, heavy with young, will suffer no mishap or miscarriage;There will be no cry of distress in our public squares.

16435.label: Psalms 144:15
16435.text: Happy is the people for whom it is this way! Happy is the people whose God is Jehovah!

16437.label: Psalms 145:1
16437.text: I will exalt you, O my God the King, I will praise your name forever and ever.

16438.label: Psalms 145:2
16438.text: All day long I will praise you; I will praise your name forever and ever.

16439.label: Psalms 145:3
16439.text: Jehovah is great and most worthy of praise; His greatness is unsearchable.

16440.label: Psalms 145:4
16440.text: Generation after generation will praise your works;They will tell about your mighty acts.

16441.label: Psalms 145:5
16441.text: Of the glorious splendor of your majesty they will speak And on your wonderful works I will meditate.

16442.label: Psalms 145:6
16442.text: They will speak about your awe-inspiring deeds, And I will declare your greatness.

16443.label: Psalms 145:7
16443.text: They will bubble over as they recall your abundant goodness, And they will shout joyfully because of your righteousness.

16444.label: Psalms 145:8
16444.text: Jehovah is compassionate and merciful, Slow to anger and great in loyal love.

16445.label: Psalms 145:9
16445.text: Jehovah is good to all, And his mercy is evident in all his works.

16446.label: Psalms 145:10
16446.text: All your works will glorify you, O Jehovah, And your loyal ones will praise you.

16447.label: Psalms 145:11
16447.text: They will proclaim the glory of your kingship And speak about your mightiness,

16448.label: Psalms 145:12
16448.text: To make known to men your mighty acts And the glorious splendor of your kingship.

16449.label: Psalms 145:13
16449.text: Your kingship is an eternal kingship,And your dominion endures throughout all generations.

16450.label: Psalms 145:14
16450.text: Jehovah supports all who are falling And raises up all who are bowed down.

16451.label: Psalms 145:15
16451.text: All eyes look hopefully to you;You give them their food in its season.

16452.label: Psalms 145:16
16452.text: You open your handAnd satisfy the desire of every living thing.

16453.label: Psalms 145:17
16453.text: Jehovah is righteous in all his ways And loyal in all that he does.

16454.label: Psalms 145:18
16454.text: Jehovah is near to all those calling on him, To all who call on him in truth.

16455.label: Psalms 145:19
16455.text: He satisfies the desire of those who fear him; He hears their cry for help, and he rescues them.

16456.label: Psalms 145:20
16456.text: Jehovah guards all those who love him, But all the wicked he will annihilate.

16457.label: Psalms 145:21
16457.text: My mouth will declare the praise of Jehovah; Let every living thing praise his holy name forever and ever.

16458.label: Psalms 146:1
16458.text: Praise Jah! Let my whole being praise Jehovah.

16459.label: Psalms 146:2
16459.text: I will praise Jehovah all my life. I will sing praises to my God as long as I live.

16460.label: Psalms 146:3
16460.text: Do not put your trust in princes Nor in a son of man, who cannot bring salvation.

16461.label: Psalms 146:4
16461.text: His spirit goes out, he returns to the ground; On that very day his thoughts perish.

16462.label: Psalms 146:5
16462.text: Happy is the one who has the God of Jacob as his helper, Whose hope is in Jehovah his God,

16463.label: Psalms 146:6
16463.text: The Maker of heaven and earth,Of the sea, and of all that is in them, The One who always remains faithful,

16464.label: Psalms 146:7
16464.text: The One securing justice for those defrauded,The One giving bread to the hungry. Jehovah is releasing the prisoners.

16465.label: Psalms 146:8
16465.text: Jehovah is opening the eyes of the blind; Jehovah is raising up those bowed down; Jehovah loves the righteous.

16466.label: Psalms 146:9
16466.text: Jehovah is protecting the foreign residents;He sustains the fatherless child and the widow, But he thwarts the plans of the wicked.

16467.label: Psalms 146:10
16467.text: Jehovah will be King forever, Your God, O Zion, for generation after generation. Praise Jah!

16468.label: Psalms 147:1
16468.text: Praise Jah! It is good to sing praises to our God;How pleasant and fitting it is to praise him!

16469.label: Psalms 147:2
16469.text: Jehovah is building Jerusalem; He gathers together the dispersed ones of Israel.

16470.label: Psalms 147:3
16470.text: He heals the brokenhearted;He binds up their wounds.

16471.label: Psalms 147:4
16471.text: He counts the number of the stars;He calls all of them by name.

16472.label: Psalms 147:5
16472.text: Our Lord is great and is mighty in power; His understanding is beyond measure.

16473.label: Psalms 147:6
16473.text: Jehovah raises up the meek, But he hurls the wicked to the ground.

16474.label: Psalms 147:7
16474.text: Sing to Jehovah with thanksgiving;Sing praises to our God, accompanied by the harp,

16475.label: Psalms 147:8
16475.text: The One who covers the heavens with clouds,The One providing rain for the earth, The One making grass sprout on the mountains.

16476.label: Psalms 147:9
16476.text: To the animals he gives food, To the young ravens that call out for it.

16477.label: Psalms 147:10
16477.text: He does not delight in the power of the horse; Nor is he impressed by the strong legs of a man.

16478.label: Psalms 147:11
16478.text: Jehovah finds pleasure in those who fear him, In those waiting for his loyal love.

16479.label: Psalms 147:12
16479.text: Glorify Jehovah, O Jerusalem. Praise your God, O Zion.

16480.label: Psalms 147:13
16480.text: He makes the bars of your city gates strong;He blesses your sons within you.

16481.label: Psalms 147:14
16481.text: He brings peace to your territory; He satisfies you with the finest wheat.

16482.label: Psalms 147:15
16482.text: He sends his command to the earth;His word runs swiftly.

16483.label: Psalms 147:16
16483.text: He sends the snow like wool; He scatters the frost just like ashes.

16484.label: Psalms 147:17
16484.text: He hurls down his hailstones like morsels of bread. Who can withstand his cold?

16485.label: Psalms 147:18
16485.text: He sends out his word, and they melt. He makes his wind blow, and the waters flow.

16486.label: Psalms 147:19
16486.text: He declares his word to Jacob,His regulations and judgments to Israel.

16487.label: Psalms 147:20
16487.text: He has not done so with any other nation; They know nothing about his judgments. Praise Jah!

16488.label: Psalms 148:1
16488.text: Praise Jah! Praise Jehovah from the heavens; Praise him in the heights.

16489.label: Psalms 148:2
16489.text: Praise him, all his angels. Praise him, all his army.

16490.label: Psalms 148:3
16490.text: Praise him, sun and moon. Praise him, all shining stars.

16491.label: Psalms 148:4
16491.text: Praise him, O highest heavens And waters above the heavens.

16492.label: Psalms 148:5
16492.text: Let them praise the name of Jehovah,For he commanded, and they were created.

16493.label: Psalms 148:6
16493.text: He keeps them established forever and ever; He has issued a decree that will not pass away.

16494.label: Psalms 148:7
16494.text: Praise Jehovah from the earth,You great sea creatures and all deep waters,

16495.label: Psalms 148:8
16495.text: You lightning and hail, snow and thick clouds,You storm wind, carrying out his word,

16496.label: Psalms 148:9
16496.text: You mountains and all you hills, You fruit trees and all you cedars,

16497.label: Psalms 148:10
16497.text: You wild animals and all you domestic animals,You creeping things and winged birds,

16498.label: Psalms 148:11
16498.text: You kings of the earth and all you nations,You princes and all you judges of the earth,

16499.label: Psalms 148:12
16499.text: You young men and young women, Old men and young together.

16500.label: Psalms 148:13
16500.text: Let them praise the name of Jehovah,For his name alone is unreachably high. His majesty is above earth and heaven.

16501.label: Psalms 148:14
16501.text: He will exalt the strength of his people,For the praise of all his loyal ones,Of the sons of Israel, the people close to him. Praise Jah!

16502.label: Psalms 149:1
16502.text: Praise Jah! Sing to Jehovah a new song; Praise him in the congregation of the loyal ones.

16503.label: Psalms 149:2
16503.text: Let Israel rejoice in its Grand Maker; Let the sons of Zion be joyful in their King.

16504.label: Psalms 149:3
16504.text: Let them praise his name with dancing And sing praises to him, accompanied by the tambourine and the harp.

16505.label: Psalms 149:4
16505.text: For Jehovah takes pleasure in his people. He adorns the meek with salvation.

16506.label: Psalms 149:5
16506.text: Let the loyal ones exult in glory;Let them shout for joy upon their beds.

16507.label: Psalms 149:6
16507.text: Let the songs praising God be in their throat,And a two-edged sword be in their hand,

16508.label: Psalms 149:7
16508.text: To execute vengeance on the nationsAnd punishment on the peoples,

16509.label: Psalms 149:8
16509.text: To bind their kings with shacklesAnd their nobles with iron fetters,

16510.label: Psalms 149:9
16510.text: To execute the judgment written against them. This honor belongs to all his loyal ones. Praise Jah!

16511.label: Psalms 150:1
16511.text: Praise Jah! Praise God in his holy place. Praise him in the expanse of his strength.

16512.label: Psalms 150:2
16512.text: Praise him for his mighty works. Praise him for his exceeding greatness.

16513.label: Psalms 150:3
16513.text: Praise him with the sounding of the horn. Praise him with the stringed instrument and the harp.

16514.label: Psalms 150:4
16514.text: Praise him with the tambourine and the circle dance. Praise him with strings and the flute.

16515.label: Psalms 150:5
16515.text: Praise him with ringing cymbals. Praise him with crashing cymbals.

16516.label: Psalms 150:6
16516.text: Every breathing thing—let it praise Jah. Praise Jah!
